data.jd_text:
**About Moove**
 Moove is a global mobility fintech and operations company focused on transforming mobility through innovative fleet solutions, mobility, and next\-generation transportation technologies. As we expand our operations across the UAE and GCC region, we are looking for an experienced and highly driven Project Manager to support the launch and scaling of new mobility and automotive projects.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This role leads the planning, coordination, and execution of new mobility and automotive projects across the UAE. Working closely with internal teams, OEM partners, technology providers, and strategic stakeholders, the Program Manager drives initiatives from concept through commercial launch ensuring Moove’s expansion is delivered on time, at scale, and to the highest operational standard.
   

  

 The role requires strong project management expertise, stakeholder coordination, and a working understanding of the mobility ecosystem. The ideal candidate has 5–7 years of experience in project or program management, with a track record of delivering complex, cross\-functional initiatives in mobility, fleet, logistics, or adjacent sectors.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 The role exists to own end\-to\-end delivery of mobility projects across the UAE from initial scoping through pilot and into commercial launch. Success is measured by projects delivered on time, within budget, and at the quality standard required for Moove to scale its regional operations.
   

  

 Within the first 6 months, the role is expected to own at least one active project end\-to\-end, establish clear project governance and reporting cadence for the leadership team, and build the operational frameworks that enable future market launches to be faster and more repeatable.
   

  

 Core Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end project management for mobility and automotive projects across the UAE.
* Develop detailed project plans, timelines, budgets, and execution frameworks for new market launches.
* Manage cross\-functional teams across Operations, Engineering, Compliance, Fleet, Safety, and Technology.
* Drive project execution from pilot phase through commercial launch, owning delivery outcomes end\-to\-end.
* Monitor project risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans; escalate issues proactively to senior leadership.
* Lead vendor management, OEM partner onboarding, and operational integration activities across GCC markets.
* Ensure compliance with transportation, safety, and operational standards.
* Prepare executive dashboards, management reports, operational updates, and board presentations.
* Build scalable operational processes and frameworks to enable faster and more repeatable expansion.
* Perform operational analysis, reporting, forecasting, and data tracking using advanced Excel and BI tools.


**What You Will Need For This Position**
* Experience: 5–7 years in project or program management within mobility, transportation, fleet operations, logistics, or technology; proven track record of delivering cross\-functional projects end\-to\-end in a fast\-paced environment.
* Education / Skills: Bachelor’s in Engineering, Business, Transportation, or Technology; PMP or equivalent preferred; advanced Excel and BI tools proficiency required.
* Traits: Exceptional stakeholder management, highly analytical, comfortable with ambiguity, GCC market\-savvy, strong communicator, and able to lead without authority across complex cross\-functional teams.


**Key Metrics**
* On\-time, on\-budget delivery of mobility projects across UAE.
* Quality and accuracy of executive dashboards, project reporting, and operational updates.
* Stakeholder satisfaction across internal functions and external OEM and technology partners.
* Speed and repeatability of new market launches enabled by scalable operational frameworks.
* Compliance and risk management across all active projects and UAE market operations.


**Who You'll Be Working with:**
 Directly reporting to our Managing Director, and closely working with our UAE Operations Team.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our team is collaborative, positive, curious, and engaged. We think fast, work smart, laugh often, and are looking for like\-minded people to join us in our mission to disrupt vehicle ownership and make financial freedom within reach.
   

  

 Moove is strongly committed to diversity within its community. The Company’s approved Employment Equity Plan and Targets will be considered as part of the recruitment process. As an Equal Opportunities employer, we welcome people from all backgrounds who seek the opportunity to help build a future where everyone and everything can move independently.
   

  

**Pre\-hiring Notice:** 
 Moove relies on the accuracy of information contained in employment applications, as well as the accuracy of other data presented throughout the hiring process and during employment. Any misrepresentations, falsifications, or material omissions in any information or data provided by an applicant may result in the applicant being excluded from further consideration for employment or if an individual has already been hired, termination of employment.
   

  

**EEO Statement:** 
 Moove is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, race, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, political affiliation or any other protected characteristic.

data.raw_snippet: Join the UAE’s largest bank and one of the world’s largest and safest financial institutions. We are looking for top talent and your success is our success
data.jd_text:
Join the UAE’s largest bank and one of the world’s largest and safest financial institutions. Our focus is to create value for our employees, customers, shareholders and communities to grow through differentiation, agility and innovation. We are looking for top talent and your success is our success. Accelerate your growth as you help us reach our goals and advance your career. Be ready to make your mark a top company, in an exciting \& dynamic industry.
 



  





**Job Purpose**




  





 To grow and manage large account portfolios and sensitive client relationships for assigned portfolio in the Real Estate \& Hospitality banking segment; improve service quality levels and supervise the subordinates' day\-to\-day activities and client interactions to ensure that the team's objectives are constantly met and its revenue targets achieved, while maintaining client satisfaction and portfolio credit quality.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities**




  





**Client and Market Analysis** 




  




* Conduct financial analysis on clients and their respective geographies/ industries/ markets to identify potential opportunities and risks.
* Demonstrate understanding of the sector across all RE asset classes
* Originate new business opportunities with new to bank target clients across banking products and in line with relevant policies.
* Cross collaborate to obtain support from relevant stakeholders and governance forums to close deals (e.g., credit, products, GT).
* Develop Term Sheet, Information Memorandum, Mandate letter etc.
* Examine \& resolve credit, market and operational risk aspects of the transactions in collaboration with products and enablement units.
* Leverage FAB’s network expansion through cross border deals to expand RE market share
* Anchor Strategic Alliances with UAE’s Top Developers, Authorities, and sector experts
* Expand Products Penetration Through Sector\-Focused Solutions, keeping with RE cycles and thematics
* Ensure high returns with satisfactory yields
* Maintain the credit quality of the client's relationships within the Portfolio to an acceptable level set by the
* Bank's management.
* Pitch, review, negotiate and conclude deals.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key decision makers in other banks and attend industry events to originate business.
* Up to date with the latest market, competitors, regulatory and industry and amend accordingly the account plans as when applicable.
* Ability to handle sophisticated transactions and engage assigned team members.
* Recommend policy amendments as when required to match with the latest business trends.



  





**Business Origination** 




**Client Relationship Management** 




  




* To achieve assigned financial and non\-financial objectives by meeting all borrowing \& non borrowing needs of customers with target segments (E.g., borrowers, transactors, depositors).
* Prepare and Maintain Account Plans for all clients with support from relevant partners (e.g., products, international banking, Employee banking, Asset Management, etc.).
* Support on the conduct of annual/periodic credit facility reviews in the existing portfolio in a timely manner and support on the recommendation of appropriate credit facilities in line with the banks credit. policy to maximize earnings while containing risks to an acceptable level and identifying candidates for downgrades/ upgrades.
* Develop, Implement and maintain complete control aspects i.e., documentation, periodical client visits / call reports, stock inspections and formal credit checks / informal market feedback to monitor the assigned portfolio effectively.
* Establish appropriate monitoring of client relationships and the underlying RE portfolio performance
* Organize client meetings with relevant partners/ seniority to deepen FAB relationship within the portfolio.
* Identify \& develop cross selling opportunities and increase cross\-sell ratio and returns with clients.
* Support client on their day\-to\-day banking requirements with support from the team (as applicable).
* Ensure customer satisfaction remains high and meets the targeted NPS score.
* Keep abreast of market trends and manage a disciplined marketing process by identifying steps/strategies necessary to effectively initiate relationships with prospects.
* Onboard new clients as and when required.



  





**Collaboration** 




  




* Align with the relevant Real Estate teams across the bank (credit, products) as well as other partners (international FAB offices) to identify and convert opportunities.
* Collaborate with other business divisions to drive cross\-BU collaboration. Develop proposition strategy, competition analysis, focused group approach, service delivery model, customer experience, internal \& external campaigns and alignment with other Products \& proposition including Risk policies, Payment \& Cash management, Trade products, collaboration with Retail banking including Private Banking, etc.
* Align with International banking to support client in FAB network locations.
* Support Unit/Divisional/Bank\-wide initiatives (as required or assigned).



  





**Operational** 




  




* Follow all relevant policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions so that work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner.
* Conduct periodic reviews of risks (credit, operational, compliance etc.) within the portfolio on a regular basis.
* Drive day\-to\-day administrative and transactional activities for the team such as client calls, documentation follow up, pipeline updates, and any other activities in the unit/team to ensure continuity of work and delivery of effective/high quality output.
* Ensure that internal processes for existing portfolio/ NTBs are in\-line with the Bank's policies \& procedures.
* Manage and follow up on KYC and compliance requirements to ensure consistency with the Bank's KYC and AML policies and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure all credit reviews are submitted on time and agreed conditions are met.
* Ensure all clients' files \[documents] are maintained.
* Maintain a satisfactory audit on the portfolio.
* Adhere to process KPl's and, ORM, BCP \& Internal Audit requirements.
* Prepare timely and accurate statements and reports to meet the unit's requirements, policies, and standards.



  





**Leadership** 



* Act as Role Model for the entire Real Estate \& Hospitality group and Real Estate team
* Lead, Mentor, Motivate, Develop and Coach team members to ensure career growth and short \& long term successors
* Establish high\-performance culture and ensure high engagement levels.
* Encourage ownership through rightful assignments to team members.
* Achieve individual and team's financial performance targets.
* Learning \& Development Attend appropriate on and off\-the\-job training programs and ensure development and skill upgradation of team members.
* Involvement in team members new hirings.



  





**Qualifications**




  




* Bachelor’s degree in finance or related discipline.
* Master’s degree in business administration is preferred.



  





**Experience**




  





 12\+ years of experience in Banking with at least 8\+ years in senior role of team management.
 



  





**Knowledge, Skills, And Attributes**




  




* Deep Knowledge of Wholesale Banking or investment banking.
* Demonstrable RE Sector knowledge and experience.
* Understanding of FAB's product offering and business strategy.
* Ability to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders to drive business.
* Strong relationship management skills both internally and externally.
* Sound communication skills (written and verbal).
* Ability to analyse and research information.
* Deep Financial and credit analysis ability with an aptitude to identify opportunities and close business deals.
* Data analysis and financial modelling skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and adjust quickly to changing priorities.
* Proficient in MS Office (excel, word and Power\-point).

data.jd_text:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together. The Company’s three core products are Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world; Lens Studio, an augmented reality platform that powers AR across Snapchat and other services; and its AR glasses, Spectacles.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Head of Public Policy, MEA to join Snap Inc. As a member of the EMEA Public Policy team, the role reports to the Senior Director Public Policy EMEA. You will be responsible for the public policy and government relations work across the MEA region, with a particular focus on UAE and Saudi Arabia, as well as Qatar and potentially further afield in Africa. Working from our office in Dubai, you will co\-design, and execute the implementation of the public policy plan for relevant markets. The Middle East and Africa are key growth regions for Snap and our relationships with the governments and other key public stakeholders are of the utmost importance. Ensuring that Snap’s distinctive voice is heard and accommodated in policy\-making circles will be a key priority.
   

  

 The Head of Public Policy is co\-responsible for development of positions on key local and regional policy issues impacting Snap and for developing effective strategies to achieve policy outcomes and mitigate risk. This person will work closely with the rest of the Global Public Policy team, wider Legal team, regional Sales teams, the Communications team, Platform Integrity and Product teams and, on occasion, senior business executives to ensure the public policy program supports business growth and protects the company’s interests.
   

  

 What you’ll do:
   

  

* Serve as the main day\-to\-day policy representative of Snap Inc in the Middle East and Africa. Further deepen relationships with relevant government officials, NGOs, trade associations, non\-governmental organizations, and other influential stakeholders.
* Work closely with the Senior Director EMEA of Public Policy, the EMEA Public Policy team, the SVP Global Policy \& Platform Operations and, on occasion, the senior executive organization.
* Being the Policy spokesperson of the company in the region in various fora, events etc.
* Be the first to act and respond to the appropriate public policy inquiries.
* Collaborate with Public Policy, Legal and Business teams to analyze legislative initiatives, advise on risks and opportunities and develop company policy positions and messaging
* Partner with the Communications team to help them appropriately respond to Policy\-related media inquiries, by providing the correct policy narrative that best represents Snap Inc.


 Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:
   

  

* A proven ability for shaping, and working with, government officials, NGOs, coalitions and other stakeholder groups.
* Good tech policy understanding and existing relationships within government and the wider stakeholder community in the region.
* Excellent communication and advocacy skills and sound political judgment.
* Forward thinking and proactive ability on legislative, regulatory and public policy issues. Ability to rapidly understand and master complex policy issues.
* Ability to work with Snap business to identify pertinent issues and orient the public policy team to meet priorities.
* Ability to work independently/ self\-starter in a fast\-paced, multicultural environment
* Demonstrated ability to work with a wide range of external groups and individuals, including those who are opponents or critics.
* Teammate with a positive attitude, motivation and a sense of humor
* Articulate and thoughtful.
* Able to adapt communication on complex issues for different audiences.
* A passion for Snapchat and creativity.


 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

* Master's degree or advanced studies in law/economics/public affairs
* 10\+ years relevant experience in MENA public policy and public affairs
* Strong experience (4\+ years) on MENA tech policy, ideally working on platform regulations


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Working experience in Dubai or Riyadh
* Previous experience working with the Government or regulators or other Public institutions is a plus
* Full Arabic and English proficiency necessary


 If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please don’t be shy and provide us some information.
   

  

 "Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4\+ days per week.
   

  

 At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. Snap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. EOE, including disability/vets.
   

  

 Our Benefits: Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long\-term success!

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**About Us**
 Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
   

  

 At Visa, youll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
   

  

 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
   

  

****Job Description****
 Team Summary:
   

  

 The Executive Talent Acquisition team at Visa plays a strategic role in shaping the company’s leadership pipeline and driving its long\-term vision. This team manages full\-cycle executive recruitment globally, from sourcing and market mapping to candidate assessment and onboarding, ensuring Visa hires the right leaders to support Visa’s growth.
   

  

 What a Director, Executive Talent Acquisition, CEMEA does at Visa:
   

  

* Owns and leads Executive Talent Acquisition strategy and delivery for CEMEA, ensuring alignment with Visa’s global Executive TA framework while adapting approaches to local and regional market needs.
* Acts as a trusted strategic adviser to senior executives in CEMEA, providing market intelligence, talent insights and guidance on executive hiring decisions.
* Builds strong partnerships with People Team partners and leadership teams to anticipate future leadership capability needs.
* Partners with Global TA Leadership to evaluate and adopt emerging AI capabilities that improve executive hiring efficiency, decision making and candidate experience across the region.
* Contributes to the Global Executive Talent Acquisition strategy, collaborating with Executive TA leaders across Research, Coordination, AP, CEMEA, LAC and North America to drive consistency, innovation and best\-practice sharing.
* Partners with Global Exec TA leaders to design and execute global TA initiatives and operational enhancements that improve scalability, governance and executive hiring outcomes across regions.
* Ensures regional compliance with global processes and executive hiring standards.
* Sets clear performance expectations, coaches on executive search excellence, drives accountability and supports career development across the team.
* Oversees workload prioritisation and resource planning to ensure seamless execution of multiple, high\-impact executive searches.
* Coaches and upskills the Executive TA team on the effective and responsible use of AI and automation, embedding data\-driven decision making into executive search delivery.
* Manages a complex portfolio of senior\-level executive searches across CEMEA, balancing competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Develops and deploys client\-specific executive recruiting strategies, including proactive market mapping and talent pipelining.
* Partners with internal teams including Workforce Planning, ETA Research, Coordination, Preboarding, Total Rewards and Talent Management to deliver a seamless end\-to\-end hiring experience.
* Leverages advanced data analytics and reporting (ATS, Excel, Talent Insights tools) to assess performance, identify trends and inform decision\-making.
* Provides regular insights to Global TA Leadership and business leaders on talent availability, competitor activity and hiring risks.
* Stays current on CEMEA labour markets, regulatory considerations, industry news and executive compensation trends.
* Champions Visa’s employer brand in the CEMEA executive talent market, ensuring an exceptional, high\-touch candidate experience.
* Represents Visa with professionalism, discretion and credibility when engaging senior external talent.
* Supports branding, process improvement and candidate engagement initiatives as part of broader TA projects.


**Why This Is Important To Visa**
 The CEMEA region spans highly diverse, fast‑growing, and complex markets where leadership capability directly determines business performance and risk management. This role owns and leads executive TA strategy and delivery across CEMEA, ensuring Visa attracts and appoints senior leaders who can navigate regulatory complexity, geopolitical variation and differing market maturity while remaining aligned to Visa’s global strategy and standards. Acting as a trusted adviser to CEMEA executives, this role brings forward market intelligence, succession insights and transparent decision‑making to support critical VP and SVP appointments, while also strengthening internal mobility and long‑term leadership pipelines. By connecting regional needs to the global Executive TA framework, the role ensures consistency, governance and innovation in how Visa builds leadership capability across one of its most strategically important growth regions.
   

  

 This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.
   

  

****Qualifications****
* 12\+ years of experience in Executive Talent Acquisition or executive search in complex, multinational environments.
* Proven track record delivering senior executive hires across any markets in the CEMEA region, ideally within financial services, payments, technology or global matrixed organisations.
* Deep understanding of CEMEA talent markets, cultural nuances and cross\-border hiring considerations.
* Passion for inclusive hiring, data\-driven decision\-making and continuous improvement.
* Experience with Applicant Tracking Systems.
* Highly advanced reporting and data analytics experience to identify hiring challenges and gaps.
* Ability to operate at both strategic and operational levels, influencing senior stakeholders while driving execution excellence.
* Results\-oriented, self\-motivated, organised and resourceful.
* Detail\-oriented with a proven track record of juggling multiple tasks and meeting various deadlines.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


**Visa is an EEO Employer**
 Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

 This role will ideally be based in either our Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore office.

 Reporting to our Director of Conflicts and joining the OGC team, the successful candidate will assist with the development of a specialised team of conflicts professionals responsible for analysing, advising on and resolving legal and commercial conflicts of interest, information barriers and share dealing requests. * Compliance expert with deep technical and practical knowledge of legal conflicts of interest, commercial conflicts and client confidentiality, with some knowledge of Market Abuse Regs.
* Familiarity with Intapp Intake.
* Experience of policy work.
* Experience of people management, including supervision/management of large teams and experience devising and driving people initiatives (including around recruitment and development).
* Proven track record of delivering change and process improvements.
* Experience working in an offshore environment or with offshore structures would be helpful but not required
* Strategic: ability to work in pursuit of a clear strategic direction, align the teams priorities with those of the wider OGC team and the firm, and proactively identify improvements.

 **Salesforce**

 The Delivery Director solutioning role aims to identify the potential and cultivate the career path of those digital studio members (Product, Design, Data, Cloud, Scalable, etc) that share a willingness to:
   

  

* Actively participate in the high quality delivery of solutions for our clients,
* Executive thought leadership and aid in decision making,
* Co\-creation (feasibility analysis and alternatives design) and the integration of off the shelf solutions with customized implementations,
* Executive management of dependencies and risks, and
* Managing our client’s business impact.


**Capabilities**
**Project Leadership and integral delivery responsibilities**
* Approach projects holistically, owning and driving end\-to\-end delivery of solutions.
* Lead execution of key enterprise initiatives by forming collaborative partnerships with colleagues across businesses and functional areas.
* Provide thought leadership and subject matter expertise in relevant areas (e.g., Digital Transformation, AI, Blockchain, etc.)
* Manage client governance and communication processes.


**Solutioning: Thought Leadership \& Advisory**
* Frame and analyze complex problems.
* Assess areas of opportunity, in line with overall vision and strategy.
* Develop pragmatic solutions to key strategic and operational issues.
* Create and deliver compelling recommendations and presentations to senior client leadership, aligned to audience and purpose
* Play a key role in informing and influencing senior client decision making.
* Lead, coach and influence top management (CEO, COO, CIO) from a variety of company types (large organizations, disruptive start\-ups)
* Define and successfully execute a transformation program while upholding business KPIs.


**Be a Commercial Market Expert:**
* Proactively participate in the clear mission and vision for client programs.
* Proactively participate in the creation of a viable go to market strategy given the competitive landscape.
* Proactively participate in the measurement of industry \& business specific KPIs.


**Desired Qualifications**
 We are looking for outstanding individuals with excellent intellectual \& analytical capabilities, pragmatic problem\-solving skills, strong communications \& influencing capabilities, a robust strategy toolkit and a passion to effect change across the organization at the most senior levels.
   

  

* Engineering Bachelor’s degree required, or advanced degree strongly preferred.
* 10\+ years of experience in Delivery Management
* 5\+ years experience in a consulting firm or similar consulting capacity.
* Strong English communications skills.
* Outstanding critical thinking, analytical and quantitative abilities.
* Strong communication skills including experience in developing C\-suite presentations.
* Experience in structuring \& delivering technology strategy projects
* Broad understanding of current technology practices (Agile, Cloud Computing/SaaS, Enterprise Data Management, etc.)
* Collaborative work style / leadership presence.
* Ability to effectively interact with \& earn trust of peers and senior management across the organization.
* Strong project and process management skills, including proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Executive presence: self\-starter with a keen sense of ownership and commitment to the work, and a passion to deliver results.
* Storytelling: can use narratives to create an emotional connection with clients.
* Open minded and respectful of various points of view and beliefs.


 Join our team
   

  

 This job Must be filled in Dubai, UAE.
   

  

 Create with us digital products that people love. We will bring businesses and consumers together through AI technology and creativity, driving digital transformation to impact the world positively.
   

  

 We may use AI and machine learning technologies in our recruitment process. Compensation is determined based on skills, qualifications, experience, and location. In addition to competitive salaries, we offer a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about our commitment to diversity and inclusion and Globant’s Benefits.

 At Kerzner, we never settle. Through continued innovation, our team of pioneers push until the next level is achieved, and then to keep going. Our philosophy is simple \- we go above and beyond to Blow Away our Guest and Colleagues. Good enough never is. For us, it is all about perfection and innovation. This is not simply our job, it’s our passion.
   

  

 Our Colleagues are at the heart of who we are and what we do. With an international team of over 10,000 Colleagues and strong strategic growth on the horizon, we offer unrivalled career opportunities around the world. We are committed to provide our Colleagues at all levels with opportunities to grow and develop within the organisation through personalised development plans and tailored succession planning. We invest in our communities to sustain the environment where we operate and minimising our own footprint. Whether it is through animal conservation, education or tree\-planting, we like to give back in as many ways as we can to help our communities flourish.
   

  

 The Director, Experience \& Customer Journey supports the definition, implementation, and continuous enhancement of the guest journey across all touchpoints within the brand experience. This position reports to the VP Operations and ensures that the brand consistently delivers seamless, differentiated, and memorable experiences that align with the brand promise, while supporting guest loyalty, satisfaction, advocacy, and commercial performance.
   

  

 The role works closely with Operations, Commercial, Marketing, Digital, Learning \& Development, Quality, and Resort teams to identify pain points, improve service delivery, and enhance the guest experience from pre\-arrival through post\-stay interactions. The Director, Experience \& Customer Journey supports the design of guest journey standards, emotional touchpoints, service rituals, and personalized experiences that elevate the brand positioning and create lasting guest connections.
   

  

 The position also supports the use of guest feedback, technology, AI, CRM tools, and data insights to drive personalization, simplify guest interactions, and improve guest satisfaction across all touchpoints. The role collaborates with corporate functions and resort teams to ensure that customer journey principles are embedded into new projects, brand initiatives, operational processes, and service culture across the portfolio.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop and implement the brand’s guest experience and customer journey strategy across all properties and touchpoints.
* Define and continuously refine the ideal end\-to\-end guest journey, ensuring alignment with the brand vision, values, and positioning.
* Lead the development of guest experience standards, emotional touchpoints, rituals, and service moments that create memorable experiences.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, personalize, and improve the guest journey.
* Ensure consistency in guest experience delivery across all resorts, residences, clubs, and other brand offerings.
* Map and document guest journeys for key customer segments and personas.
* Identify pain points, gaps, and opportunities across the customer lifecycle.
* Partner with operational and functional teams to implement improvements and monitor effectiveness.
* Lead projects related to guest journey redesign, service innovation, digital integration, and process enhancement.
* Ensure guest journey considerations are embedded into new openings, renovations, systems, and business initiatives.
* Oversee the collection, analysis, and interpretation of guest feedback from surveys, reviews, social media, direct comments, mystery audits, and other channels.
* Use guest insight data to identify trends, root causes, and opportunities for improvement.
* Develop dashboards, reporting tools, and presentations to communicate guest experience performance and key priorities.
* Benchmark against competitors and luxury hospitality best practices.
* Support properties with action plans related to guest satisfaction, reputation management, and service recovery.
* Collaborate with Brand, Quality, and Operations teams to ensure that guest experience standards are clearly defined and embedded.

**Account Director – Social, Content, Influencer \& Performance** 




**Company:** 
 Techne Agency
 



**Location:** 
 Dubai (Managing a UK team) / Hybrid or Remote (with travel when required)
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Start Date:** 
 Q3 2026
 



  





**About Techne Agency** 





 Techne is a boutique marketing agency operating at the intersection of brand, content and performance. We specialise in social media, content production, influencer marketing, paid media and website content, delivering integrated strategies across the full customer journey.
 





 We work with premium and luxury brands across hospitality, fashion, beauty and technology, supporting both brand\-building and performance\-driven marketing with a strong track record of results across the UK, UAE and Europe.
 





 Our teams are based across London and Dubai, working with clients on both sides — European and UAE markets. This international footprint allows us to combine cultural relevance, creative execution and performance expertise across multiple markets.
 





 As the agency continues to grow, we are building a senior leadership layer to support this expansion. We are looking for someone who can help shape the future of the business, elevate our standards and play a key role in delivering exceptional work across all clients.
 




  





**The Role** 





 We're looking for a senior operator to lead client delivery across the agency and act as the right hand to the Founder \& CEO.
 





 This is a pivotal role within Techne, offering the opportunity to take ownership of high\-profile client relationships, shape the quality and direction of our work, and build a delivery function designed to scale.
 





 This is not a traditional account management role. You will operate across multiple disciplines — combining strategic oversight, team leadership and hands\-on execution to ensure consistently exceptional output. You'll manage the team, own the day\-to\-day, and be the person who keeps everything moving to a high standard.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Client Leadership** 



* Own senior client relationships across our European and UAE portfolio, acting as the main point of contact for strategy, performance and escalation
* Lead communication and direction across retainers and projects, ensuring accounts are proactively managed
* Identify and drive growth opportunities within existing accounts and support new business where relevant
* Balance client ambition with operational feasibility — ensuring what gets sold can be delivered



**Delivery \& Standards** 



* Take full ownership of delivery across all accounts, including the transition from new business into execution
* Oversee social media, content production, influencer campaigns, paid performance, and website and editorial content
* Define clear processes and pipelines to deliver each scope item to a high standard
* Challenge output and hold a high bar for creative and strategic quality across all functions
* Understand team strengths and gaps, and step in where needed to support or unblock delivery
* Be comfortable getting hands\-on when required to demonstrate standards or solve execution challenges



**Team Leadership** 



* Manage and develop the social, content, influencer and performance team across London and Dubai
* Set clear expectations and hold the team accountable for performance and delivery
* Provide regular visibility to the Founder \& CEO on team performance, risks and priorities
* Build a culture of ownership, pace and accountability — shifting the team from reactive execution to structured, proactive delivery



**Operations \& Problem Solving** 



* Continuously review workflows, resourcing and delivery structures
* Identify inefficiencies and implement practical, scalable solutions
* Expand and improve the agency's network of vendors, tools and capabilities
* Move the team from ad\-hoc execution to structured, repeatable systems over time



**Growth \& New Business** 



* Support the CEO and the Client Growth Manager on new business pitches through strong strategic, creative and operational input
* Shape proposals, scopes and pricing aligned with both client ambition and delivery capability
* Contribute ideas to improve the agency's offering, positioning and commercial structure



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 7–10 years in a digital marketing agency environment, with at least 2–3 years at a senior account or director level
* Strong working knowledge across social media, content, influencer marketing, paid performance and website content — you don't need to execute everything, but you need to know what good looks like
* Proven experience owning client relationships and driving account growth, not just managing delivery
* Experience managing and developing junior and mid\-level team members
* Commercially aware — strong understanding of scope, resourcing and how to protect margin
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, lean agency — this is not a corporate role
* Experience working with premium or luxury brands — you understand the standard these clients expect
* Based in Dubai with UK market experience, or based in the UK with proven UAE market experience
* Highly solutions\-oriented, with a bias for action and ownership over process



  





**A Note from the Founder** 





 This role is central to the next stage of growth at Techne across London, Dubai and New York.
 





 I'm looking for someone who can take ownership of client delivery, elevate standards across the team and help build a more scalable and structured way of operating — without losing the pace and quality that defines how we work.
 





 This is not a hands\-off or purely strategic role. You'll be expected to lead from the front, bring solutions and step into execution when needed. If you're looking for a highly structured corporate environment, this likely isn't the right fit. If you're motivated by ownership, pace and building something, we should speak.

 8\. Strategic Planning \& Expansion

 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**
 At Emirates IT, we are dedicated to staying ahead of the curve by embracing the latest technologies and strategies to streamline integration processes and enhance infrastructure efficiency. As a valued member of our team, you will play a pivotal role in managing and optimizing our integration landscape, ensuring smooth data flow and system interoperability across our enterprise platforms. If you are passionate about creating seamless integration solutions and driving technological excellence, we invite you to apply and to contribute to the success of Emirates Group.
   

  

 Join our Agile Delivery team on a mission to create technology solutions that enhance customer experience and drive revenue growth. We focus on leveraging agile methodologies to deliver innovative and secure technology quickly and efficiently. If you are passionate about delivering value, embracing agility, and leading projects in a dynamic environment, we invite you to apply and become a key player in our journey to drive success at the Emirates Group.
   

  

**The** 
**Agile Delivery Manager** 
**is responsible for planning, leading, organising and motivating scrum teams, either within a Release Train or outside, to achieve a high level of performance and quality in the delivery of outputs that provide exceptional value to end users and customers. The Agile Delivery Manager may be responsible for managing several concurrent high visibility initiatives using agile/hybrid methods, in a fast paced environment that may involve multiple business units.**
**In This Role You Will**
* Facilitate key ceremonies such as PI planning and Review, and play a consultative role to help put in place the appropriate people, process, and tools supporting the Agile framework and coaching members of the team as needed to optimize the efficiency of the Release Train team.
* Be responsible for driving delivery of large scale internal development and vendor tender across Emirates Network Operations. The environment is fast paced, with tight timelines and high operational impact. The focus is on delivering internally built systems as well as tendering for a large vendor implementations.
* Act as a Champion in blending traditional project management principles and practices with an Agile development approach in the right proportions to fit initiatives of all sizes with the appropriate level of planning and provide the right balance of agility and predictability based on PMI\-ACP principles.
* Build a trusting and safe environment where problems can be raised without fear of blame or retribution, with an emphasis on healing and problem\-solving. Protect and provide all support to the team/s using a servant leadership style whenever possible and lead by example. Facilitate getting the work done practicing servant leadership and encourage discussion, decision making and conflict resolution.
* Lead the Integrated Programme Planning (Lean Start Up). Working with portfolio teams and supporting the Technical Product Manager, drive and facilitate decomposition of Epic Roadmaps into Integrated Program backlog/plans (Features), ready for hand off into team level backlogs.
* Drive Quality and ensure the Definition of Done (DOD) is being followed; ensures each team member is fully engaged in the stories and making a meaningful contribution. Encourage a sustainable pace adhering to the agreed quality management plan with the team. Maintain an agile project management tool (e.g. ScrumDesk, JIRA, etc.).
* Assist in team development through holding teams accountable for their commitments, removing roadblocks to their work; leveraging cross functional team skills to improve product backlog throughput; and mentoring and developing team members. Attend regular stand\-ups and scrum of scrums, in order to understand the team's progress and issues, and to flag up to the team, where necessary, any important external issues of which they need to be aware.
* Supports the Technical Product Manager in managing business expectations and transparency in both product backlog and schedule for all initiatives. Supports IT Service Manager on service management, service performance and continuous improvements.
* Define and manage a well\-defined process and champion ongoing process improvement initiatives to implement best practices for Agile Delivery Management. Implement an agile governance with key ceremonies, drives continuous improvement with constant assessments of velocity (team story point throughput), defect percentage improvements etc. and also ensures that required governance and ceremonies are in place to give visibility and transparency to business stakeholders.
* Assist with the cost estimation / sizing exercise for both near term and future initiatives and assists with preparing total cost of ownership with the product team, maintains the actuals within the allocated budget and also ensure that forecasting for all the demands are accurately done for the FY.
* Together with the Product team, supports the RFx phases in the procurement process and the scheduling of such activities in relation to the product lifecycle.


 Qualification
   

  

**To be considered for the role, you must meet the below requirements:**
* Degree in Computer Science or equivalent
* Proven leadership and project delivery experience in a matrix organisation with global teams for a large organisation.
* Experience in agile delivery within the context of a large technology change programmes.


**Knowledge/skills**
* Certified SAFe and PMI ACP (additional certifications such as PMI, Prince 2, CSM desirable) with 5\+ Years of practical application of the Scrum Management discipline.
* Well\-versed in the use of tools of software delivery e.g. ServiceNow ITBM, MS OFFICE suite, JIRA, Confluence etc.
* Good architectural knowledge of large scale systems.
* Ability to effectively communicate specialist information in an understandable format to all stakeholders.
* Excellent communication skills, focusing on core scrum values of openness, honesty and respect.
* Hands\-on leader with strong people skills.
* Experience in operational domains such as network operations, crew management or rostering will be an advantage, particularly where delivery impacts live operations.


 Leadership Role: Yes
   

  

 Salary \& benefits
   

  

 Join us in Dubai and enjoy an attractive tax\-free salary and travel benefits that are exclusive to our industry, including discounts on flights and hotel stays around the world. Find out what it’s like to live and work in our fast\-paced, cosmopolitan home city in the Dubai Lifestyle section of our website www.emirates.com/careers

data.jd_text:
Ciel Dubai Marina, Vignette Collection is a lifestyle luxury hotel located in the Dubai Marina district of Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Standing at 377 meters, Ciel is the tallest hotel in the world boasting 1,004 guestrooms featuring floor\-to\-ceiling panoramic glass windows, eight dining destinations, three outdoor swimming pools including one of the world's highest infinity pools, a luxury spa, and a state\-of\-the\-art gymnasium. Designed by award\-winning architects Norr, the skyscraper is a global symbol of modern engineering and luxury.
   

  

 Ciel is strategically located at the gateway to Dubai Marina, offering direct access to key tourist attractions, beaches, retail centres, and transport networks. The property was developed by The First Group, a renowned UAE\-based global property investment firm and is part of IHG Hotels \& Resorts’ Vignette Collection. Discover more at https//www.vignettecollectionhotels.com/cieldubai.
   

  

 The First Group Hospitality is a Dubai\-headquartered, full\-service hospitality management company specialising in hotel operations, asset management, and F\&B strategy. With a team of industry veterans and a proven track record, the company delivers tailored solutions that enhance efficiency, optimise revenue, and maximise asset value for investors and hotel owners. As a trusted third\-party hotel management provider, The First Group Hospitality partners with leading global brands to drive operational excellence and long\-term profitability, thanks to expertise spanning property performance optimisation, cost management, and guest experience enhancement.
   

  

 Beyond management, The First Group Hospitality develops and operates a dynamic portfolio of upscale hotels, residences, and award\-winning restaurants, creating high\-value hospitality assets that stand out in the market. For more information, visit tfghospitality.com
   

  

 The Senior Commercial Director is responsible for setting, leading and delivering the full commercial strategy for the Ciel Dubai Marina \- Vignette Collection by IHG. Working directly with the Managing Director, hotel leadership teams and above\-property/shared\-service teams, this role is accountable for commercial growth across rooms, food and beverage, meetings and events, and all relevant ancillary revenue streams.
   

  

 The role has clear accountability for RevPAR, market share, total revenue, profitability\-aligned growth, brand\-aligned commercial execution and the development of a high\-performing commercial culture across the organization. The ideal candidate is a proven commercial leader with successful experience in a similar hotel organization and a demonstrated track record of managing luxury lifestyle in a complex environment as well as critical asset importance.
   

  

 Sales and Marketing Teams report directly to the Senior Commercial Director, ensuring clear ownership of demand generation, brand activation, commercial execution and revenue delivery across all commercial disciplines.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Commercial Strategy and Leadership**
* Develop, lead and execute the hotel strategy ensuring alignment with ownership objectives, brand standards, annual budgets and hotel business plans.
* Act as the senior commercial partner to the Managing Director, providing clear recommendations on business mix, pricing, demand generation, channel strategy and growth opportunities.
* Translate objectives into measurable commercial action plans with clear ownership, timelines and performance expectations.
* Create a strong commercial culture across the organization, ensuring hotel teams understand market opportunities, revenue priorities and their role in driving commercial results.


**RevPAR, Total Revenue and Market Share Growth**
* Drive RevPAR, ADR, occupancy, market share and total revenue growth across the asset through disciplined commercial planning and execution.
* Lead total hotel revenue opportunities across rooms, food and beverage, groups, meetings and events, long\-stay, corporate, leisure and ancillary revenue streams.
* Work closely with revenue management teams to optimize pricing, inventory controls, restrictions, forecasting, segmentation and channel mix.
* Identify demand gaps and growth opportunities by monitoring market trends, competitor activity, city\-wide events, source markets and changing customer behaviour.
* Ensure commercial decisions are profitability\-aligned, balancing revenue growth with distribution costs, margin impact and long\-term account value.


**Sales, Marketing, Distribution and Brand Activation**
* Lead the overall sales strategy across key segments including corporate, leisure, groups, MICE, wholesale, consortia, travel trade, OTA and direct channels.
* Ensure strategic account management disciplines are in place, including account plans, production reviews, relationship mapping, conversion tracking and measurable action plans.
* Oversee commercial input into marketing, PR, digital, e\-commerce, CRM, loyalty and promotional campaigns to drive demand and conversion for each hotel.
* Maximize the use of IHG commercial platforms, Vignette Collection brand opportunities, distribution systems, loyalty channels and shared\-service resources.
* Prioritize Brand.com and overall direct business revenue generation, increasing direct booking contribution, improving channel profitability and reducing reliance on third\-party channels where commercially appropriate.
* Further leverage One Rewards, IHG's loyalty ecosystem and the Vignette Collection brand platform to capture direct business, drive member engagement, strengthen repeat demand and grow loyalty\-led revenue across the portfolio.
* Provide direct leadership and accountability for Sales and Marketing teams, ensuring both functions are aligned behind the hotel commercial strategy, revenue targets and brand priorities.
* Represent the hotel at asset management reviews, key client meetings, brand reviews, trade events, sales missions and commercial forums when required.


**Team Management and Performance**
* Lead, coach and develop commercial teams and relevant on\-property colleagues, creating a results\-driven and collaborative working environment.
* Set clear individual and team KPIs, monitor performance regularly and provide timely feedback, coaching and corrective action where needed.
* Build team capability through training, succession planning, best\-practice sharing and consistent commercial routines.
* Ensure strong communication and coordination between sales, revenue, marketing, reservations, events, F\&B and hotel operations teams.
* Direct the Sales Leader and Marketing Leader with clearly defined responsibilities, reporting routines, KPIs and accountability for revenue\-generating activities.


**Above\-Property and Shared\-Service Collaboration**
* Build strong and productive relationships with above\-property and shared\-service teams, including IHG/brand commercial support, revenue management, digital, distribution, reservations, loyalty, PR and marketing resources.
* Influence and coordinate shared\-service support to ensure hotel priorities are understood, actioned and measured against expected results.
* Translate above\-property initiatives into property\-level execution, ensuring hotel receives the right level of commercial focus and follow\-through.
* Escalate risks, opportunities and resources needs clearly to the Managing Director and senior leadership team.


**Business Planning, Reporting and Analysis**
* Lead and contribute to annual business planning, budgeting, forecasting and commercial reviews.
* Prepare clear commercial reports and presentations for the Managing Director, senior management and relevant stakeholders.
* Use data from PMS, CRS, RMS, CRM, sales reporting and business intelligence tools to identify trends, risks and actionable opportunities.
* Track progress against commercial plans, revenue targets, pace, pickup, conversion, account production and campaign performance.


**Operational and Stakeholder Alignment**
* Work closely with hotel operations teams to ensure commercial promises are aligned with guest experience, service delivery and operational capacity.
* Partner with food and beverage leaders to create demand, packages, promotions and partnerships that grow total revenue and enhance hotel positioning.
* Maintain strong relationships with asset management/owners, brand representatives, key clients, partners and internal stakeholders to support long\-term commercial success.


**Key Performance Indicators**
* RevPAR, ADR, occupancy and market share index performance.
* Total revenue delivery, including rooms, food and beverage, meetings and events, and ancillary revenue versus budget and forecast.
* Sales productivity, account penetration, conversion, pipeline quality and business mix improvement.
* Channel mix optimization, direct booking contribution, loyalty performance and distribution cost efficiency.
* com production, direct business revenue contribution, One Rewards and loyalty contribution, member engagement and repeat demand.
* Forecast accuracy, pricing discipline, commercial plan execution and speed of corrective action.
* Team engagement, talent development and quality of collaboration with hotel leadership and shared\-service teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Hospitality Management, Commercial Strategy, Marketing or a related field; master’s degree or relevant certification is an advantage.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive hotel commercial, sales, revenue, distribution or marketing leadership experience, including 3\-5 years in a senior commercial role.
* Proven track record of delivering RevPAR, total revenue, market share, Brand.com/direct\-channel growth, loyalty revenue and profitable commercial performance.
* Prior international chain with lifestyle brand experience is strongly preferred.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen across rooms, F\&B, groups, events, pricing, segmentation, distribution, digital/e\-commerce, CRM, brand marketing and demand generation.
* Proven ability to lead Sales and Marketing teams, with clear reporting lines, KPIs, performance routines, coaching and accountability across a multi\-property environment.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation and relationship\-building skills, with the ability to influence senior leadership, owners, brand teams, shared\-service teams, clients and partners.
* Proficiency with hotel commercial systems, including PMS, CRS, RMS, CRM, sales reporting and business intelligence tools.
* Knowledge of the Dubai/UAE hospitality market and international source markets is strongly preferred; fluent English is required and additional languages are preferred.
* Flexibility to travel and attend client meetings, industry events and commercial activities as required.

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**
 At Emirates IT, we are dedicated to staying ahead of the curve by embracing the latest technologies and strategies to streamline integration processes and enhance infrastructure efficiency. As a valued member of our team, you will play a pivotal role in managing and optimizing our integration landscape, ensuring smooth data flow and system interoperability across our enterprise platforms. If you are passionate about creating seamless integration solutions and driving technological excellence, we invite you to apply and to contribute to the success of Emirates Group.
   

  

 Join our Agile Delivery team on a mission to create technology solutions that enhance customer experience and drive revenue growth. We focus on leveraging agile methodologies to deliver innovative and secure technology quickly and efficiently. If you are passionate about delivering value, embracing agility, and leading projects in a dynamic environment, we invite you to apply and become a key player in our journey to drive success at the Emirates Group.
   

  

**The** 
**Agile Delivery Manager** 
**is responsible for planning, leading, organising and motivating scrum teams, either within a Release Train or outside, to achieve a high level of performance and quality in the delivery of outputs that provide exceptional value to end users and customers. The Agile Delivery Manager may be responsible for managing several concurrent high visibility initiatives using agile/hybrid methods, in a fast paced environment that may involve multiple business units.**
**In This Role You Will**
* Facilitate key ceremonies such as PI planning and Review, and play a consultative role to help put in place the appropriate people, process, and tools supporting the Agile framework and coaching members of the team as needed to optimize the efficiency of the Release Train team.
* Act as a Champion in blending traditional project management principles and practices with an Agile development approach in the right proportions to fit initiatives of all sizes with the appropriate level of planning and provide the right balance of agility and predictability based on PMI\-ACP principles.
* Build a trusting and safe environment where problems can be raised without fear of blame or retribution, with an emphasis on healing and problem\-solving. Protect and provide all support to the team/s using a servant leadership style whenever possible and lead by example. Facilitate getting the work done practicing servant leadership and encourage discussion, decision making and conflict resolution.
* Lead the Integrated Programme Planning (Lean Start Up). Working with portfolio teams and supporting the Technical Product Manager, drive and facilitate decomposition of Epic Roadmaps into Integrated Program backlog/plans (Features), ready for hand off into team level backlogs.
* Drive Quality and ensure the Definition of Done (DOD) is being followed; ensures each team member is fully engaged in the stories and making a meaningful contribution. Encourage a sustainable pace adhering to the agreed quality management plan with the team. Maintain an agile project management tool (e.g. ScrumDesk, JIRA, etc.).
* Assist in team development through holding teams accountable for their commitments, removing roadblocks to their work; leveraging cross functional team skills to improve product backlog throughput; and mentoring and developing team members. Attend regular stand\-ups and scrum of scrums, in order to understand the team's progress and issues, and to flag up to the team, where necessary, any important external issues of which they need to be aware.
* Supports the Technical Product Manager in managing business expectations and transparency in both product backlog and schedule for all initiatives. Supports IT Service Manager on service management, service performance and continuous improvements.
* Define and manage a well\-defined process and champion ongoing process improvement initiatives to implement best practices for Agile Delivery Management. Implement an agile governance with key ceremonies, drives continuous improvement with constant assessments of velocity (team story point throughput), defect percentage improvements etc. and also ensures that required governance and ceremonies are in place to give visibility and transparency to business stakeholders.
* Assist with the cost estimation / sizing exercise for both near term and future initiatives and assists with preparing total cost of ownership with the product team, maintains the actuals within the allocated budget and also ensure that forecasting for all the demands are accurately done for the FY.
* Together with the Product team, supports the RFx phases in the procurement process and the scheduling of such activities in relation to the product lifecycle.


 Qualification
   

  

**To be considered for the role, you must meet the below requirements:**
* Degree in Computer Science or equivalent
* Proven leadership and project delivery experience in a matrix organisation with global teams for a large organisation.
* Experience in agile delivery within the context of a large technology change programmes.


**Knowledge/skills**
* Certified SAFe and PMI ACP (additional certifications such as PMI, Prince 2, CSM desirable) with 5\+ Years of practical application of the Scrum Management discipline.
* Well\-versed in the use of tools of software delivery e.g. ServiceNow ITBM, MS OFFICE suite, JIRA, Confluence etc.
* Good architectural knowledge of large scale systems.
* Ability to effectively communicate specialist information in an understandable format to all stakeholders.
* Excellent communication skills, focusing on core scrum values of openness, honesty and respect.
* Hands\-on leader with strong people skills.


 Leadership Role: Yes
   

  

 Salary \& benefits
   

  

 Join us in Dubai and enjoy an attractive tax\-free salary and travel benefits that are exclusive to our industry, including discounts on flights and hotel stays around the world. Find out what it’s like to live and work in our fast\-paced, cosmopolitan home city in the Dubai Lifestyle section of our website www.emirates.com/careers

The role focuses on commercial execution, customer support, operational coordination, and product deployment, contributing to sustainable and profitable growth in line with regional and corporate objectives.
   

  

 The Manager partners closely with the Director – Energy \& Projects, regional leadership, and cross‑functional teams to support business development initiatives, ensure operational excellence, and maintain strong relationships with customers and service providers involved in complex Energy and Project logistics solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead and coordinate end‑to‑end execution of Energy, Oil \& Gas, and Project Cargo movements across India \& Middle East region, ensuring safety, regulatory compliance, and on‑time delivery.

data.jd_text:
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drive everything we do. The Middle East markets (UAE and Kuwait) are one of our most dynamic and competitive markets. Functions include commercial, operations, and marketing, and teams in the Middle East partner closely with global functions such as product, technology, and consumer to deliver results for our customers.
   

  

 This role sits within Operations and leads all things Rider Experience. A large and impactful scope that includes Rider community management, Rider communications, several aspects of Rider Performance, Rider Support, and Rider Onboarding. The role entails building, improving, and implementing processes across the areas above, tracking and managing efficiency and effectiveness of how we are performing across a variety of metrics, and finally ensuring that we are able to deliver excellent support to riders across the region.
   

  

**The Role**
 Operating at scale in a hyper\-competitive, hyper\-growth environment is no easy feat. As such, you'll be faced with some of the most exciting problems across the food tech space. Reporting to the Director of Operations, Middle East, you’ll have a key role in ensuring the success of the logistics network in our Middle East markets. This centers around ensuring that we always have a fleet of highly engaged, highly satisfied, and highly performing riders on our network. Working with stakeholders within Ops to find the right approach through levers like communications, education modules, and rider events. This role is regional, and will be required to build world\-class frameworks and systems that are both effective and scalable. The objective is straightforward: build the best systems to ensure riders are able to deliver the best experience for our customers and merchants.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with other members of the Middle East rider operations teams, as well as wider teams within HQ Ops, Product, and Tech to ensure the best possible outcomes for our riders, restaurants, and customers.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 Here’s what your day\-to\-day might look like:
   

  

* Managing a large team that owns and runs several processes across the scope of the team
* Building effective, scalable, and efficient frameworks and systems that can be centralized to manage and track several key metrics across our network
* Make recommendations on how to allocate our resources to ensure the best possible outcomes, for instance, managing rider churn to optimal levels to ensure best\-in\-class service levels
* Ensuring the quality and engagement of riders newly onboarded on our network is conducive to our strategy of having best\-in\-class service levels
* Track our key metrics, look for unusual trends in our data, and uncover root causes to ensure that we preserve the health of the network.
* Work alongside other members of the Middle East Rider Operations team to ensure that we operate to budget
* Provide regular, relevant, concise updates on rider experience to senior business stakeholders.


**What You'll Need To Thrive**
 Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
   

  

* A high standard of university\-level education
* 8\+ years of experience in program management, consulting, banking, engineering, or a high\-growth start\-up
* Excellent problem\-solving skills – experience solving tough, complex problems
* An ownership mindset that means you know what is happening in your area of responsibility
* Experience managing a multi\-functional team
* Experience building scalable processes, tools, and structured change methodologies, and therefore enjoying working in a process\-driven environment
* Strong analytical mindset and comfortable with large data sets
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
* Comfortable handling multiple workstreams at the same time, working both individually and as part of a team


**Why Join Us?**
 At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real\-world problems in a three\-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.
   

  

 We’re Food Lovers, Problem Solvers, Community Builders, And More, Brought Together By a Shared Drive To Make Things Better. Working Here, You Can Expect To
   

  

**🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale** 
 Work on a complex, always\-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.
   

  

 🌱
 **See your impact, fast** 
 Ship, test, and improve ideas quickly in a low\-hierarchy, high\-ownership
   

  

 environment.
   

  

**🧠Grow through challenge and ownership** 
 Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.
   

  

**🌎A culture built for builders** 
 High standards, collaboration, flexible working, and continuous learning.
   

  

 We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3\-4 stages. Find more about how we hire
 **here.**
**Our Global Structure**
 Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
   

  

**Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**
 At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
   

  

 We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio\-economic background, religion, or belief.
   

  

 If you have a disability or long\-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.
   

  

 If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast\-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

data.jd_text:
At Lummus Technology, innovation thrives, and excellence is a shared pursuit. When you join Lummus, you are empowered to make an impact and be part of a dynamic team that celebrates creativity, encourages professional development, and fosters collaboration.
   

  

 From our technology portfolio to our global workforce, Lummus is growing at a rapid pace, and we hope that you will grow with us during this exciting time.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants International (LCI) is an autonomous business within Lummus Technology that provides technical, environmental \& social and management consulting services worldwide. We work primarily in the energy industry, with a depth of expertise in power generation, oil \& gas, refining and petrochemicals. We maintain a very strong presence in the international technical due diligence markets to support the global financial industry. LCI has a far\-reaching organization with offices in the United States, UK, the Middle East and Asia.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants is looking for a Business Development Director to grow the company into the area of technical and management consulting in the energy industry – offshore and onshore oil \& gas, LNG, pipelines, power generation and transmission, as well as refining and petrochemicals. This role will be expected to help grow the consulting practice area in the fields of oil\& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization and will primarily entail growing relationships with the financial community and project developers. Assignments require a high level of experience and ability to focus quickly on important issues.
   

  

 The individual we are seeking must be comfortable and confident to work in a seller/doer organization structure.
   

  

**Position**
 The Business Development Director will be expected to grow and lead a new consulting practice area in the fields of Oil \& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization. The group VP and the Leadership Team should have contacts and skills to help him achieve this goal. An international focus is expected. Areas of skill and knowledge should include knowledge of project financing, capex benchmarking analysis, O\&M practices and costs, M\&A support, due diligence and strategy development. The candidate will be expected to lead and participate in advisory assignments, conduct business development, and manage his/her practice business area and interface with Lummus Consultants’ senior management. Additional business areas may be identified based upon the candidate’s personal history and strengths and interests.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities**
* Grow Lummus Consultants’ business – in cooperation with the existing business heads. His growth strategy should be heavily focused on technical solutions but with a broad business perspective beyond traditional due diligence assignments.
* Develop a business plan to capitalize on existing talents and resources within Lummus Consultants and Lummus Technology; the candidate’s strengths; and market opportunities.
* Grow name recognition of Lummus Consultants in all Energy industry segments (with assistance from the Lummus Communication team and other internal resources).
* Carry out business development, marketing, and proposal preparation efforts and lead Key Account Management teams efforts.
* Lead or participate in consulting project work.
* Prepare clear and concise written reports on assignments, develop conclusions and present clear and precise written and verbal results to clients.
* Expand the Lummus Consulting practice area (globally), consistent with the business plan – identify gaps in skills and potential recruits.
* Achieve objectives with minimal oversight.
* Management of the P\&L forecast by close collaboration with his supervisor and finance.
* Report to Senior Director of Lummus Consultants in Dubai office.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Required**
* Strong leadership abilities and excellent interpersonal skills
* Strong communicator with excellent written and oral communication skills
* Must have a high degree of self\-motivation and energy
* Must have proven ability to manage business forecasting, short and long term projection
* Capability of earning respect from the team and capable of influencing others without authority
* Excellent professional image/presentation
* Knowledge of many cultures/international style
* Strong commercial savvy and negotiating skills
* Interest in being knowledgeable in all services offerings in Lummus Consultants portfolio
* Ability to work well with finance partners.
* Must have a strong balance of technical and commercial capabilities.


**Basic Qualifications**
* A degree\-educated Engineer; MBA is a plus but not required.
* The candidate should have at least 20 years relevant professional experience.
* Prior experience with an owner/operator or major engineering company and/or consultancy.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including ability to write clear and concise reports in English.
* The candidate should have strong interpersonal skills and be comfortable conversing with clients and senior management
* Demonstrated management and project management skills


**Office Location and Travel:**
* Dubai office. Relocation is not being offered.
* Job\-related travel (business trips usually requiring less than a two\-week duration; often just one or two days) which includes international travel to financial institutions in London, is an important part of the work. Time away from the office may average 10 to 30 percent of work hours.


 Lummus Technology is the global leader in developing technology solutions that make modern life possible and focus on a more sustainable, low carbon future. We license process technologies in clean fuels, renewables, petrochemicals, polymers, gas processing and supply lifecycle services, catalysts, proprietary equipment and digitalization to customers worldwide.

data.raw_snippet:
**Deliveroo: A DoorDash Company:**
