**Job Description**
 Pattern is a leading eCommerce accelerator with offices across the globe offering outsourced marketplace and ecommerce management services for brands worldwide. The Pattern Ecommerce Acceleration Platform leverages AI\-powered technology, industry expertise, and global distribution, logistics, and fulfilment services to help quality brands scale profitably on their own websites and through hundreds of marketplaces. Pattern works with some of the most recognized brands such as Thorne, Naturelo, Marshall, Nutricost, MegaFood, TIGI, Hair Burst and Sage and it ranks among the top 5 Amazon sellers globally.
   

  

 Pattern is expanding and we are looking for an experienced Ecommerce expert to join our MENA Team in Dubai to support the scaling of the business by driving the performance of the brands we represent on Amazon and other Marketplaces.
   

  

 You will own the relationship and financial performance of a portfolio of global brands managing their performance across marketplaces here in MENA. You will support the Associate Director of eCommercewith defining and implementing the E2E growth and profitability plan for your portfolio of brands by working cross\-functionally with Operations, Content, Advertising, Creative, Merchandising and Finance. You will also lead cross\-functional projects to implement processes to scale the organisation in MENA. You will be a strategic and commercial ecommerce professional who can engage partners and internal stakeholders towards a common goal. You will have a growth mindset and love navigating the challenges of working in fast changing landscapes.
   

  

**The core responsibilities of the eCommerce Manager reflect the following**
* Drive revenue growth on marketplaces across MENA through a data\-driven approach across a portfolio of brands through B2B and D2C marketplaces.
* Ensure that a clear activity plan is in place to achieve and surpass the budget targets, including promotional planning, seasonal phasing, NPD launches, advertising campaigns etc.
* Define the strategy and joint business plan with our brands to create mutually beneficial sales and marketing plans which grow market share.
* Represent your brands brilliantly across Marketplaces through best\-in\-class product content, including but not limited to images, enhanced content, keyword SEO, local language translation, advertising campaigns etc.
* Conduct analysis of brands performance using multiple data sources and tools on a regular basis to ensure that performance is continuously optimised across all touch points.
* Manage inventory, working alongside our merchandisers to maintain a healthy pipeline
* .Establish and maintain relationships with appropriate client partners, providing day\-to\-day contact on project status and changes.
* Have a passion for continuous improvement and building and automating processes.


**What will I need to thrive in this role?﻿**
* Demonstrated success in managing an ecommerce business
* 2\-5 years experience in an ecommerce role
* Strong academic background (2:1 or above)
* Previous experience managing and growing 3P business on Marketplaces (Amazon and Noon)
* Creative thinker and problem solver
* Highly organized and disciplined
* Willing to be nimble and adaptable to change
* Able to work under pressure and manage workloads effectively
* Arabic fluency preferred to facilitate communication with local market clients

**Game Changers** 
 \- A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern’s processes and outcomes.
   

  

**Data Fanatics** 
 \- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data.
   

  

**Partner Obsessed** 
 \- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner’s expectations and delivers results that exceed them, prioritises the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern.
   

  

**Team of Doers** 
 \- Someone who is a part of team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners.

data.jd_text:
The First Group Hospitality is a Dubai\-headquartered, full\-service hospitality management company specialising in hotel operations, asset management, and F\&B strategy. With a team of industry veterans and a proven track record, the company delivers tailored solutions that enhance efficiency, optimise revenue, and maximise asset value for investors and hotel owners.
   

  

 As a trusted third\-party hotel management provider, The First Group Hospitality partners with leading global brands to drive operational excellence and long\-term profitability, thanks to expertise spanning property performance optimisation, cost management, and guest experience enhancement.
   

  

 Beyond management, The First Group Hospitality develops and operates a dynamic portfolio of upscale hotels, residences, and award\-winning restaurants, creating high\-value hospitality assets that stand out in the market. For more information, visit tfghospitality.com
   

  

 The Director of Revenue Management is responsible for maximizing revenue growth and optimizing profitability across all revenue\-generating channels in the hotel. This role entails setting and executing pricing strategies, managing inventory, and analyzing market data to drive revenue performance. The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker with deep analytical expertise and a strong understanding of market trends, customer behavior, and distribution channels.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
- Strategic Revenue Management

* Develop and implement revenue management strategies and pricing models to maximize room revenue and market share.
* Conduct regular revenue analysis and forecasting to inform business decisions and strategic planning.
* Monitor competitive market trends and adjust pricing strategies as necessary to maintain a competitive edge.


- Inventory and Pricing Control

* Oversee the distribution and management of room inventory across all booking channels.
* Set room rates, packages, and promotions based on forecasted demand, market conditions, and competitive intelligence.
* Manage and optimize distribution channels, including OTAs, brand website, GDS, and other online and offline channels.


- Performance Analysis

* Track, analyze, and report on key revenue metrics, including RevPAR, ADR, occupancy, and market share.
* Regularly review and interpret revenue performance reports to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
* Present findings and recommendations to senior management to support revenue and profitability goals.


- Cross\-Departmental Collaboration

* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Reservations, and Operations teams to align revenue strategies with overall business goals.
* Provide training and guidance to sales and front office teams on revenue management principles and upselling techniques.
* Work closely with marketing teams to develop promotions and campaigns that drive occupancy and ADR.


- Technology and Systems Management

* Utilize revenue management software (e.g., RMS, CRS, PMS) to manage data and make data\-driven decisions.
* Oversee the implementation and maintenance of technology solutions that support revenue management processes.
* Ensure data integrity and accuracy in revenue management systems and processes.


- Market Intelligence

* Conduct ongoing competitive analysis, including pricing, positioning, and market trends.
* Keep abreast of industry changes, new technologies, and best practices in revenue management.
* Develop market segmentation and customer profiling strategies to enhance targeting and pricing precision.


- Budgeting and Forecasting

* Lead the annual budgeting and forecasting process for all revenue streams, including rooms, F\&B, and ancillary services.
* Ensure that revenue targets align with overall financial goals and provide regular updates on performance against budget.
* Identify opportunities to increase incremental revenue through upsell programs and ancillary offerings.
* Bachelor’s degree in hospitality management, Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or a related field
* Minimum 7\-10 years of experience in Revenue Management within the hospitality industry
* At least 3\-5 years in a leadership or multi\-property revenue management role
* Strong knowledge of hotel distribution channels, pricing strategies, and market segmentation
* Experience working with major hotel PMS, RMS, CRS, and channel management systems.
* Proven track record of driving RevPAR, ADR, and occupancy growth Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret and act on complex data sets.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present to senior management and influence key stakeholders.

**Fund Sales Business Development Director** 




**Dubai, UAE** 




**Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week** 




**Hybrid** 









**Intro:** 




 The Fund Sales Business Development Director (BDD) is responsible for originating and winning new fund services business across the United Arab Emirates, with a primary focus on the fund management community. Working closely with colleagues across Sales, Markets, and Global Financial Solutions, you will build pipelines, lead the end\-to\-end sales cycle, and convert opportunities into long\-term client relationships. You will represent CSC® externally with fund managers, asset managers, financial institutions, and key referral partners such as law firms and professional services firms. This role is suited to a high\-energy “hunter” with a strong network and a consistent track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
 



  





**Some of the things you’ll be doing:** 



* Proactively originate, qualify, and win new fund sales opportunities across the UAE.
* Build and maintain a strong referral network with external business partners (including law firms and professional services firms), deepening existing relationships and unlocking new referral sources.
* Lead the full sales cycle from prospecting to close, including discovery, solution positioning, presentations, deal management, follow\-ups, and negotiation.
* Collaborate with Global Financial Solutions and Markets teams to position CSC’s product suite, including fund administration, SPV services, depositary, AIFM, and strategic outsourcing solutions.
* Develop account and territory plans, including go\-to\-market activity plans, aligned to revenue targets and strategic priorities.
* Coordinate and contribute to proposals and RFP responses in partnership with the Funds Market team and other subject matter experts.
* Conduct deal\-by\-deal risk assessment and ensure new opportunities meet internal governance, regulatory expectations, and commercial criteria.
* Monitor market and competitor trends and provide actionable insights to support commercial strategy and growth planning.
* Represent CSC at client meetings, industry forums, conferences, and seminars to promote brand visibility and generate pipeline.
* Use sales tools and technology (e.g., Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Preqin or similar platforms) to manage pipeline, forecasting, activity tracking, and reporting.








**What technical skills, experience, and qualifications do you need?** 



* Demonstrated success in a business development / sales role with consistent achievement against quotas or revenue targets (new business acquisition focus).
* Experience selling to, or within, the fund management community (e.g., fund managers, asset managers, financial institutions) or selling closely related financial services solutions into that client base.
* Strong network within the fund management community and ability to build referral channels with law firms and professional services partners.
* Proven ability to run complex, consultative sales cycles, coordinate internal stakeholders, and close deals.
* Strong commercial judgement, negotiation skills, and ability to assess opportunity risk and fit.
* Proficiency with CRM and sales enablement tools, including Salesforce (or similar), with disciplined pipeline management and forecasting.



  





**Preferred Qualifications:** 



* Knowledge of fund servicing models and products such as fund administration, depositary, AIFM, SPVs, or strategic outsourcing.
* Existing partner relationships across the UAE fund management community.
* Experience selling regulated services and navigating governance, compliance, and risk review processes during onboarding.
* Strong presentation skills and experience representing an organisation at industry events and conferences.








**A typical career progression** 
 path could look like: Business Development Director → Senior Business Development Director / Sales Leader → Regional Sales Head / Commercial Director (Funds).
 



 Cross\-functional opportunities: pathways into Product Strategy, Funds Market Leadership, Key Account Management, or broader Global Financial Solutions commercial leadership roles.
 



 Compensation: competitive salary plus a commission plan aligned to individual performance and revenue outcomes (details discussed during the interview process), with access to CSC benefits and additional incentives as applicable.
 



  





**Why work with CSC?** 




 At CSC®, we’re always looking ahead, finding ways to improve and anticipate the future needs of our customers. Curiosity fuels our innovation and productivity drives our results. This proactive mindset has helped us adapt and create solutions that have enabled businesses to run smoother and smarter for more than 120 years.
 



 CSC is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining talented people whose personal values align with ours. We empower our employees to bring the right solutions to market to meet customer demand. That is why we are the premier provider of global solutions for more than 180,000 businesses.
 



  




* CSC is a great place to work with smart and dedicated people.
* We have been voted a Top Workplace every year since 2006\.
* We offer challenging work and career opportunities. Most positions are filled with internal moves and employee referrals.
* Employees are eligible for success sharing, bonus, or commission plans based on role and individual performance.
* CSC offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package as part of your Total Rewards that includes annual leave, tuition reimbursement, employee referral bonuses, and more.



  





**About us** 




 CSC is a global business, legal, and financial services company based in Wilmington, Delaware, USA, providing knowledge\-based solutions to clients worldwide. We have offices and capabilities in over 140 jurisdictions in the Americas, Europe, Asia Pacific, and the Middle East, and more than 8,000 colleagues. We are the business behind business.®

CSC offers challenging career opportunities and excellent benefits, including annual success\-sharing bonuses or commission plans based on individual performance. To learn more, visit cscglobal.com/service/careers.
 



  





 Visit our careers site to learn more about CSC and our commitment to our clients, communities, and each other.

data.jd_text:
* About the position The Technical Engineer is responsible for supervising the delivery of technical maintenance and hard services across assigned client sites, ensuring that locations are maintained and operated in line with the agreed maintenance strategy, client requirements, statutory obligations, and CBRE standards.
* Decision Making Authority


**This Position Has The Authority To**
* Technical Maintenance Delivery


 Supervise day\-to\-day technical maintenance and hard services activities across assigned client sites.
   

  

 Ensure planned preventive maintenance and reactive maintenance activities are completed safely, on time, and in accordance with the agreed service levels, KPIs, and client requirements.
   

  

 Support delivery of a cost\-effective maintenance plan that protects assets, reduces business interruption risk, and supports a safe and comfortable working environment.
   

  

 Monitor workload, vendor capacity, site resources, and open technical issues, escalating concerns and recommending changes where required.
   

  

* Technical Site Inspections \& Risk Management


 Conduct regular technical site inspections to identify MEP, building services, operational, compliance, and asset condition risks.
   

  

 Identify defects, recurring faults, business\-critical risks, and maintenance gaps, and recommend practical corrective actions or improvement plans.
   

  

 Support root\-cause review of recurring technical failures and help drive preventative actions to reduce repeat issues and unnecessary invasive maintenance.
   

  

 Escalate critical technical risks, safety concerns, or potential service interruptions to the Facilities Manager / Account Lead.
   

  

* Work Order \& Maintenance System Management


 Monitor open work orders and ensure timely updates, evidence upload, escalation, and closure.
   

  

 Support the implementation and ongoing use of Chase or other CAFM / work order management systems.
   

  

 Ensure maintenance records, job cards, completion notes, service reports, photos, permits, and supporting evidence are accurately captured and maintained.
   

  

 Reduce reliance on manual Excel trackers by improving system\-based reporting, visibility, and accountability.
   

  

* Vendor, Subcontractor \& Service Partner Management


 Coordinate with subcontractors, third\-party vendors, and specialist service providers for planned, reactive, and small works activities.
   

  

 Monitor vendor performance, response times, quality of work, statutory compliance, and value for money.
   

  

 Validate completion of subcontractor works before closure, approval, or escalation.
   

  

 Support technical scoping, quotation review, and follow\-through for remedial works, minor projects, relocations, equipment handling, and lifecycle\-related improvements.
   

  

 Ensure service providers hold the required professional qualifications, permits, RAMS, licenses, and service documentation where applicable.
   

  

* Compliance, HSSE \& Statutory Requirements


 Ensure all technical works comply with statutory requirements, client standards, CBRE procedures, and site HSSE rules.
   

  

 Promote a strong safety culture and ensure unsafe practices, non\-compliance, or flagrant violations are escalated appropriately.
   

  

 Support site teams with permits to work, RAMS, isolation requirements, compliance certificates, service records, and audit evidence.
   

  

 Assist with closure of technical, safety, and compliance\-related findings.
   

  

* Team Support, Training \& Continuous Improvement


 Provide technical guidance and practical support to Facilities Coordinators, site teams, and vendors.
   

  

 Support competency reviews, identify technical training needs, and help uplift site\-based maintenance capability.
   

  

 Share best practice and recommend improved maintenance techniques, operational controls, and service delivery solutions.
   

  

 Build strong working relationships with internal teams, clients, vendors, and support functions.
   

  

* Reporting, Budget Awareness \& Client Support


 Provide regular updates on technical issues, open works, risks, defects, PPM progress, reactive performance, and action plans.
   

  

 Support account leads with technical input for client meetings, operational reviews, business cases, and reporting packs.
   

  

 Provide technical input into monthly reports, budget variance commentary, discretionary spend visibility, and maintenance improvement recommendations where required.
   

  

 Perform other duties as reasonably assigned by the line manager.
   

  

* Experience / Education Diploma, trade qualification, recognised apprenticeship, ONC / equivalent, or technical certification in Mechanical, Electrical, HVAC, Building Services, Facilities Management, or a related discipline. Minimum 5 years' experience in facilities management, building services, MEP, technical maintenance, or hard services delivery. Previous experience supervising technical teams, subcontractors, or specialist service providers is preferred. Experience in planned preventive maintenance, reactive maintenance, statutory compliance, asset management, and work order systems. Experience conducting technical site inspections and identifying MEP, building services, safety, and operational risks. Experience coordinating vendors, reviewing technical quotations, validating service reports, and following through on remedial works. Experience in a client\-facing FM environment. Knowledge of HSE requirements, permits to work, RAMS, statutory compliance documentation, and audit evidence is preferred.
* Skills Required Strong technical knowledge across MEP, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire/life safety, and general building systems. Strong technical inspection, fault\-identification, and root\-cause problem\-solving capability. Ability to supervise technical maintenance activities and coordinate multiple vendors across several sites. Ability to prioritise workload and maintain a safe, compliant, and effective operating environment. Ability to develop practical technical solutions, site improvement recommendations, and business case inputs. Good CAFM / work order system capability, including job updates, evidence upload, reporting, and closure discipline. Strong vendor management and contractor coordination skills. Strong communication skills with site teams, vendors, clients, and management. Good report writing, business writing, and Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, and digital tracking systems. Proactive, detail\-oriented, service\-focused, and solution\-driven. Ability to coach and support site teams to improve technical standards and maintenance discipline. Strong safety awareness and commitment to compliance, quality, and client satisfaction.
* Knowledge Required Integrated facilities management and hard services delivery. MEP systems, building services infrastructure, and maintenance best practice. PPM planning, reactive maintenance, asset condition assessment, and lifecycle risk identification. Work order management / CAFM systems, preferably Chase or similar platforms. SLA / KPI management and technical service delivery standards. Vendor coordination, subcontractor control, quotation review, service report validation, and value\-for\-money principles. HSE standards, permits to work, RAMS, compliance records, statutory maintenance requirements, and audit evidence. Maintenance strategy, asset protection, business continuity risk, and prevention of service disruption. Basic budget awareness, discretionary spend controls, and cost\-effective maintenance delivery. Client account structures, site operating requirements, cost centres, and escalation routes.


**Competencies Required**
 Communication, Team leadership, Customer and quality focus, Problem solving and decision making, Accountability, Planning and organising, Drive and productivity, Collaboration
   

  

* Company Values Respect; Integrity; Service; Excellence; Accountability; Collaboration; Transformation
* Major Drivers of Work Volume The major drivers of work volume are planned preventive maintenance, reactive work orders, technical inspections, asset condition issues, vendor coordination, statutory compliance, HSSE requirements, service reports, open work order management, small works / remedial works, client reporting, SLA / KPI performance, and the implementation of structured maintenance processes across the portfolio.
* Interface / Relationships With Internal: Facilities Coordinators, Facilities Managers, Account Leads, Operations Managers, Middle East Operations Director, Procurement, Finance/AP, HSE, P\&A, IT, Regional Operations, and on\-site client stakeholders. External: Clients, landlords/building management teams, subcontractors, specialist service providers, suppliers, auditors, statutory authorities where applicable, and project\-related stakeholders.


**Working environment / Special factors**
 The incumbent will work across client sites and office environments, with regular site\-based inspections required to support technical delivery, vendor management, compliance, and maintenance performance. Normal working hours will apply as per client and operational requirements; however, flexibility may be required to support urgent technical issues, planned shutdowns, audits, emergency works, or client/project requirements.

**Description**
**About Alvarez \& Marsal**
 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with over 11,000 entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A\&M.
   

  

**The Team**
 The Infrastructure and Capital Projects (Infra) team focuses on improving return on investment capital and reducing the risks specific to capital projects. The Infra team is built on deep industry sector expertise with a demonstrably differentiated ability to address the most complex business problems and by supporting our owner/operator/contractor clients with the expertise of our deep project, Alvarez \& Marsal's ultimate goal is to reduce the level of uncertainty associated with the development and operational costs of your projects, contributing to greater shareholder value drawn from procurement through execution and asset management through different solutions.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute**
 A\&M continues to expand in EMEA, and we are looking to recruit a Director \& Senior Director to be based in our Riyadh office. Working with some of the industry's brightest and most experienced colleagues, you will:
   

  

* Lead the execution of project workstreams, demonstrating expertise and identifying opportunities for process improvement within the assigned tasks.
* Conduct meetings and presentations with clients, as well as internal managerial and executive stakeholders, showcasing proficiency and confidence in discussing project matters.
* Collaborate with teams and clients, engaging in negotiations and fostering effective partnerships between leadership.
* Develop and nurture client relationships, seeking to understand their needs and contributing to their satisfaction.
* Participate in industry events and associations to broaden professional connections and identify potential growth avenues.
* Contribute to the identification and pursuit of new business prospects, aligned with the strategic goals of Infra and other Business Units.
* Drive project analyses, propose actionable plans, and exhibit strong decision\-making capabilities.
* Demonstrate leadership qualities while effectively guiding project delivery.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or master’s degree in business administration, Engineering, or a related field.
* Proven experience in project management and business development, ideally within consulting or related industries.
* 8\+ years experience within public sector large scale projects experience is necessary.
* Arabic language skills is required
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, capable of articulating ideas to diverse audiences.
* Willingness to travel as required.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze complex situations and develop solutions, emphasizing creativity and critical thinking.
* Self\-starter with strong business acumen and a results\-driven approach.
* Ability to adapt and thrive in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.
* Collaborative and team\-oriented mindset.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills for interactions with senior management, clients, and colleagues.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with ambition and risk appetite.
* Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Developing client management skills and aptitude for business development and negotiation.
* Thrives in a high\-energy, fast\-paced, and dynamic culture.


**Your journey at A\&M**
 We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career.
   

  

 We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.
   

  

 Inclusive Diversity
   

  

 A\&M’s entrepreneurial culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who can positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A\&M’s core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are the main reasons our people love working at A\&M. Inclusive Diversity means we embrace diversity, and we foster inclusiveness, encouraging everyone to bring their whole self to work each day. It runs through how we recruit, develop employees, conduct business, support clients, and partner with vendors. It is the A\&M way.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity Employer
   

  

 It is Alvarez \& Marsal’s practice to provide and promote equal opportunity in employment, compensation, and other terms and conditions of employment without discrimination because of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, sex or gender, gender identity or gender expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, family medical history, genetic information or other protected medical condition, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected by and in accordance with applicable laws. Employees and Applicants can find A\&M policy statements and additional information by region here.
   

  

 Unsolicited Resumes from Third\-Party Recruiters
   

  

 Please note that as per A\&M policy, we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third\-party recruiters unless such recruiters are engaged to provide candidates for a specified opening. Any employment agency, person or entity that submits an unsolicited resume does so with the understanding that A\&M will have the right to hire that applicant at its discretion without any fee owed to the submitting employment agency, person or entity.

data.jd_text:
Who We Are
   

  

 At Inverto in Riyadh, we’re defining what’s next in procurement and supply chain—driven by ambition, precision, and impact. With the strength of BCG behind us and a sharp entrepreneurial mindset at our core, we partner with leading global organizations to deliver strategies that create lasting value.
   

  

 Our people are central to that mission. As experts who move with intent and momentum, we continually invest in developing our capabilities, expanding our reach, and scaling our impact. Growth at Inverto is shared growth\-opening new opportunities for our clients, our business, and our teams.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 The Business \& Operations Senior Manager drives the effective operationalization of Inverto’s regional growth agenda by leading key commercial, people, financial, and operational processes for the Middle East.
   

  

 Acting as a strategic partner to Inverto leadership and EMESA teams, the role ensures transparency in business development activities, enables strong go\-to\-market execution, and supports high\-quality decision\-making through robust performance and financial management. It plays a central role in shaping and sustaining talent and team development, driving a cohesive and high\-performing culture, and ensuring optimal staffing and resource allocation.
   

  

 The position also safeguards operational excellence by strengthening cross\-functional collaboration with BCG Core and Inverto EMESA, ensuring reliable data flow, and securing compliance with governance, legal, and internal standards. Additionally, it oversees local office operations and orchestrates shared services and marketing initiatives to enable seamless delivery and reinforce Inverto’s brand presence in the region.
   

  

 A key aspect of the role is ensuring alignment between BCG core and Inverto\-specific requirements, in accordance with Inverto’s global guardrails, and business model.
   

  

 Overall, the role is critical in enabling the Middle East business to operate effectively, grow sustainably, and achieve its strategic objectives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead Management and GTM support
* Partner with Inverto Managing Directors, Principals, and Inverto EMESA to operationalize the Inverto growth plan and operating model by translating strategic priorities into actionable initiatives and effective execution
* Liaise with the Inverto Business Excellence team and local Inverto leadership to ensure full transparency in the BD pipeline, including tool management / data accuracy, process alignment, and effective governance of local Inverto leads
* Enable commercial success by creating visibility into local platforms (e.g., local BCG lead calls), synthesizing insights, and supporting senior stakeholders with actionable steering information
* People \& Talent Management
* Drive optimal team deployment and resource allocation in close collaboration with the Inverto EMESA team, ensuring sustained delivery capacity and alignment with business needs
* Shape the Middle East hiring strategy jointly with Inverto EMESA and local recruiting teams, contributing to the attraction and retention of top consulting talent and enhancing the effectiveness of selection processes
* Coordinate and improve professional development initiatives \- including career development, training, retention, and team affiliation \- liaising with EMESA team
* Lead local people\-related initiatives that strengthen team cohesion and organizational culture
* Ensure smooth HR operations and benefits implementation in collaboration with local HR teams
* Support driving the Teaming process in partnership with Inverto’s central Teaming Team, ensuring effectiveness and continuous improvement.
* Financial Planning \& Performance Management
* Collaborate with Finance teams to steer annual strategic and financial planning processes, ensuring alignment between functional priorities and financial targets
* Ensure rigorous budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting, translating data into insights and recommendations for senior leadership
* Liaise with Inverto and BCG Finance teams to ensure accurate cost accounting and P\&L management against Plan
* Support Inverto Commercial Finance in maintaining full transparency of the project portfolio, enabling informed decision\-making on performance and risk management
* Collaboration \& Data flow
* Maintain strong and effective collaboration with BCG Core and Inverto EMESA teams (BST, HR, IT, etc.), enhancing cross\-functional processes and ensuring smooth operational integration
* Ensure reliable information and data flow between Inverto Middle East and Inverto EMESA, including oversight of non\-automated processes and adherence to data governance standards
* Risk Management \& Compliance Coordination
* Support governance, risk management, and compliance efforts by ensuring alignment of local operations with Inverto EMESA and BCG Core requirements, while proactively identifying improvement areas
* Ensure compliance with legal standards and internal policies, implementing effective local controls and maintaining transparency on regulatory updates
* Establish processes to systematically gather and synthesize up\-to\-date information on relevant compliance regulations
* Local Coordination \& Office Enablement
* Oversee day\-to\-day office operations of the Inverto team and act as a key point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, ensuring smooth and efficient business operations
* Coordinate shared services and functions (e.g., HR, Recruiting, IT) with BCG where applicable, optimizing processes to support local delivery
* Drive local marketing initiatives and ensure consistent execution of campaigns in alignment with global teams (Global Inverto Marketing and Global Employer Branding), maintaining a unified and compelling brand presence


 What You'll Bring
   

  

 Bachelors or Masters degree with an above\-average grade.
   

  

 8\+ years of relevant experience within business operations
   

  

 Confident presence in an international environment, business fluent in English.
   

  

 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 Reporting to the Inverto Managing Director
   

  

 Working with global, regional and local teams
   

  

 Hyper motivated individuals
   

  

 Entrepreneurs and those that have a growth mindset
   

  

 Teammates that are authentic by nature, they thrive to support the team to win
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.
   

  

 BCG is an E \- Verify Employer. Click here for more information on E\-Verify.

**Role Overview :**
 webook.com is looking for a Director of Strategy to establish and lead the company's Strategy Management Office (SMO). Reporting directly to the Chief Strategy Officer, this role will work closely with executive leadership and key stakeholders across the business.
   

  

 This position is suited for someone who enjoys building functions from the ground up, creating structure in fast\-moving environments, and driving strategic initiatives from concept through execution.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy Management Office**
* Establish and lead the SMO, including governance models, planning processes, OKR structures, KPI reporting, and executive dashboards
* Coordinate quarterly business reviews and strategic planning cycles
* Track execution of company\-wide strategic initiatives and ensure accountability across departments
* Develop reporting frameworks for executive leadership and board visibility


**Corporate Strategy \& Expansion**
* Support the development and execution of corporate strategy across existing and future markets
* Build market assessment and expansion frameworks for international growth opportunities
* Lead cross\-functional strategic initiatives and monitor delivery against targets


**Investments \& Strategic Partnerships**
* Partner with the investments team on evaluating acquisitions, partnerships, and venture opportunities
* Support commercial and strategic due diligence processes
* Assist with integration planning and post\-deal execution where required
* Develop frameworks for assessing strategic fit and long\-term value creation


**Executive \& Board Engagement**
* Prepare board materials, strategic presentations, and investor\-facing narratives
* Support communication with institutional shareholders and strategic stakeholders
* Provide strategic analysis and recommendations to senior leadership


 Team Leadership
   

  

* Lead and develop members of the strategy team
* Strengthen internal capabilities across strategic planning, execution management, and analytical problem\-solving
* Foster a high\-performance and ownership\-driven culture within the function


**Requirements**
* 8\-12 years of experience in strategy, corporate development, transformation, or a related field
* Experience building or leading a Strategy Management Office or similar strategic execution function
* Demonstrated ability to drive initiatives from strategy through implementation and measurable business outcomes
* Background within high\-growth, scale\-up, PE\-backed, VC\-backed, or pre\-IPO environments

* Experience preparing and presenting materials for senior executives or boards
* Fluent in both Arabic and English


**Preferred Background**
* Experience in live events, entertainment, sports, marketplaces, or consumer technology
* Familiarity with the Saudi and broader MENA business landscape
* Exposure to international expansion across multiple markets


**Why Join webook.com**
* Opportunity to shape strategy at one of the region's most prominent growth\-stage companies
* Direct exposure to executive leadership, institutional shareholders, and board\-level decision\-making
* Ability to build and define a strategic function from the ground up
* Fast\-paced environment with significant regional and international growth ambitions


**This Role May Not Be Suitable For**
* Candidates whose experience is primarily advisory or consulting\-based without operational ownership
* Individuals who have supported strategy functions but not directly led execution
* Candidates who rely heavily on established structures and processes rather than building them
* Limited exposure to executive stakeholder management

**Description**
**Job Purpose:**
 To manage the overall complete company financial and operational performance of the respective areas of responsibility as per the guidelines given by Chief Executive Officer. To ensure strict adherence to the scope of work detailed in the terms and conditions of the contract under the individual’s management. Ensure that strict cost control systems are established in all departments in the operation, and that they are constantly maintained and monitored. To ensure that storage and stock control systems are maintained up to date, and to monitor stock rotation and validity. To ensure that company and Client owned assets and equipment are maintained in good order, and that repair/replenishment costs are strictly controlled.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities And Duties**
* To ensure that the contract is operated within the budgetary margins established for the operation.
* To maintain constant liaison with the Client representative for the individual’s operation and establish a good working relationship.
* To monitor ordering of all supplies/requirements both internally on site and from the supplier.
* To ensure that validity of all employee documentation, e.g. security passes, medical certificates, licenses, vacations where applicable, are maintained and that timely action is taken for renewal that will not adversely affect the individual’s operation.
* To ensure employee time sheets are correctly filled in and that they are forwarded to Head Office on time each month.
* To liaise with Training Department for Staff Trainings.
* To conduct job training on the individual’s operations.
* To carry out annual evaluations of staff. Make recommendations for employee promotions, salary changes, employee of the month, disciplinary action, including termination where applicable.
* To ensure that employees are aware of the company policies and procedures and to ensure compliance.
* To ensure that the individual is aware of the contents of the KSA labor Law, and its stipulations regarding disciplinary action in particular.
* To ensure that leave schedules are maintained, and that requests for relievers are submitted to CEO at least two months in advance.
* To ensure strict confidentiality of all company financial information regardless of its nature.
* To compile and submit to CEO monthly reports on all aspects of the operations that should highlight any problems encountered and actions taken to rectify them.
* This report should cover maintenance activities, including both planned and reactive tasks, which are completed within required timeframes, on\-going or new projects information, supplier communications and enhancement schemes for the cost\-effective management of services.
* To ensure that copies of all Client correspondence, minutes of site meetings and any other communication (verbal or written) pertained to the operation are transmitted to the CEO immediately upon acknowledgment.
* The CEO must review on all offers to the Client prior to submittal. Site Engineers, where applicable, must be involved in offers pertaining to anything within the individual’s discipline.
* To ensure that company and Client owned assets and equipment are maintained in good order, and that repair/replenishment costs are strictly controlled. CEO must be informed of any major R\&M activity.
* To ensure that highest standards of health, hygiene and safety are maintained in the individual’s operation and to liaise closely with the company’s CEO on these matters.
* Closely monitor the performance of all the department heads.
* Adhere to the safety regulations set by the company as well as the Client.
* Provide on monthly basis with a safety statistic report for the individual’s entire operation.
* Liaise with the Client on all matters related to Safety.
* Conduct safety meetings with all the department heads and establish a safety committee to closely monitor and update management on safety matters.
* To perform any other duties requested by the CEO out of the normal routine but within the scope of work.
* The individual is fully responsible and accountable for the HSE policies and procedures, which are in place.
* To conform to the Company’s guidelines related to the area as detailed in the Company’s Quality Assurance Program developed on the basis of ISO 9001:2000 Q.M. S


**All Fakeeh Care employees are responsible for continuous improvement, including:**
* Performing all duties and tasks in a manner that supports Fakeeh’s Person\-Centered care values.
* Actively contributing to continuous improvement initiatives, within the scope of the role.
* Adherence to safety protocols and proactively seeking to address any job\-related safety concerns.
* Maintaining strict confidentiality of all sensitive information accessed or encountered during work.
* Complying with cybersecurity policies and standards to protect Fakeeh’s systems and participating in awareness training and initiatives to prevent cyber threats.
* Adhering to and upholding Fakeeh Care’s code of conduct, policies and ethical standards.
* Completion of mandatory education as per the requirement, at least one month prior to expiration.


**Requirements**
* Minimum 10 years operational experience, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership or management role.
* Experience in facility management and healthcare environments from a well reputed local or international companies.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field; an MBA from an accredited University.
* Excellent command of oral and written English and Arabic.

 Lenovo’s SSG (Solutions Services Group) is looking for a strategic and collaborative Chief of Staff for META (Middle East, Türkiye Africa
 **)** 
 to partner with senior leadership and drive execution across the region.
   

  

 This role sits at the center of regional operations, helping align priorities, drive strategic initiatives, and support data\-driven decision\-making in a complex, matrixed environment.  You will report to the SSG KSA Sales Director and collaborate closely with regional and global stakeholders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience supporting senior leaders in a complex, matrixed, and international setting
* Ability to build strong relationships and credibility with senior stakeholders
* Comfortable managing multiple priorities at once, with a structured and well\-organized approach

Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

 7\- We are looking for someone who is able to travel in case needed.

 At Thales we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. data.jd_text:
**Overview**
 This is a critical Transformation role responsible for enabling the delivery of the multi\-year transformation agenda. This agenda is key to delivering long\-term sustainable growth (NOPBT margin ambition) for the OU/market and building organization capability for the future.
   

  

 The main pillars of the Transformation function are:
   

  

* Next Chapter Operating Model: Next Chapter organization, GCC, Processes, Simplification, WoW
* Cost Transformation: 2\-3 year productivity pipeline
* Transformation Management Office: develop and maintain integrated business transformation agenda which aligns to the OU/market vision and strategic KPIs
* Lead several key scale x\-functional transformation initiatives: as aligned with senior stakeholders
* Change Management


**Responsibilities**
* Operating Model
* Next Chapter Operating Model:
* Provide Program leadership to Next Chapter for OU/market. Working with OU Next Chapter PMO and CMO, and Region team, to land Next Chapter organization, processes and ways of working, per aligned OU roadmap
* Drive program level visibility and progress, connect the key workstreams.
* GCC:
* Provide program leadership to the OU/market GCC agenda per aligned roadmap: Ensure smooth transition through leveraging global scale and consolidating similar works in HUBs to maximize effectiveness.
* Collaborate with multiple partners in OU/market (Function Leads, People Lead, Comms Lead) and Region GCC team to ensure transition moves according to plan.
* Drive program\-level visibility and progress. Embed overall change management and communications. Manage interdependencies and key risks, escalating as required
* Cost Transformation
* Provide Program management to the OU/market Cost Transformation agenda. Provide program leadership to the OU/market cost agenda, focused on building a medium and long\-term productivity pipeline (next 2\-5 years).
* Drive program level visibility and progress, visibility of pipeline, connect and operationalize the key x\-functional workstreams, working with key stakeholders to size opportunities, mobilize team, build roadmaps/scorecards:
* DTV, Portfolio Harmonization, SC transformation, Procurement, GTM, A\&M, Operating Model (Picasso/Next Chapter/GCC), Digital
* Act as the Lead for Saudi DTV: Key tasks include Sprint Facilitation, Prioritization, \& Planning, SWAT Team Identification \& Onboarding, Value Realization and Brainstorming Ideas based on Benchmarking
* Embed overall change management and communications.
* TMO support to cost transformation governance processes (e.g. Productivity Council, agenda, pre\-reads, and actions as appropriate for OU/market).
* Manage interdependencies of workstreams and key risks, escalating as required.
* Transformation Management Office
* Own delivery of multi\-year OU/market Transformation roadmap, including digital agenda, working in conjunction with key OU stakeholders, Region Transformation and Deployment teams.
* Define overall project management plan leveraging standard frameworks for each program with the Project/Program lead, delivering detailed roadmaps and key milestones
* Define best support for each initiative in conjunction with key stakeholders and identify cross\-functional integration and tension points.
* Provide leadership and governance to these projects, working closely with core project teams, Functions, and OUs as required.
* Leverage project management methodology, guidance, and communication frameworks
* Provide scorecard and performance metrics for each project, manage risk and course correcting as required, and deliver defined benefits.
* Embed overall change management and communications.
* Lead process by prioritizing all investment requests, tracking resources, enabling active risk management, and ensuring value realization.
* Define a multi\-year investment plan and work with project stakeholders to outline the scope, goals, deliverables, required resources, budget \& timing.
* Build tools and capability to support OU/market Transformation agenda: Partner with Sector TMO and CMO to build standard tools, project management, and working methods to ensure execution discipline across our transformation and strategic projects.
* Collaborate with the Global Team to leverage global tools and capabilities and get insights from other sectors on adoption and roll\-out practices.
* Lead key scale x\-functional transformation initiatives (to be aligned with stakeholders)
* Provide leadership and project management to several scale OU/market Transformation projects
* Change Management
* Lead the change management community, plan training for new change leads and impacted managers, and drive effective organizational implementation.
* Working with EMEA Change Lead to seamlessly integrate a clear change management plan.
* Sharing learnings across projects and teams
* Estimate 2\-3 significant projects per year (often multiyear projects)


**Qualifications**
 Key Skills/Experience Required
   

  

* University degree or MBA
* 10\+ years of business experience in leadership roles at Market/OU/Region/Global level in the FMCG sector, preferably with transformation, change management and/or project management experience
* Deep understanding of the OU/market, processes, priorities and goals


 Key skills required for the role:
   

  

* Thinking: Excellent strategic mindset and thinking skills, forward\-thinking, ability to think holistically E2E and connect the dots, ability to frame the right questions and develop frameworks and solutions to solve complex problems. Highly analytical, motivated, decisive thought leader with excellent general management skills – strong bias for action and can\-do approach to work, “out of the box” thinking using traditional and non\-traditional information sources to support recommendations and drive business results.
* Execution: Strong leadership skills and proven track record of partnering with and influencing at all levels of the organization to develop and implement scale transformation or strategic initiatives, working across business functions to set and execute the agenda. Outstanding project management skills and ability to bring clarity and discipline to the transformation agenda. Excellent communication skills and ability to simplify.
* Relationships: collaborative team player who thrives working in an agile and ambiguous environment, demonstrating solid people skills, working well x\-function and x\-BU to align behind goals and delivery
* Agility: flexibility and willingness to take on diverse and challenging tasks, passion for supporting and managing change. Ability to operate in through ambiguity and adapt to changing priorities. Demonstrates courage and conviction required to lead scale changes initiatives and embrace new ways of working.

**Who We Are**

Our Global Smart Supply Chain Network combines highly automated warehousing with robust international transportation solutions, enabling seamless cross\-border movement. Today, we operate 130\+ bonded, direct mail, and overseas warehouses across 23 countries and regions, supported by our global brands, JoyLogistics and JoyExpress, as we continue scaling JD.com’s international logistics footprint.
   

  

 Learn more about who we are and what we do: https://www.jingdonglogistics.com/
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Joining JD Logistics means helping shape the future of global supply chain and logistics. You’ll work with smart warehousing, autonomous delivery, and innovative technology that keeps goods moving worldwide. With a competitive salary, great locations, and a supportive, people\-first culture, you’ll have the space to take on meaningful challenges, grow your skills, and make a real impact in a fast\-evolving industry.
   

  

**About The Team**
 You’ll be joining the JINGDONG Logistics team, which values collaboration, ownership, and a commitment to delivering high\-quality results in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Project Lifecycle Management: This includes project initiation, making project plans, detailing project work content, adjusting project plans according to the actual situation, and coordinating with project stakeholders to complete the work, ensuring high\-quality project delivery . 2\. On\-site Project Implementation Management, coordinating resources from all parties to ensure that the civil construction renovation, power and communication system, installation and commissioning of logistics automation equipment, and other tasks are carried out in an orderly manner, proceed as planned, and are delivered on time. 3\. Project Delivery and Integration: Collaborating with planning, operations, R\&D, equipment supplier, and other parties, organizing project training, on\-site setup, warehouse relocation, and starting operation to ensure a smooth project launch.
* Accumulation of Project Implementation Techniques and Standardization Construction: Based on the practice of Middle East project construction and operation, accumulate and compile Middle East project construction standards from the principles of compliance, efficiency, and economy, continuously iterate and improve to enhance the efficiency and quality of project construction.


 ﻿
   

  

**Job Requirements**
* Basic Requirements: Bachelor's degree or above, majors in Industrial Engineering, Logistics and supply chain management, Automation, and other related fields.
* Language Requirement: Fluent in English, capable of using it as a working language for meetings, reports, and project communication.
* Work Experience: More than 3 years of experience in project implementation, familiar with the overseas working environment and logistics policies, with experience in managing automated projects such as large\-scale warehousing centers, sorting centers, etc. Priority will be given to those with overseas project implementation experience.
* Basic Skills: Rigorous logical thinking and data sensitivity, good summarization and induction abilities, and data analysis capabilities. Proficient in at least one data analysis tool, such as EXCEL, SQL, Python, etc.
* Soft Skills: Possess strong project management and cross\-departmental coordination abilities, able to adapt to periodic business trips within the Middle East region. Have a structured thinking process, good at summarizing and extracting, and capable of distilling methodologies from projects.

This strategic leadership role will combine business development, project delivery oversight, commercial and financial management, and client relationship excellence to drive growth and successful delivery in one of our key sectors. As a leader within the Middle East region, with global connectivity, this role will require a blend of technical expertise, project leadership, business development acumen, and strategic client engagement.
   

  

 You will be responsible for shaping the direction of the mining business line, building strong teams, and delivering complex, major mining programs that align with WSP’s global standards and regional ambitions
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Business Development \& Strategy:**
* Serve as the founding leader for WSP’s Mining \& Minerals major programs business in the Middle East, establishing market presence and credibility.
* Navigate regional regulatory frameworks, cultural dynamics, and client expectations to build a sustainable business footprint.
* Define and execute the growth strategy for the Mining \& Minerals business line across the Middle East.
* Identify and pursue new market opportunities, capitalize on your existing relationships with government entities, mining operators, and strategic investors.
* Lead bid preparation and proposal development, including pricing, risk assessments, and contract terms.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with new and existing clients, and effectively represent WSP in meetings, workshops, and site\-based engagements.
* Prepare proposals, technical reports, and client\-facing documentation aligned with project and business objectives.
* Lead the setup and execution of PMC frameworks for large\-scale mining programs.
* Develop delivery models tailored to regional client needs, including owner’s team services and integrated project controls.


**Strategic Oversight of Advisory \& Design Streams:**
* Provide strategic leadership for the Mining Advisory and Design service lines.
* Ensure alignment with global technical teams and leverage international expertise to support and grow regional delivery.
* Drive integration across service lines to create a unified client offering – from pit to port, from exploration to closure.


**Project Delivery \& Operations:**
* Provide leadership and oversight for the successful end\-to\-end delivery of major mining projects including feasibility studies, mine planning, delivery, and closure phases.
* Implement and enforce project delivery governance, quality standards, safety protocols, and risk management frameworks.
* Collaborate closely with multi\-disciplinary teams to ensure seamless project execution and client satisfaction.


**Client Relationship \& Stakeholder Management:**
* Develop and maintain trusted advisor relationships with key clients, government agencies, regulators, and industry partners.
* Represent WSP at industry forums, conferences, and stakeholder meetings to enhance brand positioning and business opportunities.
* Be proactive in identifying opportunities to improve client outcomes and exceed expectations.


**Commercial \& Financial Leadership:**
* Take full P\&L accountability for the Mining \& Minerals major programs business line, including budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting.
* Manage commercial agreements, contracts, claims, and scope changes to protect company interests and maximize profitability.
* Drive cost control initiatives and optimize resource allocation.


**Leadership \& Team Development:**
* Recruit, mentor, and lead a high\-performing team of mining professionals across technical, commercial, and operational disciplines.
* Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, safety, and continuous improvement.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in mining engineering, Mineral Processing, Geology, or related field; master’s degree or MBA preferred.
* Minimum 15–20 years of experience in the mining sector, with exposure to consulting and operator\-side roles in the Middle East region.
* Familiarity with regional mining regulations, standards, and market dynamics is highly desirable.
* Proven track record in business development and establishing new business lines or service offerings.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience managing P\&L, contracts, and financial performance.

data.jd_text:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consultancy groups specialising in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA's mission is to design safe and sustainable transport solutions to bring people together, develop social inclusion and facilitate access to employment, education and leisure throughout the world.
   

  

 For 65 years, the Group has been working alongside cities and regions to contribute to their development by creating, improving and modernising their infrastructure and transport systems, throughout the life cycle of their projects. SYSTRA is involved from the earliest stages of design through to the testing, deployment and maintenance phases. The company provides all its services in over 80 countries worldwide and generates 74% of its turnover internationally. With its new services, SYSTRA supports its clients and partners in their digital, ecological and energy transition, in order to invent the mobility of tomorrow.
   

  

 Context
   

  

***This requirement is for a bid opportunity only at this stage. Any engagement will be subject to successful project award and final client approval.***
 The Project Director will provide overall leadership and strategic direction for PMCM services on roads and bridges projects, acting as the primary point of accountability for project performance and client satisfaction. The role will be responsible for managing multidisciplinary teams and ensuring that all project objectives are achieved in line with contractual obligations and corporate standards.
   

  

 Subject to project award, the successful candidate will lead project planning, mobilization, execution, and close\-out activities, while establishing robust governance, reporting, risk management, and stakeholder coordination processes. They will oversee project controls, construction supervision interfaces, consultant and contractor performance, and ensure compliance with quality, safety, and regulatory requirements.
   

  

 The Project Director will also be expected to maintain strong relationships with clients, government authorities, contractors, and key stakeholders, while supporting business growth through opportunity identification, bid support, and strategic client engagement where required.
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

* Lead and direct PMCM delivery for major roads and bridges projects from inception through completion, subject to award.
* Serve as the senior client interface and ensure effective stakeholder management at all levels.
* Provide leadership to project managers, discipline leads, construction management teams, and support functions.
* Establish and monitor project delivery strategies, execution plans, schedules, budgets, and resource requirements.
* Ensure effective management of scope, risk, change control, quality, HSE, and commercial performance.
* Oversee design coordination, construction supervision, contract administration, and project controls functions.
* Drive timely decision\-making and resolution of technical, contractual, and operational issues.
* Ensure compliance with client requirements, local regulations, and company procedures.
* Prepare and present executive\-level progress reports, dashboards, and performance updates.
* Support recruitment, mentoring, and development of project team members.
* Contribute to bid preparation, technical proposals, and strategic positioning for future PMCM opportunities.


 Profile/Skills
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be a highly experienced infrastructure leader with a strong track record of delivering large, complex roads and bridges projects under PMCM or similar consultancy\-led delivery models. They will possess excellent leadership, communication, commercial, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to operate effectively in demanding, high\-profile project environments.
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
* Minimum 20 years of relevant professional experience in infrastructure project delivery, with a strong emphasis on site\-based execution and project delivery leadership for major roads and bridges projects.
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience in managing projects through key delivery stages, including mobilization, construction supervision, interface management, testing and commissioning, project close\-out, and handover.
* Proven track record in leading the day\-to\-day delivery of large\-scale infrastructure projects, ensuring performance against programme, budget, quality, and contractual obligations.
* Strong practical experience in construction management, site operations, contractor oversight, supervision teams, and resolution of on\-site technical and operational issues.
* Proven ability to manage multidisciplinary site teams and coordinate effectively across contractors, designers, client representatives, authorities, and other project stakeholders.
* GCC experience is mandatory.
* KSA experience is a strong advantage.
* Chartered Engineer status is preferred or equivalent recognized professional accreditation.
* Strong knowledge of SHEQ principles, standards, and implementation practices across major infrastructure projects.
* Demonstrated commitment to Safety, Health, Environment, and Quality leadership, with the ability to embed a strong SHEQ culture across project teams and supply chain partners.
* Proven experience in promoting safe working practices, quality compliance, risk mitigation, incident prevention, and continuous improvement throughout project delivery.
* Strong understanding of contract administration, construction management, project controls, change management, and stakeholder coordination in live project environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Strong client\-facing presence and the ability to engage effectively with senior stakeholders and public\-sector entities.


 Systra is an equal opportunities company; this position is open to all applicants.

 Yours is a role responsible for building a future\-ready workforce that strengthens safety, performance, and long\-term growth. You are expected to oversee high\-impact learning delivery using blended, digital, simulation\-based, and experiential methods tailored to aviation.
   

  

 Partnering closely with senior leaders, you will ensure leadership depth, regulatory compliance, and workforce readiness across all functions.

data.title: Manager - Medical Readiness & Training (Del-286)
data.raw_snippet: The Medical Readiness \& Training Manager is responsible for building and sustaining a city\-wide culture of emergency preparedness at Qiddiya. The role owns the full cycle of first aid and first responder training, certification compliance, emergency drill planning and evaluation, and event medical
data.jd_text:
The Medical Readiness \& Training Manager is responsible for building and sustaining a city\-wide culture of emergency preparedness at Qiddiya. The role owns the full cycle of first aid and first responder training, certification compliance, emergency drill planning and evaluation, and event medical readiness. Working within healthcare operations, the Manager ensures that Qiddiya's workforce is continuously trained, certified, and operationally ready to respond to medical emergencies across all venues and activations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 First Aid \& First Responder Training
   

  

* Design, deliver, and continuously improve first aid and first responder training programs aligned with AHA/SHA Heartsaver standards and applicable national requirements
* Develop and maintain training materials including manuals, skill\-station scenarios, simulation scripts, and competency assessment tools
* Supervise and mentor first aid instructors, ensuring consistent delivery quality and standardized assessment across all training cohorts
* Maintain city\-wide certification compliance, ensuring all designated staff hold valid AHA/SHA or equivalent credentials at all times, with proactive renewal tracking
* Coordinate with City Operations, HR, and department heads to embed certification requirements into onboarding and role\-specific duty conditions
* Produce monthly certification compliance dashboards and escalate gaps to the Executive Director, Healthcare Operations


 2\.2 Emergency Drills, Simulations \& Performance Reporting
   

  

* Design and manage annual drill and simulation calendar covering mass casualty incidents, medical emergencies, mass gathering scenarios, and venue\-specific response exercises
* Facilitate tabletop exercises and live simulations, coordinating participants across City Operations, and external partners as required
* Evaluate drill performance using standardized checklists, response time metrics, and team\-performance criteria; produce structured after\-action reports with corrective recommendations
* Track corrective action closure and retest through follow\-up drills to confirm sustained improvement in response performance


 2\.3 Public Health Awareness \& Community Outreach
   

  

* Plan and deliver an annual public health awareness calendar aligned with national health observances and Qiddiya's operational calendar, covering priority topics such as heat illness prevention, cardiac health, diabetes awareness, and mass gathering safety
* Coordinate with Marketing \& Communications to produce guest and staff\-facing health education content, including signage, digital materials, and event\-based messaging
* Build and maintain relationships with partner hospitals, referral facilities, and community health stakeholders to support integrated health promotion and care pathways for Qiddiya's workforce and guests
* Measure outreach reach and engagement and report outcomes to the Executive Director, Healthcare Operations


 2\.4 Vaccination Programs
   

  

* Plan and supervise staff vaccination drives in coordination with the healthcare provider and Ministry of Health requirements, covering seasonal influenza, meningitis, and other mandated or recommended programs
* 
* Track vaccination coverage rates against defined targets, maintain records, and produce reports for leadership and regulatory submission
* Coordinate logistics for vaccination campaigns including scheduling, venue setup, cold chain compliance, and post\-campaign adverse event monitoring


 2\.5 Volunteer Management
   

  

* Recruit, train, and coordinate a pool of volunteer first aiders drawn from across Qiddiya's workforce, maintaining their certification status and deploying them to supplement professional medical coverage at events and activations
* Develop and manage a roster of volunteer first aid instructors to support scaling of training delivery across the city, ensuring instructor quality through observation, feedback, and standardization
* Recruit and train Standardized Patients (SPs) to support realistic simulation exercises and emergency drills, managing their briefing, role preparation, and performance feedback to ensure high\-fidelity scenario delivery
* Maintain complete volunteer records including profiles, training history, certification status, deployment logs, and performance feedback; recognize and retain high\-performing volunteers to build program continuity


 2\.6 AED Network \& First Responder Readiness
   

  

* Oversee the city\-wide AED placement strategy, maintaining an up\-to\-date inventory of all devices, inspection schedules, and readiness status across all Qiddiya venues
* Build and maintain a layered first responder network across city departments, ensuring adequate coverage of trained lay responders at all operational areas and venues
* Promote the Qiddiya Life Saver program to grow bystander first aid capability among staff, embedding a culture of emergency preparedness across the city workforce


 2\.7 Event \& Venue Medical Readiness
   

  

* Conduct pre\-event medical readiness assessments for major activations, theme park openings, and mass gathering events, verifying that staffing, equipment, and trained responders meet defined standards
* Develop venue\-specific emergency response plans and coordinate readiness briefings with operational teams ahead of activations and high\-footfall periods


 2\.8 Reporting \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Prepare and present monthly readiness reports to the Executive Director, Healthcare Operations, covering training throughput, certification status, drill outcomes, and AED network status
* Identify and implement evidence\-based improvements to training, drill design, and readiness programs through data analysis, after\-action review, and benchmarking against mass gathering and entertainment industry standards


 2\.9 Regulatory Compliance \& Governance
   

  

* Ensure all training programs, certifications, and readiness activities comply with Saudi Commission for Health Specialties (SCFHS), Ministry of Health, and Qiddiya governance requirements
* Maintain accurate records of all training, drills, certifications, and readiness assessments to support audit, accreditation, and regulatory inspection readiness
* Support CMS governance by contributing readiness data and insights to the broader healthcare operations reporting cycle


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Emergency Medical Services, Paramedicine, Nursing, Public Health, or a related clinical discipline
* Valid SCFHS professional license in a relevant clinical category
* Minimum 5\-7 years of experience in emergency medical services, healthcare training, or mass gathering medicine, with at least 2\-3 years in a training, education, or emergency preparedness role
