data.jd_text:
**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Purpose Summary**
 The overall role for the position is to assist the SVP/ VP Innovation to drive cultural change around one dedicated strategic innovation themes. The incumbent will manage and monitor all innovation initiatives within his/ her scope in order to ensure that they are implemented and completed within the defined time, budget and requirements with the support of the originally allocated resources. The incumbent will also be responsible for developing, driving and rolling out appropriate tracking metrics for regular reporting to core stakeholders at a project, initiative and program level. He/ she is also responsible for actively maintaining and updating the established ecosystem.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities By Dimensions**
* Shareholder \& Financial:
* Establish and maintain strong working relationships across all business and support units as well as countries across QNB Group
* Assist SVP/ VP in identifying, exploring and validating one or several Strategic themes: AI/ ML, API/ Open banking, Platforms and marketplaces, Robotics and automation
* Own post\-mortems on completed innovation initiatives to ensure that they delivered the forecasted value creation to the Group
* Assist other departments in identifying, analyzing and monitoring external innovation trends
* Manage the roll out of appropriate innovation tracking metrics for regular reporting to core stakeholders at a project, initiative and program level
* Supervise the update of established performance metrics
* Implements KPI’s and best practices for Assistant Vice President Innovation role.
* Promote cost consciousness and efficiency and enhance productivity, to minimise cost, avoid waste, and optimise benefits for the bank.
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent.
* Customer (Internal \& External):
* Support the SVP/ VP Innovation to successfully run the innovation agenda
* Foster and empower employees to create a bottom\-up innovation culture in which participants share ideas to improve existing products/ services
* Act as a partner to the concerned business and support divisions and lead process improvement projects together with representatives from one or more business and support divisions
* Manage activities centered around instilling the innovation culture at QNB, such as innovation days, hackathons, innovation lab, etc.
* Supervise in the preparation of regular updates to the Executive Management on global innovative trends, status of current QNB innovation initiatives and impact of completed innovation projects
* Act as a coach and support for SMEs in the evaluation stage \- Act as a content owner for the Innovation Learning and Development resources accessible to the QNB employee base
* Internal (Processes, Products, Regulatory):
* Obtain mandate, inputs and overall direction from EVP/ SVP/ VP Innovation on specific initiatives
* Supervise the development and preparation of all policies/ processes and procedures as well as standards
* Coordinate the innovation execution by managing the portfolio of group\-wide innovation initiatives and conducting the post\-mortem on completed initiatives
* Be involved and engaged in individual projects on a day\-to\-day basis to provide assistance to the project teams
* Demonstrate advanced project management skills and implement industry best practices and standards of project portfolio management
* Demonstrate deep understanding of Lean and Process Management to ensure alignment with the work undertaken across the wider Innovation Department
* Learning \& Knowledge:
* Identify related areas for professional self\-development
* Possess strong project management fundamentals as well as project portfolio management methodology/ techniques and tools
* Maintain basic knowledge about banking processes, regulations, and generally accepted operating practices.
* Research industry topics and react by recommending changes to products, services, and systems
* Carry out other similar duties that can be defined within the broad functional job and functional responsibilities outlined above
* Proactively identify areas for professional development of self and undertake development activities.
* Seek out opportunities to remain current with all developments in professional field.


**Education \& Experience Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree from Top tier university degree or equivalent
* Minimum of 10 years work experience in a change management and senior advisory function within the financial services arena
* Proven track record within the field of innovation preferably from global financial services institution
* Track record as a change leader, motivator, driver for cultural change throughout a large and complex organization
* Substantial management experience and proven track record in driving senior management agenda
* Demonstrated career development, progress, and experience in establishing new functions
* High level knowledge of all major banking related business and support functions


 Note: you will be required to attach the following:
   

  

* Resume/CV

data.jd_text:
**JOB SUMMARY** 




 The Director \- Human Research Subjects Protection Program is responsible for the overall administration of the program for protecting human participants in research, including the oversight and implementation of, and compliance with, institutional policies and procedures, national statutes and regulations, and ethical and professional standards for the conduct of human research. The HRPP Director serves as the organization authority on relevant compliance issues and as a liaison between the organization and Ministry of Public Health.
 



 Responsibilities
 



  





**KEY ROLE ACCOUNTABILITIES** 



* Maintains the institution assurance of compliance with the Ministry of Public Health (MOPH) and the U.S. Office for Human Research Protections (OHRP) and ensures adherence to their terms for the protection of human subjects.
* Works collaboratively with the Chairs of regulatory committees, Department Chairs, institution administration to provide support, compliance monitoring and oversight, and facilitate ethical conduct of research.
* Oversees and coordinates HRPP activities across the various offices and staff that have roles in protecting research participants.
* Coordinates with Sidra’s Divisions and Units for implementing other aspects of human research protection programs and initiatives.
* Proactively creates or revises policies and procedures and corresponds guidance to assure consistency with best practices and evolving external policies from MOPH.
* Manages and supervises the staff that provides administrative and regulatory support to the IRB Committee.
* Develops, modifies and executes policies that affect immediate operation(s) and may also have organization\-wide effect.
* Coordinates efforts of the IRB Office staff to ensure thorough and timely reviews of all IRB submissions.
* Administers the Responsible Conduct of Research training coordination.
* Provides subject matter\-specific counsel to HRPP team members, Board members, and investigators.
* Ensures that human research protection training is available and completed by investigators, key study personnel, the Institutional Signatory Official, and all Sidra staff who participate in the human subject’s protection program.
* Oversees the quality assurance monitoring of the HRPP, including research protocols and investigation of matters of non\-compliance. Ensure implementation of corrective action, as needed, in accordance with Sidra policies and IRB policies and procedures.
* Serves as the organization authority on relevant compliance issues, and as a liaison between the organization and federal regulators,
* Oversees and is accountable for policies and procedures related to relevant compliance area.
* Reviews and approves recommendations for research compliance programs.
* Maintains current knowledge of human research protection guidance and regulations as they evolve. Stay current on emerging issues. Monitors MOPH regulatory websites and other research\-related resources so as to stay current with regulatory changes in human research protections guidelines and policies. Communicate pertinent information to staff in a timely manner.
* Establishes objectives and work plans, and delegate’s assignments to subordinate managers.
* Coordinates and participates in regulatory agency site visits and audits; analyzes and assesses audit findings and proposes and implements changes to HRPP policies and procedures to address findings, when needed.
* Manages, prepares, administers, and directs resources



  





**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE** 




**Education** 




 Bachelor’s Degree in biomedical field
 



  





**Experience** 




 10\+ years of experience with progressive responsibilities in the human subject protection program area or in other research protection programs, clinical research, or management of human research including:
 


* 5\+ years direct supervisory / management experience.
* Previous leadership experience combined with a proven and demonstrated track record of leading others and achieving outstanding results.
* Expertise and experience in supervision and oversight of IRBs at an Academic Medical Center
* Experience in budget management.



  





**Certification** 




 Council for Certification of IRB Professionals (CCIP) certification or willingness to obtain within six months.

**Job Description**
 The role will act as the senior onsite engagement lead for the client, governing end\-to\-end delivery, operational readiness, release management, platform stability, AI operations, and managed services execution across multiple enterprise platforms.
   

  

 The role is responsible for designing, launching, and scaling enterprise grade DataOps, MLOps, AI operations, CI/CD, application support, and managed services capabilities from the ground up. This includes enabling governance frameworks, operational standards, release governance processes, service management models, operational KPIs, support structures, and scalable delivery capabilities.
   

  

 In addition, the role plays a key leadership function in stakeholder management, capability development, business growth, and long\-term service expansion. The successful candidate must demonstrate strong leadership across Data \& AI delivery, production operations, organizational capability building, and executive stakeholder engagement within complex multi\-vendor environments.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Enterprise Platform Delivery \& Operations Leadership
* Own enterprise delivery and operational governance across multiple data platforms.
* Lead production readiness, hypercare governance, release management, operational acceptance, and transition into managed services.
* Govern enterprise platform lifecycle management including environment management, deployment governance, rollback planning, and operational stabilization.
* Ensure delivery alignment with strategic business objectives, roadmap priorities, operational timelines, and release schedules.
* Drive operational scalability, resiliency, observability, monitoring, and continuous service improvement initiatives.
* DataOps, MLOps \& AI Operations
* Establish and scale enterprise\-grade DataOps, MLOps, CI/CD, and AI operations frameworks.
* Define operational standards for model deployment, monitoring, retraining coordination, drift management, inference operations, and AI governance controls.
* Govern AI operational readiness and support processes for enterprise AI use cases across multiple production platforms.
* Standardize release management, deployment automation, testing governance, and operational quality assurance processes.
* Managed Services \& Service Offering Development
* Design and scale enterprise Data \& AI managed services offerings covering platform operations, application support, DataOps, MLOps, and AI operations.
* Develop reusable operational frameworks, governance standards, support models, delivery playbooks, and service catalogs.
* Define L1/L2/L3 support operating models, escalation procedures, SLA structures, and operational KPIs.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance service quality, operational maturity, and delivery efficiency.
* Program Management \& Delivery Governance
* Lead delivery execution across multiple Data \& AI workstreams including data engineering, analytics, governance, AI enablement, and operational support.
* Monitor delivery progress, operational risks, issues, dependencies, and readiness activities across all programs.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise standards, governance policies, cybersecurity requirements, and operational controls.
* Govern delivery reporting, performance tracking, financial oversight, and operational accountability.
* Stakeholder Leadership \& Client Engagement
* Act as the senior onsite engagement lead for Data \& AI programs and operations.
* Build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders, sector leadership, technical teams, and implementation partners.
* Lead executive governance forums, steering committees, operational reviews, and strategic planning sessions.
* Drive alignment across business, architecture, operations, AI, infrastructure, and governance stakeholders.
* Vendor \& Multi\-Partner Governance
* Govern multi\-vendor delivery and operational coordination across implementation partners, cloud providers, platform vendors, and support teams.
* Manage dependencies, escalation management, operational coordination, and delivery alignment across all involved parties.
* Capability Building, Staffing \& People Management
* Define the long\-term capability model required for sustainable enterprise Data \& AI operations.
* Lead workforce planning, staffing strategy, onboarding, capability development, and succession planning.
* Support recruitment and management of Data \& AI delivery, operations, governance, engineering, AI, PMO, and support resources.
* Coach and mentor teams to establish high\-performance delivery and operational practices.
* Business Growth \& Commercial Support
* Identify service expansion and upsell opportunities aligned with client strategic priorities.
* Support development of proposals, business cases, effort estimates, pricing models, and service expansion strategies.
* Manage delivery financials including forecasting, utilization tracking, operational efficiency, and margin optimization.
* Communication \& Executive Reporting
* Provide executive\-level dashboards, operational updates, release readiness reports, risk registers, and performance reporting.
* Lead communication planning and change management activities supporting operational adoption and stakeholder engagement.


**Qualifications**
**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Management, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 12\+ years of experience in enterprise Data \& AI delivery, platform operations, managed services, or digital transformation programs.
* Proven experience leading enterprise scale DataOps, MLOps, AI operations, or Data \& AI platform support organizations.
* Experience managing production critical enterprise platforms and large scale release programs.
* Experience establishing managed services, operational governance models, and scalable support capabilities from inception.
* Experience managing executive stakeholder relationships within government or large enterprise environments is highly preferred.


**Technical Competencies**
* Strong understanding of DataOps, MLOps, CI/CD, enterprise data platforms, data architecture, data governance, metadata, lineage, data quality, and analytics ecosystems.
* Experience operationalizing enterprise AI use cases in production environments.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML operationalization including model deployment, monitoring, retraining cycles, drift detection, inference operations, and AI governance controls.
* Familiarity with operational processes including testing governance, deployment pipelines, incident management, problem management, and service operations.


**Leadership \& Management Competencies**
* Excellent executive stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, and leadership skills.
* Demonstrated experience leading multi\-disciplinary teams across delivery, operations, AI, engineering, governance, and support functions.
* Strong strategic thinking and operational leadership capabilities.
* Ability to operate effectively in complex, multi\-stakeholder, and multi\-vendor environments.


**Mandatory Requirements**
* Fluent in English communication skills required, Arabic language fluency is very much preferred.
* Willingness to work onsite and lead client\-facing engagement activities.

**Job Description**
 We are currently seeking a Senior Project Manager – Fit Out to lead the fit\-out delivery of high\-rise projects in Qatar.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will bring proven experience in a Senior Project Manager role, with a strong track record in managing fit\-out delivery, testing and commissioning, snagging, handover, and project close\-out on high\-rise PMC projects.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead and manage the fit\-out phase of high\-rise projects from planning through to handover
* Oversee fit\-out execution to ensure works are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards
* Manage project scope, programme, cost, and risk while ensuring alignment with client requirements and business objectives
* Coordinate and lead the project team, including contractors, consultants, architects, engineers, and support staff
* Monitor project progress and provide regular updates, financial control, and reporting
* Ensure fit\-out works are properly coordinated with all disciplines and completed in line with project delivery processes
* Review and manage contractor performance, shop drawings, material approvals, mock\-ups, and installation quality
* Lead testing, commissioning, snagging, handover, and close\-out activities related to fit\-out packages
* Support resolution of site issues, commercial matters, claims, and interface challenges during the fit\-out stage
* Ensure robust project plans, look\-aheads, and forecasts are prepared and regularly updated


**Qualifications**
* A bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or a related field
* PMP certification or membership of an equivalent professional institution
* 20\+ years of experience in project management/construction management, with strong experience in fit\-out delivery
* Proven experience as a Senior Project Manager leading high\-end fit\-out packages on complex high\-rise or large\-scale building projects
* Strong knowledge of fit\-out coordination, finishing trades, testing and commissioning, snagging, and handover processes
* Experience managing contractors, consultants, and multidisciplinary teams through the fit\-out stage
* Demonstrable understanding of commercial management, claims, and project close\-out requirements
* Experience using modern project delivery and coordination tools, including BIM
* International consultancy experience, with at least 5 years in the Middle East preferred
* Strong ability to manage technical and delivery matters across all disciplines associated with fit\-out projects

* Must have proven experience as Project Engineering Manager / Engineering Manager on Pre\-FEED, FEED and Detailed Engineering projects during the last five years.
* Strong exposure to multi\-disciplinary engineering and global delivery teams.


**Technical \& Functional Competencies**
* Strong understanding of engineering governance, execution planning, and design assurance.
* Extensive knowledge of cross\-discipline integration, interfaces, and sequencing.
* Experience in engineering deliverables, specifications, and design review processes.
* Solid understanding of project lifecycle phases (Pre\-FEED, FEED, Detailed Design, EPC).
* Familiarity with industry standards and customer specifications.
* Experience in risk management, change management, and technical decision\-making.


**Leadership \& Behavioral Competencies**
* Strong leadership capability with ability to manage diverse, multi\-location teams.
* Effective communicator with the ability to influence technical and commercial decisions.
* Strong problem\-solving mindset with ability to manage complexity and conflicting priorities.
* High level of planning, organization, and execution discipline.
* Ability to operate in fast\-paced, multi\-project environments.


**Moving forward together**
 We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels they belong, can bring themselves, and are heard. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by law.

data.jd_text:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance and healthspan. WHOOP empowers its members to perform at a higher level by providing a deep understanding of the interactions between their unique physiology and chosen behaviors.
   

  

 We’re looking for a talented leader to help open WHOOP Labs Doha, our first international product research facility. The Doha lab will partner with the WHOOP Labs Boston team to conduct mixed\-methods research to support physiology, user experience, and consumer studies. To serve the company’s diverse testing and validation needs, WHOOP Labs completes tens of thousands of data collections a year and creates best in class experience for our participants. WHOOP Labs Doha will set the bar for product innovation research in the GCC, setting strategy for participant experience and contributing to advancing WHOOP technology.
   

  

 We’re looking for someone with a proven track record collaborating internationally and leading a cross\-functional team, who is excited to work with our members and isn’t afraid to roll up their sleeves and get sweaty. This position is in\-person in Doha, Qatar with potential travel to Boston, MA 1\-2 times per year.
   

  

**This role is based in the Doha, Qatar. We will only consider candidates who currently live in Doha, Qatar.**
**Responsibilities**
* Own the development and execution of the WHOOP Labs Doha opening strategy, including team hiring, participant compensation structure, and setting operating hours
* Champion research integrity, including ensuring that data collection tools and team practices align with local regulations for ethical human subjects research
* Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of program initiatives and track progress towards goals
* Ensure clear communication between the Boston and Doha labs, developing ways of working that support multi\-facility research execution
* Represent Doha culture and unique participant experience factors in broader strategic conversations with the rest of the WHOOP human subjects research team
* Build the WHOOP Labs Doha brand and represent WHOOP in the GCC region

**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree in a field related to human subjects research such as psychology, neuroscience, exercise physiology, or consumer science
* 5\+ years of full\-time professional experience in a related area
* 2\+ years of success leading a diversely skilled team
* Experience working on a distributed international team preferred
* Deep knowledge of local culture and ability to thoughtfully communicate localization considerations for research at WHOOP Labs Doha
* Understanding of best practices regarding human subjects research, including how to obtain IRB approval for new research projects; research ethics, data privacy, and consent
* Track record of successful project management, including resource allocation, timeline management, and risk mitigation
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills, ability to plan ahead while still being flexible and able to work around challenges

data.raw_snippet:

data.jd_text:
**Department:** 
 NUQ Library
   

  

 Northwestern University in Qatar (NU\-Q) seeks an outstanding Director of the NU\-Q Library. The Director of the NU\-Q Library guides a team of library professionals with vision and purpose in support of NU\-Q vision of excellence in teaching, research, and mediamaking. Reporting to the Associate Dean for Education, the Director of the NU\-Q Library will provide collaborative leadership and strategic direction to the programs, services, initiatives, and collections of the NU\-Q Library. The successful candidate will be a forward\-thinking professional who is enthusiastic about advancing research, teaching, learning, and practice through access to NU\-Q Library resources, and knowledgeable about the complex nature of building, supervising, managing, and mentoring a collaborative team. The Director of the NU\-Q Library will facilitate partnerships in education and knowledge creation within Northwestern and beyond.
   

  

**Core Mission**
* Commitment to the core mission of NU\-Q as a global community of evidence\-based storytellers guided by the core values of excellence, collaboration, community, and sustainability
* Leadership and Strategic Vision
* Administration and Supervision
* Campus Engagement
* Professional and Ethical Practices and Innovation
* Assessment and Continuous Improvement


 The NU\-Q Library is a user\-focused library and serves the research and educational needs of NU\-Q faculty, staff, and students. The growing collection is made up of print, DVD/Blu\-ray, and electronic resources purchased and provided to support the curricular needs of the Communication Program which offers Media Industries and Technology major, the Journalism and Strategic Communication Program which offers Journalism major, and the Liberal Arts Program. The NU\-Q Library’s core mission is to coordinate and deliver robust reference services both in\-person and online, supporting research and learning across disciplines.
   

  

 The Director of the NU\-Q Library supports the university leadership and is responsible for the overall management and administration of the NU\-Q library. The Director of the NU\-Q Library oversees all aspects of NU\-Q Library staffing\-from recruitment and onboarding to performance evaluation and professional growth\-while fostering a collaborative work environment. With a keen eye on strategic planning and strategic resource management, the Director of the NU\-Q Library develops and administers departmental budgets to ensure operational excellence. As a passionate advocate for the NU\-Q Library's core mission and services, the Director of the NU\-Q Library builds strong relationships with campus leadership and stakeholders, championing the library's essential role in academic excellence and student success. Through thoughtful planning and continuous assessment, the Director of the NU\-Q Library drives the development of innovative research support services and information resources. By partnering with faculty, academic departments, and student support teams, the Director of the NU\-Q Library helps elevate community members’ learning outcomes and ensures the library remains a vital, evolving hub of intellectual engagement. The Director of the NU\-Q Library fosters a culture of shared governance; advances the library culture of assessment through data collection; engages in evidence\-based decision\-making practices; and promotes a culture of accessibility, accountability, innovation, and ethical practices.
   

  

 There are also opportunities to collaborate with NU\-Q’s Institute for Advanced Study of the Global South (IAS), Artificial Intelligence and Media Lab (AIM\-Lab), and Media Majlis Museum (MMM). The IAS in the Global South at NU\-Q (\#IAS\_NUQ) produces and promotes evidence\-based storytelling focused on the histories, cultures, societies, and media of the Global South. The AIM\-LAB at NU\-Q produces and promotes data\-based storytelling focused on the intersection of artificial intelligence and media. MMM at NU\-Q is a museum dedicated to exploring journalism, communication, media and art.
   

  

 In the era of digital technologies and AI, libraries in media schools need to transition from a conventional resource center into an active catalyst for digital storytelling, research advancement, and ethical media innovation. They curate and provide access to multimedia collections, data journalism resources, AI\-driven production tools, and cutting\-edge media technologies. Beyond access, libraries in media schools are expected to cultivate advanced information literacy, AI literacy, critical understanding of algorithms, copyright compliance, academic integrity, and responsible AI integration in creative projects. They partner with faculty, staff, and students to confront misinformation, deepfakes, and data ethics challenges while upholding the highest standards of media research, media production, journalism practice, and creative scholarship.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Ph.D. in a subject area relevant to the core mission of Northwestern University in Qatar (communication studies, media studies, media design, cinema studies, journalism studies, liberal arts, etc.)


**Required Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in Library and Information Science (MLIS) from an ALA\-accredited program.
* Minimum of 6 years of successful progressive leadership experience in university libraries (e.g., Assistant Director of Library and then Associate Director of Library required to support the Director of Library).
* Proven experience in and strong record of supervising, training, mentoring, and evaluating librarian faculty and staff members, fostering professional growth, contribution, and collaboration
* Proven experience in and strong record of developing and delivering library faculty/staff development programs
* Proven experience in and strong record of annual assessment of library services and implementation of long\-term strategies for the growth and innovation of library services
* Proven experience in and strong record of data collection and data analytics to inform evidence\-based decision\-making and service improvements
* Proven experience in and strong record of assessment of the effectiveness of library services, spaces, and collections in advancing student success and academic excellence
* Proven experience in and strong record of adoption of emerging technologies and innovative practices to enhance access, discovery, and research support
* Proven experience in and strong record of development and implementation of strategic initiatives that support institutional goals and accreditation requirements
* Proven experience in and strong record of university teaching and instructional design for information literacy
* Proven experience in and strong record of developing programs that showcase the role of university libraries in research, curricular use, and community engagement
* Proven experience in strategic planning, assessment practices, and advocacy in higher education environments.
* Proven experience in and strong record of building and maintaining effective partnerships and collaborations between the library, university leadership, academic departments, and the broader university community
* Proven experience in and strong record of dedication to student success
* Solid understanding of the organizational structure, organizational workflows, and approval chains in top\-tier universities
* Extensive knowledge of a broad range of issues and emerging trends in managing, collecting, and providing access to academic/university libraries
* Knowledge of Open Education Resources (OER) and affordable learning initiatives
* Comprehensive familiarity with the current trends in academic libraries, media schools, digital scholarship, and student learning support.
* Proven experience in budget and grant development and management
* Excellent communication, collaborative, interpersonal, and organizational skills
* Strong record of professional engagement and contribution, such as research, publications, and involvement in professional and scholarly organizations
* Strong record of progressively responsible experience working with a multidisciplinary team in academic/university libraries, including supervisory and leadership roles.
* Proven experience in and strong interest in applying new and emerging technologies to Library collections and archives, including digital scholarship and digital humanities initiatives
* Ability to demonstrate a calm, courteous, and professional demeanor when working with a variety of situations and/or people.
* Vision for leveraging emerging technologies, including the ethical application and use of artificial intelligence for library resources, services, and assessment
* Experience with collection development and maintenance, including databases and resources


***Please note this position description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this position. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.***
**Responsibilities**
* Provide leadership to and management of a forward\-thinking NU\-Q Library, by playing a dynamic leadership role, guiding a team of library professionals with vision and purpose
* Oversee all aspects of staffing\-from recruitment and onboarding to performance evaluation and professional growth\-while fostering a collaborative work environment
* With a keen eye on strategic resource management, the Director develops and administers departmental budgets to ensure operational excellence.
* Articulate a compelling vision for the NU\-Q Library and the value of the NU\-Q Library in supporting research, teaching, learning, and community engagement that aligns with the NU\-Q Library’s core mission and strategic directions
* Provide vision for NU\-Q Library collection development and stewardship. Establish priorities and develop policies that guide the development of library collections in alignment with the core mission of NU\-Q
* Establish strategic directions and priorities for a range of user\-centered services and programs that create exceptional experiences for the Northwestern community in support of their research, teaching, learning and practice with NU\-Q Library resources
* Provide leadership and oversight to the development of staff development programs and initiatives that establish the NU\-Q Library as a dynamic and innovative teaching and learning resource at Northwestern
* Provide overall direction for a team of 7 librarian faculty and staff members. Directly supervise Library faculty/staff members including librarians, library associate, and library assistants. Coordinate the department work. Provide mentorship, advocacy and support to all department staff and foster their professional engagement and growth
* Build and nurture collaborations and partnerships within the library, with faculty, academic departments, and the broader Northwestern community that strengthen and promote the key role and core mission of the NU\-Q Library in research, teaching, and community engagement
* Collaborate with library departments to advance the library’s digital transformation agenda to broaden discovery, access, and preservation of primary source materials in support of research and academic pursuits
* Represent the NU\-Q library in initiatives and events related to the strategic vision and priorities of the university within and outside NU\-Q. Contribute to the library’s leadership role in the field through projects, presentations, scholarship, and active participation in relevant professional organizations


**The anticipated salary range is $100,000 – $110,000 Commensurate with experience and qualifications.** 
 The pay offered to the selected candidate will be determined based on factors including (but not limited to) the experience and qualifications of the selected candidate including years since terminal degree, training, and field or discipline; departmental budget availability; internal comparators; and external market pay for comparable jobs.
   

  

 NU\-Q is a community of evidence\-based storytellers in the Global South. We are a globally embedded institution, being one of three campuses of Northwestern University (Chicago, Doha, Evanston) and one of several partner universities in the Qatar Foundation’s Education City in Doha, Qatar. Our mission is to mentor and educate students to become creative, ethical, and impactful communicators across cultural and national boundaries. We are committed to a vibrant student life, academic excellence, and high\-level undergraduate student research and media making, particularly on the Global South. Located at the confluence of continents, NU\-Q is a multidisciplinary global community with approximately 500 students from 60 countries.
   

  

 NU\-Q provides competitive compensation and benefits. The medium of instruction is English, but proficiency in Arabic or another regional language is an advantage at NU\-Q. Candidates with experience in US higher education as well as in the Arab region are particularly encouraged to apply. Northwestern University in Qatar is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

data.jd_text:
**Primary Purpose Of The Job**
 To lead, manage and successfully deliver the EPIC Execution Phase for the PS3 BH Field Redevelopment Project – covering both Greenfield and Brownfield scopes— ensuring delivery within cost, schedule, quality, and HSE requirements in line with QatarEnergy's Project Management Framework.
   

  

 The role acts as the Project Manager’s primary deputy, accountable for day‑to‑day coordination, decision‑making, and execution oversight for all EPIC activities across engineering, procurement, fabrication, installation, pre‑commissioning, commissioning, and handover.
   

  

 The EPIC Phase Scope of Work includes, but is not limited to:
   

  

* New Production Station (PS3\) bridge connected to the existing complex, consisting of a Process (PS3K) Platform, a Utilities and Living Quarters (PS3L) Platform, MJ Separation and Compression (PS3M), Riser Platform (PS3R), Flare and interconnecting bridges with structural props.
* Brownfield Modifications to existing PS3A,PS3B and PS3C, plus HV Electrical modifications and Civil works at Halul Island.
* A structural Prop and new 4 leg jacket with topside for injection wells.
* Structural Props (support platform) at several remote WHJs.


**Required Experience And Skills**
* At least 10 years in senior Project Management roles delivering large offshore packages.
* Proven leadership delivering multi‑billion USD EPIC contracts involving Topsides, Jackets, Brownfield modifications, offshore construction, installation, and commissioning.
* Work experience in fabrication, offshore construction, and Inspection and Pre\-commissioning activities.
* Strong understanding of engineering design, offshore fabrication, load‑out, T\&I, hook‑up, pre‑commissioning and commissioning.
* Knowledge of offshore codes and standards (API, DNV, ISO) and Shell DEPs.
* Solid experience with risk management, schedule control, earned value, interface management, and change management.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills in multicultural environments.
* Strong decision‑making capability, including under pressure and with limited information.
* Ability to lead large teams (\>150 personnel) across multiple locations and time zones.


**Educational Qualifications**
* B.Sc. in an Engineering Discipline or equivalent from an internationally recognized University with 18 years minimum relevant project experience.

 Position Overview:
 




  





 The Technical \& Engineering Director position will be working within the businesses EPC Power \& Digital division, on all MENA data centre project.
 



  





 The role is responsible for the end\-to\-end technical integrity of data centre projects from front\-end definition through to construction handover, ensuring that power, cooling, civil, and ICT systems are designed to hyperscale and colocation standards and are fully constructable and operable at commissioning.
 



  





 Working in close alignment with the EPC Chief Operations Officer the Technical \& Engineering Director serves as the day\-to\-day technical authority on assigned projects, owning design standards, discipline coordination, OEM interfaces, and technical risk management across the full delivery lifecycle.
 



  





 Some travel to construction sites across MENA will be required when necessary.
 



  






 Key Responsibilities:
 




  




* Lead multi\-disciplinary engineering teams across power, cooling, civil/structural, and ICT disciplines
* Own technical standards and design basis documentation through to FEED
* Ensure all designs are constructable, installation logic aligned, and ready for site execution
* Manage inter discipline coordination and clash resolution using 3D plant modelling tools (REVIT, etc.)
* Oversee HV/MV/LV power architecture design including utility intake, MV switchgear, transformers, and LV distribution
* Manage UPS, battery storage, and generator system design and OEM interfaces
* Ensure power redundancy models are correctly implemented, targeting AI\-ready campuses
* Coordinate protection, metering, and power quality studies with specialist consultants
* Lead cooling system design including air\-side economization, chillers, air cooling, and liquid cooling for high\-density AI compute
* Target PUE benchmarks in line with hyperscale client requirements; industry benchmark for AI campuses is 1\.2–1\.4 PUE
* Oversee plumbing, drainage, HVAC, and fire suppression system design and integration
* Interface with energy modelling teams to validate system performance and efficiency projections
* Manage civil and structural design scope including foundations, raised floor systems, data halls, and façade
* Ensure structural designs accommodate equipment loadings, seismic considerations, and phased capacity expansion
* Oversee M\&E services coordination within building fabric to eliminate site clashes and rework
* Oversee ICT infrastructure design including structured cabling, fiber backbone, and carrier\-neutral meet\-me rooms
* Ensure DCIM\-readiness is embedded in design from the outset to support operational efficiency post\-handover
* Coordinate with network operators and hyperscale clients on connectivity and meet\-me room requirements
* Engage the commissioning team from FEED stage to ensure testability and safe energization sequences are designed in
* Define and review CX documentation including CX plans, ITPs, FAT and SAT procedures
* Ensure technical handover packages are complete, accurate, and meet client O\&M requirements
* Embed safety by design principles across all engineering disciplines
* Own HAZOP/HAZID planning and chairing, ensuring action close\-out is tracked
* Manage quality assurance processes for design deliverables including review gates, checking, and sign\-off
* Act as primary technical interface with hyperscale and colocation clients during design development
* Lead technical clarification meetings with clients, authorities, and utility providers

* Degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related discipline (BEng / MEng)

* Demonstrated experience delivering hyperscale or large\-scale colocation data centre projects

* Strong cooling systems experience
* Proven ability to lead multi\-disciplinary design teams of 10\+ engineers
* Experience with FEL/FEED\-driven delivery models
* Proficiency in design tools including AutoCAD, REVIT, or equivalent
* Working experience in the Middle East or comparable international markets
* LEED, BREEAM, or equivalent sustainability certification experience
* Familiarity with hyperscale client design standards (Google, Microsoft Azure, Meta, AWS, Oracle)

data.jd_text:
**Tax Analyst \& Senior Tax Analyst**




**Job Title: Tax Analyst**




**Department: Advance Tax Rulings Section, Tax Policy Department** 




**Role purpose** 




 To deliver high\-quality technical analysis, research, and drafting that supports timely and consistent Advance Tax Ruling (ATR) decisions. The postholder will contribute to the full case lifecycle, ensuring analytical accuracy, procedural consistency and effective collaboration across technical and operational teams.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 



1. **Technical support and drafting**


* Analyze ruling applications and supporting documentation to identify key issues.
* Research and interpret tax legislation, regulations, guidance, and relevant case law.
* Draft rulings, issue lists, and technical memoranda under the supervision of the Senior Tax Analyst.
* Prepare concise and well\-referenced summaries and comparative analyses.



  




1. **Case execution and collaboration**


* Coordinate with the Case Manager in ensuring completeness, document version control, and adherence to deadlines.
* Liaise with applicants to clarify information requests and coordinate responses for additional documentation.
* Prepare ruling case packs, meeting minutes, and decision logs for Senior Tax Analyst review.



  




1. **Quality and knowledge management**


* Apply approved templates, citations, and style guides consistently.
* Maintain and tag technical materials for future reference in the knowledge base.
* Track similar rulings to promote consistency and identify emerging policy trends.



  





**Skills and Experience:** 




**Essential** 



* A certified Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field, such as Law, Accounting, Taxation, Finance, Economics, Public Administration.
* Minimum of four years of experience in tax advisory, tax administration, or tax policy.
* Strong understanding of domestic tax laws, regional tax frameworks, and administrative practice.
* Proven analytical and legal interpretation skills and attention to detail.
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with legal, policy or audit teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication in Arabic and proficiency in English.



  





**Desirable** 



* Professional certifications such as CPA, ADIT, or CTA.
* Exposure to project management and information security basics.



  





**Core competencies** 



* Analytical rigor and research discipline.
* Clear and concise drafting with accurate citation.
* Proactive communication and effective team collaboration.
* Professional judgment, integrity and confidentiality.
* Reliability and adaptability under pressure and shifting priorities.



  





  





**Job Title: Senior Tax Analyst**




**Department: Advance Tax Rulings Section, Tax Policy Department** 




**Role purpose** 




 The Senior Tax Analyst is responsible for leading the technical review and drafting of Advance Tax Rulings (ATRs), ensuring accuracy, consistency, and alignment with Qatari tax law and procedural standards. The postholder provides expert analysis, mentors junior analysts, and contributes to the quality, efficiency, and integrity of the rulings process
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 



1. **Technical analysis and drafting**


* Lead the technical assessment of ruling applications, ensuring comprehensive analysis of facts and evidence.
* Interpret legislation, executive regulations, guidance, and relevant case law to support conclusions with validation and clear rationale.
* Draft technically sound high quality rulings and supporting memoranda, articulating options, risks, and impact of precedents.
* Identify information gaps and frame targeted clarification questions for applicants.



  




1. **Collaboration and review**


* Work closely with the Case Manager to ensure completeness, accuracy and adherence to case milestones.
* Coordinate with Legal Counsel, Audit, Policy, and Transfer Pricing specialists on cross\-functional cases.
* Review, augment and consolidate the draft work produced by Tax Analysts into a single structured package for Legal Counsel and Head of Section feedback.



  




1. **Hearings and stakeholder engagement**


* Participate in technical discussions, hearings and briefings, presenting findings clearly and objectively.
* Lead the preparation and delivery of concise technical briefings to the Head of Section .
* Contribute to controlled publication and redaction where applicable.



  




1. **Quality, governance, and improvement**


* Apply approved templates, citation standards, and documentation protocols consistently.
* Monitor the consistency of treatment across similar rulings to ensure fairness and legal soundness.
* Recommend updates to guidance materials, FAQs, and procedural templates based on case experience and emerging issues.



  





**Skills and Experience:** 




**Essential** 



* A certified Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field, such as Law, Accounting, Taxation, Finance, Economics, and Public Administration.
* Minimum seven years of experience in tax advisory, tax administration, or tax policy.
* In\-depth knowledge of domestic tax laws and related regulations, regional tax frameworks, international standards, and administrative practice.
* Strong legal interpretation and analytical skills with the ability to frame issues logically and persuasively.
* Excellent drafting ability, including clear reasoning and defensible conclusions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in Arabic with proficiency in English.
* Demonstrated experience working collaboratively with legal, policy or audit teams.



  





**Desirable** 



* CPA, ADIT, CTA, or an equivalent.



  





**Core competencies** 



* Technical depth with pragmatic judgment.
* Structured thinking and precision in drafting.
* Coaching and mentoring of junior staff.
* Integrity, confidentiality, and professional independence.
* Effective time management and Service Level Agreement discipline.

data.jd_text:
**Overview**
 University of Doha for Science and Technology (UDST) was officially established by the Emiri Decision No13 of 2022, and it is the first national university specializing in academic applied, technical, and professional education in the State of Qatar. UDST has over 70 bachelor's and master's degree programs, diplomas, and certificates. The university houses 5 colleges: The College of Business, the College of Computing and Information Technology, the College of Engineering and Technology, the College of Health Sciences, and the College of General Education, in addition to specialized training centers for individuals and companies. UDST is recognized for its student\-centered learning and state\-of\-the\-art facilities. Its world\-renowned faculty and researchers work on developing the students’ skills and help raise well\-equipped graduates who proudly serve different sectors of the economy and contribute to achieving human, social, and economic development goals nationally and internationally.
   

  

 With more than 700 staff and over 8,000 students, UDST is the destination of choice for applied and experiential learning. The University is recognized for its student\-centered learning and state\-of\-the\-art facilities. Our faculty are committed to delivering pedagogically\-sound learning experiences that incorporate innovative learning technologies. Our aim is to enhance students’ skills and help develop talented graduates who can effectively contribute to a knowledge\-based economy and make Qatar’s National Vision 2030 a reality.
   

  

 Our eligible employees enjoy competitive compensation and benefits, in accordance with applicable UDST policies. These benefits include:
   

  

* Generous academic annual leave
* Tax free salary
* Fully furnished upmarket accommodation (inclusive of utilities: water \& electricity)
* Annual flights for spouse and 3 children (up to 18 years old)
* Children’s education allowance
* Relocation/Shipping allowance
* Professional development opportunities
* International health insurance
* In\-house immigration services (to help you through the residency process)
* Full access to our recreational facilities
* Research and professional development support.


 The College of Health Sciences invites applications for Midwifery faculty at Lecturer rank.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 Applicants must meet all essential qualifications in order to be shortlisted for the position; other qualifications may be a deciding factor in selection. Qualifications and experience will be assessed through your application, which may include but not be limited to curricula vitae, cover letters, references, teaching dossiers and sample publications. It is the applicant’s responsibility to provide appropriate examples that illustrate how s/he meets each requirement. Failing to do so could result in the application being rejected. We thank all applicants for applying for the role; only those selected for further consideration will be contacted.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Your Commitment**
 Reporting to the Department Head, the successful candidate will be responsible for the development, delivery and evaluation of a broad range of courses within the midwifery domain. She will evaluate student progress and manage the resources of the learning environment. The successful candidate will liaise with industry and other educational institutions; participate in industry advisory committees and coordinate, manage and control projects within the specified program area. Faculty members will keep course portfolio documents required for accreditation processes and engage in instructional development/improvement plans. All employees are expected to contribute to professional and community life within the University and beyond.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Education and Experience Requirements**
 Faculty members will be placed in the appropriate rank based on their education and experience. The broad criteria are noted below.
   

  

**Education**
* A Master’s in Midwifery is preferred.
* All candidates must hold registration as a registered midwife and be in good standing with the regulatory body.


**Experience**
* Preference given to those with experience teaching midwifery practice in a post\-secondary institution and/or mentoring/precepting midwifery students during practice practicums.
* Master’s prepared candidates must have a minimum of Three (3\) years full\-time equivalent to recent clinical practice experience
* Undergraduate prepared candidates must have a minimum of five (5\) years full\-time equivalent to recent clinical practice experience.
* Demonstrate the ability to use diverse and current teaching approaches for practice, experiences including the laboratory, simulation, and practicums.
* Demonstrate academic and information literacy skills.


**Scholarship and Research**
* Demonstrated aptitude for scholarship that contributes to the advancement of teaching and learning of midwifery practice.
* Demonstrated aptitude to use a variety of educational technology and platforms.


**Other Required Skills**
* Commitment to applied and experiential learning as a pedagogy and a key feature of UDST’s mandate.
* Ability to design, develop, deliver, and evaluate authentic learning experiences and assessments incorporating contemporary tools and resources to maximize content learning in context and to develop the knowledge, skills, and attitudes identified in program outcomes.
* Digital literacy and demonstrated fluency in technology systems, and an ability to model and facilitate use of current and emerging digital tools to support research and learning.
* Demonstrated ability to develop technology\-enriched learning environments that enable students to be active participants in their own learning.
* Commitment to the effectiveness, vitality, and self\-renewal of the teaching profession through self\-driven continuous professional development and life\-long learning.
* Effective oral and written communication skills.
* Collaborative and collegial spirit and a demonstrated ability to establish rapport with learners, colleagues, sponsor\-employers, and members of the community.
* Experience in leadership and innovation in technology\-based projects.

data.jd_text:
**Head of Faculty of English**
**Compass International School Doha, Qatar**
 Compass was established in 2006 to provide a premium British education to both expatriate and local Qatari families. We have three campuses; Al Themaid and Madinat Khalifa educate students from Early Years through to Secondary whereas Gharaffa is a stand\-alone Primary campus for children aged 3\-11\. All campuses offer a bespoke British curriculum. Secondary students can select from a wide range of IGSEs, AS and A levels. Additionally, we offer the prestigious IB Diploma Programme in Years 12 and 13\. All three sites offer a warm, friendly learning environment with our students at the heart of everything we do. We are proud of our outstanding teachers and our community feel. As for Qatar, a sunny climate year\-round and an airport with fantastic global connections ensures the continued popularity of this destination for expats.
   

  

 Our school has Qatar National Schools Accreditation (QNSA) and is a member of the British Schools in the Middle East (BSME), COBIS and AoBSO.
   

  

 To learn more about our school, please visit our website
   

  

**About You**
 You will be an exemplary teaching practitioner, with the ability to become an outstanding Head of Faculty. Together with the Senior Leadership Team, you will work to develop a vision for excellence and continual improvement at Compass. You must have the ability to lead and manage people by creating a culture where colleagues are both supported and challenged to deliver the best possible learning experience for students. You should be capable of developing a highly motivated team by nurturing positive working relationships built on respect, trust, support, and recognition. You will lead improvement through rigorous self\-evaluation of faculty performance and use quality assurance feedback to identify improvement priorities moving forward. You should already demonstrate excellent management skills such as resource management, curriculum planning, data analysis, performance tracking, task delegation and the organisation of meetings.
   

  

 You will be asked to lead a learning culture where students are supported, challenged, and inspired to be the best they can be \- students in classes across the faculty will believe there are no limits to what can be achieved. Your excellent motivation and communication skills enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within all lessons across the department.
   

  

 Receptive to feedback and ready to embrace change, you will be keen to share best practice with colleagues and peers. As a strong ambassador for the school, you will be able to develop new ways to engage students and parents across Secondary school, and the wider Nord Anglia Education communities. Your strong motivation and communication skills will also enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within the classroom.
   

  

 You will have the following essential attributes:
   

  

  

* 
+ university degree in a relevant specialist subject
+ teaching qualification (QTS, PGCE/PDGE)
+ teaching experience in a UK and/or international context
+ strong working knowledge of the English national curriculum as relevant to your subject


 You will also be able to meet visa\-related restrictions for Qatar, including possession of a Bachelor's degree and a teaching qualification from a face\-to\-face (non\-online) course.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Join our dynamic international education environment, where you will lead the delivery of a bespoke Secondary curriculum, built on the English National Curriculum and preparing student at Al Themaid for external examinations at IGSCE. You will lead the development of a culture in which students are challenged to be ambitious learners and teachers are required to be innovative to enhance the student experience and outcomes.
   

  

 Your educational philosophy will equip you to meet the needs of all learners, including those who have English as a second language, and you must be able to teach students with a range of prior achievement, knowledge, and skills. Your expertise and planning adaptability will allow you to map out pathways for all students to progress in your subject, creating opportunities for all learners to achieve success based on individualised targets. You will contribute to good practice by demonstrating a collegiate approach to departmental development and sharing strategies with colleagues.
   

  

 As Head of Faculty, you will be responsible for leading the planning, delivery and evaluation of the curriculum, teaching and learning, assessment, reporting and for the professional development of teachers in your team.
   

  

 Please refer to the job description of the role for the following information:
   

  

  

* 
+ Job purpose
+ Reporting to
+ Key relationships
+ Key results areas
+ Performance measurement


**Benefits**
 Nord Anglia Education is the world's leading premium schools organisation. We are a fast\-paced and growing family of 80\+ international schools in China, Europe, the Middle East, South\-East Asia and The Americas, providing outstanding education to over 90,000 students from preschool to 18 years of age. Our schools are united by one philosophy\-we are ambitious for our students, our people, our community and family of schools. This means that we want every student to achieve more in our schools, than in any other schools in the world. We ensure this through personalised learning enhanced with bespoke global opportunities such as Juilliard, MIT and UNICEF. We learn from the best and with the best.
   

  

 We offer you unsurpassed opportunities to innovate and develop best practice across our family, to access extensive professional development, and to gain exceptional experience and career development in our schools. At Nord Anglia, you will have opportunities to progress more, learn more, and collaborate more.
   

  

 We offer a professional working environment and an attractive remuneration \& benefits package.
   

  

 Alongside great training and a competitive package, you'll enjoy the chance to live and work in a rapidly growing country which is perhaps best known for successfully hosting the World Cup in 2022\. Qatar is a great place to be based for travel and enjoys a lovely climate most of the year.
   

  

**Essential**
**Experience / Qualifications Sought** 
  

  

  

* 
+ A university degree in English or a related subject
+ A teaching qualification (QTS)
+ At least 5 years of teaching experience within the British curriculum


**Desirable** 
  

  

  

* 
+ Prior middle leadership experience, for example as a Head of Subject
+ Master's degree, or other significant professional development
+ Previous international experience


**Personal Qualities Sought** 
  

  

  

* 
+ Fluent English speaker
+ Values\-led approach; integrity and honesty are paramount
+ Reliability, loyalty and commitment
+ Personal confidence and presence
+ Energetic and positive with a ‘can\-do' approach
+ Strong interpersonal skills
+ Effective communication skills, both orally and in writing
+ Approachable to all; able to show respect and display cultural sensitivity
+ Sense of humour and grace under pressure
+ Ability to understand complex issues and solve problems
+ Able to manage own time and prioritise; organized
+ Flexible and adaptable; able to handle uncertainty
+ Able to delegate effectively


**To apply**
 The application should be submitted online via the Nord Anglia Education Careers page.
   

  

 Online applications should contain a CV, a two\-page letter of application, and the details of three professional references, one of which should be a School Principal.
   

  

**Start date:** 
 1st August 2025
   

  

 The closing date for applications is
 **30th June 2026\.**
**Selection process**
 Interviews will be conducted face to face or via Teams.
   

  

 Candidates are encouraged to apply early as the school reserves the right to appoint before the closing date.
   

  

 At Nord Anglia Education we are committed to providing a world class, safe, happy environment in which children and young people are able to thrive and learn. We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all our pupils irrespective of race, ability, religion, gender or culture.
   

  

 All post holders in regulated activity (having regular unsupervised contact with children) are subject to appropriate national and international vetting procedures including satisfactory criminal record checks from both Country of residence/birth and any Country of residence within the last 10 years.

Your strong motivation and communication skills will also enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within the classroom.
   

  

**You Will Have The Following Essential Attributes** 
  

  

* 
+ university degree in a relevant specialist subject
+ teaching qualification (QTS, PGCE/PDGE)
+ teaching experience in a UK and/or international context
+ strong working knowledge of the English national curriculum as relevant to your subject


 You will also be able to meet visa\-related restrictions for Qatar, including possession of a Bachelor’s degree and a teaching qualification from a face\-to\-face (non\-online) course.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Join our dynamic international education environment, where you will lead the delivery of a bespoke Secondary curriculum, built on the English National Curriculum and preparing student at Al Themaid for external examinations at IGSCE. You will lead the development of a culture in which students are challenged to be ambitious learners and teachers are required to be innovative to enhance the student experience and outcomes.
   

  

 Your educational philosophy will equip you to meet the needs of all learners, including those who have English as a second language, and you must be able to teach students with a range of prior achievement, knowledge, and skills. Your expertise and planning adaptability will allow you to map out pathways for all students to progress in your subject, creating opportunities for all learners to achieve success based on individualised targets. You will contribute to good practice by demonstrating a collegiate approach to departmental development and sharing strategies with colleagues.
   

  

 As Head of Faculty, you will be responsible for leading the planning, delivery and evaluation of the curriculum, teaching and learning, assessment, reporting and for the professional development of teachers in your team.
   

  

 Please refer to the job description of the role for the following information:
   

  

* 
+ Job purpose
+ Reporting to
+ Key relationships
+ Key results areas
+ Performance measurement


**Benefits**
 Nord Anglia Education is the world’s leading premium schools organisation. We are a fast\-paced and growing family of 80\+ international schools in China, Europe, the Middle East, South\-East Asia and The Americas, providing outstanding education to over 90,000 students from preschool to 18 years of age. Our schools are united by one philosophy—we are ambitious for our students, our people, our community and family of schools. This means that we want every student to achieve more in our schools, than in any other schools in the world. We ensure this through personalised learning enhanced with bespoke global opportunities such as Juilliard, MIT and UNICEF. We learn from the best and with the best.
   

  

 We offer you unsurpassed opportunities to innovate and develop best practice across our family, to access extensive professional development, and to gain exceptional experience and career development in our schools. At Nord Anglia, you will have opportunities to progress more, learn more, and collaborate more.
   

  

 We offer a professional working environment and an attractive remuneration \& benefits package.
   

  

 Alongside great training and a competitive package, you’ll enjoy the chance to live and work in a rapidly growing country which is perhaps best known for successfully hosting the World Cup in 2022\. Qatar is a great place to be based for travel and enjoys a lovely climate most of the year.
   

  

**Essential**
**Experience / Qualifications Sought** 
  

  

* 
+ A university degree in English or a related subject
+ A teaching qualification (QTS)
+ At least 5 years of teaching experience within the British curriculum


**Desirable** 
  

  

* 
+ Prior middle leadership experience, for example as a Head of Subject
+ Master’s degree, or other significant professional development
+ Previous international experience


**Personal Qualities Sought** 
  

  

* 
+ Fluent English speaker
+ Values\-led approach; integrity and honesty are paramount
+ Reliability, loyalty and commitment
+ Personal confidence and presence
+ Energetic and positive with a ‘can\-do’ approach
+ Strong interpersonal skills
+ Effective communication skills, both orally and in writing
+ Approachable to all; able to show respect and display cultural sensitivity
+ Sense of humour and grace under pressure
+ Ability to understand complex issues and solve problems
+ Able to manage own time and prioritise; organized
+ Flexible and adaptable; able to handle uncertainty
+ Able to delegate effectively


**To apply**
 The application should be submitted online via the Nord Anglia Education Careers page.
   

  

 Online applications should contain a CV, a two\-page letter of application, and the details of three professional references, one of which should be a School Principal.
   

  

**Start date:** 
 1st August 2025
   

  

 The closing date for applications is
 **30th June 2026\.**
**Selection process**
 Interviews will be conducted face to face or via Teams.
   

  

 Candidates are encouraged to apply early as the school reserves the right to appoint before the closing date.
   

  

 At Nord Anglia Education we are committed to providing a world class, safe, happy environment in which children and young people are able to thrive and learn. We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all our pupils irrespective of race, ability, religion, gender or culture.
   

  

 All post holders in regulated activity (having regular unsupervised contact with children) are subject to appropriate national and international vetting procedures including satisfactory criminal record checks from both Country of residence/birth and any Country of residence within the last 10 years.

 Join us in shaping the future of banking!
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Working closely with the Head of Wealth Management and Head of Wealth Products, this role is responsible for management of existing suite of wealth products and customer portfolio. Additionally, it involves ongoing innovative enhancement of the Wealth Management CVP across different segments of customers. This would include internal product development, research, third\-party product supplier management, product pricing and maintenance from concept through to full delivery to market. In addition, the role will require continuous interaction with multiple internal and external stakeholders across the Bank to ensure seamless functioning of the business and achievement of financial and non\-financial KPIs.

* A strong Commitment to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion, fostering a culture that values every individual’s unique perspective

 approach to redefine banking through
