**Your day to day**
* Ensures all food is prepared fresh and is of the highest quality
* Ensure the correct preparation and presentation of dishes in accordance with menu cards and produced on a consistent basis.
* Strictly adheres to all recipes, methods and instructions from supervisor.
* Consistently checks temperatures in foods and follows proper procedures in regards to chilling, re\-heating, and holding food.
* Checks outlet upon arrival to determine status of outstanding safety, or equipment issues
* Checks outlet prior to leaving to ensure cleanliness, proper disposal/removal of food, and proper storing and labeling
* Responsible for accuracy in daily inventories and requisitions.
* Assist the Head Chef in controlling and analyzing on an on\-going basis, the following:
* Quality levels of production and presentation, including employee cafeteria.
* Guest Satisfaction.
* Merchandising and promotions.
* Operating, Payroll, Food costs according to budget.
* Sanitation, Cleanliness and Hygiene.
* Food photo sessions for all new menus – set standard.
* Maintenance of recipe cards for all menu items.
* Staff attendance, rosters
* Assist in production, preparation and presentation of all food items to ensure highest quality at all times.
* Supervise and control the kitchen to meet work requirements.
* Assist Head Chef with inspections of physical of kitchen areas including cold rooms and equipment.
* Assumes responsibilities of Head Chef in his absence.
* Assist in the preparation and testing of outlet and promotional menus following the guidelines: Requirements, competition, trends, recipes, potential cost, availability.
* Maintain and keep up to date training record.
* Ensure team members are informed about new procedures, special events in the hotel, daily functions and food cost and to received feedback.
* Ensure hygiene and sanitation, all precautions on Fire, Health and Safety are taken in the kitchen and that all employees are will trained in this aspect.
* Display good time management techniques with proper planning and control.
* Strives to continuously improve flow of production
* Check regularly perishable food items received for quantity and quality standards.
* Assist Head Chef in the planning \& ordering of food stock in accordance with the volume of business.
* Perform related duties and special projects as assigned.


**FINANCIAL RETURN**
* Assist the Head Chef in supervising the functioning of all Kitchen employees’ facilities and costs to ensure maximum Food \& Beverage departmental profit is achieved.
* Controls and decreases waste by maintaining logs to submit daily/weekly
* Observe and comply with the company’s requisition and purchase order system


**RESPONSIBLE BUSINESS**
* Comply with and ensure adherence to all of the hotel’s policies and procedures
* Comply with all occupational health and safety policies and procedures
* Attend all scheduled meetings
* Inform on a daily basis the Head Chef of all relevant information in operational matters including information, which does not require the Head Chef’s action.
* Liaise with F \& B Controls for food costing, ordering and supply.
* Liaise with departmental heads for co\-ordination of functions and activities.
* Coordinate with kitchen stewarding for proper sanitation, maintenance of equipment, cleaning of cold stores, supply of service dishes, during service hours.
* Maintain a good working relationship with all staff and colleagues throughout the hotel and sister properties.
* Maintain in good working order all hotel property.
* Maintain a positive and professional attitude at all times


**PEOPLE**
* Assist scheduling of kitchen staff to ensure proper cover of shift as per business requirements.
* Recommend increments, promotion and transfer of chefs to Head Chef and under his guidance conduct such functions as employee orientation, coaching and supervision, if necessary, to ensure appropriate productivity.
* Assist Head Chef in conducting formal on\-the\-job training session for kitchen employees.
* Utilize coaching skills and demonstrate the development of other team members.


**GENERAL**
* Communicate effectively with all other departments
* Attend meetings, training sessions and any other required meeting or training session.
* Identify opportunities to innovate service delivery and product offering to meet and exceed client expectations.
* Ensure safe work practices are adopted at all time and report any OHS concerns immediately to your direct manager or HR Manager.
* Ensure consistency in quality of appearance and taste, and the best quality menus using the freshest ingredients.
* Effectively participate in the organization of ordering, cost controlling and wastage of food.
* Lead by example and ensure all procedures (HACCP, Health and Safety, and Food Safety Management) are maintained to the required standards to which training has been received, and are being followed by all kitchen members.
* Manage and deliver the production needs of the kitchen to the required standards.
* Manage time through effective planning of work, maintaining a high level of productivity.
* Achieve customer satisfaction rating of above expectations.
* Meet maximum creativity and understanding of food, by creating dishes and assisting with menu development.
* Assigned projects are completed within designated timeframes
* Reports, presentations and other administrative duties are consistently on a high standard; and free of errors and omissions.


**What We Need From You**
**PERSONAL CHARACTERISTICS**
**Education**
* Formal Hospitality Management qualifications in Culinary Institute– desirable
* Completion and awarded Intermediate Food Hygiene Certification
* Completion and awarded HACCP Certification


**Experience**
* At least 5 years previous experience in a hotel or branded units
* Minimum 2 years in similar capacity
* Experience in a high cover International /Mediterranean cuisine
* Knowledge in preparation of all Pastry and bakery products and all culinary operations.
* Knowledge of volume production and ability to maintain the highest quality standards.


**Technical**
* Competent Word, Excel, PowerPoint and software packages
* Competent Oral and Written Communication Skills
* Ability to follow standards recipes and convert quantities mathematically
* Ability to taste all foods to assure correct preparation
* Knowledge of stock control, rotas and budgetary controls


**Personal Attributes**
* ‘Can do’ attitude and a high level of energy
* Professionally groomed
* Able to manage task simultaneously; and priorities
* Flexible and aware of the pressure points within the kitchen environment and adapt to each situation with maturity and calmness.
* Hands\-on attitude, leads by example
* Always goes the extra mile to ensure guests satisfaction.


 Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

data.jd_text:
**JOB PURPOSE:** 




  





 The IND Head, Qatar leads the Industry \& Energy TIC business within the assigned geography, with full accountability for strategy, growth, profitability, and customer satisfaction across upstream, downstream, power, and renewable energy sectors. This role drives end\-to\-end business performance — from tendering and contract negotiation to project delivery and asset lifecycle management — ensuring operational excellence, safety, and compliance across all activities. The position requires deep understanding of CAPEX project execution, commissioning, shutdowns, turnarounds, and asset integrity programs within complex industrial environments. The Industry Manager serves as the face of Bureau Veritas, representing its values of Trust, Responsibility, Ambition, and Ethics, and positioning the company as the preferred TIC partner for critical energy infrastructure.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




  





**Strategic Leadership \& P\&L Management** 



* Define and execute the Industry \& Energy business strategy across Oil \& Gas (upstream, midstream, downstream), Power, Utilities, and Renewables.
* Own full P\&L responsibility, delivering revenue growth, profitability, and cash targets.
* Develop and manage annual sales, revenue, and profit budgets aligned with company goals.
* identify and capture growth opportunities in major CAPEX projects, operating assets, and new energy transitions (hydrogen, CCUS, solar, wind, nuclear, etc.).
* Integrate digital inspection, condition monitoring, and asset performance technologies to strengthen service differentiation.



  





**Business Development, Tendering \& Contracting** 




  




* Lead opportunity identification, bid preparation, tender response, and contract finalization for complex industrial projects.
* Work closely with sales, marketing, and operations to build winning proposals for EPCs, operators, and utilities.
* Negotiate commercial terms and manage key frame agreements and long\-term service contracts.
* Maintain direct access to C\-suite and senior stakeholders within client organizations and industry bodies.
* Develop partnerships and local alliances to expand market reach and achieve business growth.



  





**Operational Excellence \& Project Delivery** 



* Oversee safe, timely, and high\-quality delivery of all testing, inspection, and certification services across:
* CAPEX project phases: engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and start\-up
* Operations phases: asset integrity management, shutdowns, turnarounds, maintenance, reliability, and life extension programs
* Ensure compliance with international codes, client specifications, and local regulatory frameworks.
* Drive operational efficiency, standardization, and productivity across sites, labs, and field teams.
* Monitor delivery KPIs (on\-time completion, utilization, safety performance, customer feedback) and act decisively on deviations.
* Champion a customer\-centric delivery model recognized for quality and reliability.



  





**EXPERIENCE:** 




  




* 15\+ years professional work experience, preferably in the following areas:
* Design, Operations and Maintenance in the Oil \& Gas, Power and Utilities, and Renewables sectors
* Testing, Inspection \& Certification (TIC) services
* Business development activities
* Sales and Marketing experience



  





**EDUCATION:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical discipline (Master’s preferred).
* Additional qualifications in Business Administration, Project Management, or Maintenance and Asset Integrity desirable

A Qatar\-based diversified investment holding group operating across five core business verticals: Infrastructure \& Contracting Ventures, Property Development, Hospitality \& Healthcare, Financial Services, and a Services Group encompassing Manpower, Facilities Management, and Catering. With an active and growing footprint across the Middle East, Africa, Central Asia, and beyond — including operations in Saudi Arabia, Iraq, Libya, Syria, Algeria, Egypt, Kazakhstan, Rwanda, the Maldives, Albania, and Venezuela — the Group is at an exciting stage of strategic transformation and expansion.
 



  





***Role Overview***




 The Sr. Analyst, Corporate Development is a high\-visibility, strategically critical role sitting within the Corporate Development Office. We are hiring two Senior Analysts who will share the same mandate — supporting the Group's strategic agenda and driving cross\-vertical initiatives — but with distinct areas of focus. Both roles report to the Sr. Director, Corporate Development, and will report directly to the Holding CEO on an interim basis until the Sr. Director is onboarded.
 



 The ideal candidate brings 7–8 years of experience from a Big 4 consulting firm (Deloitte, PwC, EY, or KPMG) or equivalent top\-tier strategy practice, with a proven ability to operate in large, multi\-sector organisations.

 ● Strategy Development \& Business Planning
 



 ● Business Case Development \& Financial Modelling
 



 ● Strategic Initiatives Custodian across the Group
 



 ● Group\-level Strategic Performance Tracking
 



  





***Sr. Analyst B — Transformation***




 ● Business Transformation \& Programme Delivery
 



 ● Change Management \& Adoption
 



 ● Operational Optimisation \& Process Improvement
 



 ● Margin Enhancement across Business Verticals
 



  





***Key Responsibilities***




  





**Shared Mandate (Both Roles)** 




 ● Support the Corporate Development Office in executing the Group's strategic agenda across all five business verticals.
 



 ● Engage with senior business leaders and subsidiary management to drive Group\-wide initiatives and ensure strategic alignment.
 



 ● Prepare high\-quality executive presentations and strategic briefings for the Sr. Director and Holding CEO.
 



 ● Coordinate with external advisors and Big 4 partners engaged on Group workstreams.
 



  





**Sr. Analyst A — Strategy, Business Planning \& Modelling** 




 ● Lead the development and maintenance of the Group's corporate strategy framework, ensuring alignment across all verticals.
 



 ● Own the annual business planning cycle, coordinating inputs from subsidiaries and consolidating into Group\-level plans.
 



 ● Build robust financial models and business cases to support investment decisions, new ventures, and strategic initiatives.
 



 ● Act as the custodian of strategic initiatives across the Group — tracking progress, flagging risks, and ensuring delivery accountability.
 



 ● Conduct market and competitive analyses to identify growth opportunities and inform strategic priorities.
 



 ● Benchmark Group performance against regional and global peers to support evidence\-based decision\-making.

data.jd_text:
**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The incumbent will supervise all Money Market activities for the Group’s international operations in a cost\-effective manner in accordance with the Group’s strategy, risk appetite, regulatory requirements, policies and procedures and the delegated authority.
   

  

 Main Responsibilities

**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Purpose Summary**
 The incumbent will manage the entire research, analysis, market intelligence, co\-ordination and finalisation of QNB economic reports, along with other monthly deliverables and other ad hoc requests. We are seeking an exceptional
 **Head of Treasury** 
 to join our executive leadership team. This is a high\-impact role with direct accountability for restructuring and optimising the Group's debt capital structure, leading syndicated loan facilities with international banks, and building a world\-class treasury function that supports our multi\-vertical, multi\-geography growth strategy.
 



 The successful candidate will serve as the Group's primary interface with international banking partners, credit rating agencies, and institutional investors across diverse and often complex operating jurisdictions — ensuring robust liquidity management, financial risk governance, and regulatory compliance at both group and subsidiary level.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**




***Debt Restructuring \& Capital Structure***




 ● Lead end\-to\-end debt restructuring initiatives, optimising the company's capital structure to reduce cost of debt and improve financial flexibility.
 



 ● Develop and execute debt management strategies including refinancing, covenant renegotiation, and balance sheet deleveraging.
 



 ● Oversee the full lifecycle of corporate borrowing facilities, ensuring alignment with business strategy and board\-approved leverage targets.
 



 ● Present debt strategy recommendations to the Holding CEO, Board, and Audit \& Risk Committee.
 



  





***Syndicated Loans \& International Banking Relationships***




 ● Lead the structuring, negotiation, and execution of syndicated loan facilities and bilateral credit agreements with international banking partners.
 



 ● Serve as the primary point of contact for the company's relationship banks, maintaining strong partnerships across global financial institutions.
 



 ● Manage the documentation process for loan agreements in collaboration with legal counsel and external advisors.
 



 ● Monitor compliance with loan covenants and proactively manage lender communications.
 



  





***Liquidity \& Cash Management***




 ● Oversee global cash management, liquidity forecasting, and working capital optimisation across all group entities.
 



 ● Implement and maintain a robust cash pooling structure to maximise internal efficiency and minimise external borrowing.
 



 ● Ensure the company maintains adequate liquidity buffers and committed facilities to meet operational and strategic needs.
 



  





***Risk Management \& Hedging***




 ● Design and implement hedging strategies to mitigate FX, interest rate, and commodity price risks in line with the Board\-approved risk appetite.
 



 ● Manage relationships with derivative counterparties and oversee ISDA documentation.
 



 ● Maintain compliance with treasury risk policies and financial reporting standards (IFRS 9 / hedge accounting).
 



  





***Governance, Reporting \& Strategy***




 ● Develop, implement, and enforce treasury policies, controls, and governance frameworks.
 



 ● Produce high\-quality treasury reporting for the Board, CFO, and external stakeholders including credit rating agencies.
 



 ● Support M\&A activity, capital raises, and other strategic finance initiatives from a treasury perspective.
 



 ● Lead, develop, and mentor the treasury team, fostering a high\-performance culture.
 



  





**Qualifications \& Experience:**




***Essential***




 ● 18\+ years of progressive treasury experience, with at least 8 years in a senior treasury leadership role within a large corporate environment.
 



 ● Proven track record of leading complex debt restructuring programmes and/or refinancing transactions.
 



 ● Demonstrated experience negotiating and closing syndicated loan facilities with international banks.
 



 ● Deep expertise in cash management, liquidity risk, FX hedging, and interest rate risk management.
 



 ● Strong working knowledge of financial instruments, capital markets, and credit documentation (LMA standard preferred).
 



 ● Professional qualification: ACT (AMCT/MCT), CFA, ACA/ACCA, or equivalent.
 



 ● Degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related discipline.
 



***Desirable***




 ● Proficiency with SAP TRM; familiarity with other treasury management systems is an advantage
 



 ● Experience operating within a large conglomerate or diversified holding group, with exposure to multiple business verticals and subsidiaries, preferably including contracting or infrastructure businesses.
 



 ● Prior exposure to treasury operations spanning the GCC, MENA, Africa, Central Asia, or frontier markets — experience in markets such as KSA, Iraq, Libya, Kazakhstan, or similar is a strong advantage.
 



 ● Background in managing treasury across diverse and complex operating jurisdictions, including countries with capital controls, currency restrictions, or limited banking infrastructure.
 



 ● Familiarity with ESG\-linked financing instruments (green bonds, sustainability\-linked loans).
 



 ● Exposure to high\-yield debt markets or leveraged finance structures.
 



 ● Experience interfacing with group\-level governance, intercompany treasury arrangements, and intra\-group lending frameworks across multiple sectors.
 



  





**Leadership \& Competencies**




 ●Strategic Thinking — Ability to translate complex financial dynamics into clear, actionable treasury strategies.
 



 ● Executive Presence — Credible and confident in presenting to Boards, rating agencies, and senior banking partners.
 



 ● Negotiation Skills — Track record of delivering favourable terms in complex, multi\-party banking negotiations.
 



 ● Risk Mindset — Disciplined approach to identifying, quantifying, and mitigating financial risk.
 



 ● People Leadership — Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high\-performing teams.
 



 ● Integrity \& Governance — Highest standards of professional conduct and financial controls.

**Some Careers Shine Brighter Than Others.**
 If you’re looking for a role that will help you stand out at HSBC, take a look at how you can fulfil your potential.
   

  

 HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking (CIB) is an emerging markets\-led, financing\-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long\-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.
   

  

 Credit \& Capital Management Services (CCMS) under CIB are in the process of implementing a new, modern, and consistent E2E operating model. A key component of this operating model is the introduction of a first line credit management office, the Business Credit Office (BCO). The BCO function will complete tasks currently owned by multiple actors in the management of the first line credit risk responsibilities including structuring, credit analysis and rating recommendation, client credit monitoring tasks, credit terms and docs negotiation with WCMR and clients acting as a single handoff from a RM to the BCO for all Credit \& Lending (C\&L) tasks, creating a single control point. The function will be client facing and customer service orientated.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are currently seeking a high caliber professional to join our team as a Country Head of CCM Services \& Lead BCO.
   

  

**In This Role You Will Be Responsilbe For**
* Ensuring CCM OKRs are achieved for their respective market
* Leading the execution and implementation of the BCO function, to efficiently manage the underwriting process across country CIB. The BCO function to be globally leading across the bank, leveraging organizational design capabilities to optimize processes and structures.
* Taking a lead in managing the portfolio and risk exposure partnering with banking teams and WCRM to determine and monitor risk appetite
* Driving policy and procedure simplification / optimization to make the underwriting process more effective with a focus on value\-add activities and creating risk differentiated processes
* Continuously focus on improving the productivity of the function whilst enhancing client experience
* Providing oversight to outsourced credit \& capital management services
* Landing an ambitious multi\-year transformation journey within their market
* Implementing the Target CCM Services Operating Model and delivering financial targets associated with its’ implementation in the market
* Leading risk and control management across the end\-to\-end process
* Manage CCM COO FRP, budgeting and planning processes for the market
* Land locally the transformation and digitisation of the CCM COO journey and lead local initiatives to improve and re\-engineer processes for the market
* Monitor and analyse customer feedback, identifying key areas of focus to significantly improve customer outcomes for the market
* Represent CCM Services in front of market stakeholders and at market forum
* Unify and provide direction to a dislocated set of smaller teams, fostering a sense of unity and purpose and embed the Target CCM services operating model
* Develop and maintain a diverse, innovation\-driven credit and lending workforce, ensuring high levels of engagement and satisfaction.
* Oversee and execute the delivery of CCM services in\-country (where required), ensuring alignment with regional processes and a seamless and efficient process for customers
* Monitor and analyse customer feedback within the market, identifying local areas of focus to improve customer outcomes while ensuring alignment with regional and global priorities.
* Collaborate with global stakeholders, including technology, CCM, WCRM, Legal, the global business Coverage teams, digital channels and products to implement the overall strategy for the wholesale credit and lending journey.
* Implement governance frameworks to ensure risks and issues related to the Credit \& Lending journey are escalated to regional, and global stakeholders and resolved in a satisfactory manner. Monitor the management of financial and non\-financial risks pertaining to the CCM production in partnership with local NFR/Business Risk.
* Act as the local Business Service Owner for Credit \& Lending across CIB, ensuring service resilience. Manage and execute local end\-to\-end processes for Credit \& Lending on behalf of the CIB Business. Monitor and manage local risk and controls across the end\-to\-end controls, meeting all SOX obligations.
* Support the OKR, KPI and SLA management framework within the market, maintaining service management oversight pertaining to both operational and control performance across all CCM CTB \& RTB services end\-to\-end.
* Collaborate with the CCMS Product, Design and Innovation Pillar, technology and transformation teams to execute the technology strategy for CCM, reduce legacy technologies, and drive a culture of innovation by developing cutting\-edge automation, capability, and business solutions leveraging next\-gen technologies, AI, and analytics.
* Manage multiple senior stakeholders with varied and sometimes conflicting agendas, effectively navigating complex situations and driving alignment.
* Maintain a diverse, innovation\-driven credit and lending workforce, ensuring high levels of engagement and satisfaction.


**To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:**
* Extensive years of experience in wholesale credit and lending, with a strong background in coverage, credit management or operations
* Proven track record of leading and managing teams, with experience in organizational design and strategic planning.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate complex situations and drive alignment among senior leaders.
* Expertise in credit risk management, control assessment, and SOX compliance.
* Experience in driving digitisation and customer experience improvement initiatives.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to consume large volumes of customer feedback and distil key areas of focus.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across all levels of the organization.
* Great team player with a positive attitude, energy and enthusiasm.
* Promote a collective culture to spread experience and best practice and live the Group Values.
* Give timely, honest and constructive feedback to others.
* Promotes innovative and lateral thinking approach for devising solutions.
* Bring thought leadership and governance around the internal and external lending ecosystem.
* Deliver fair outcome for our customers and ensure own conduct maintains the orderly and transparent operation of financial markets.
* Highly effective communication skills (oral, written and presentational)
* Ability to work accurately and achieve tight deadlines with limited supervision
* Self\-motivation, and a proven rapid learning capability in a changing environment are essential
* Committed to personal and professional development


 You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
   

  

 www.hsbc.com/careers

**Job Description**
**Tiered Approach**
 In Line With The Commitment To Safeguard Capacity And Support Personnel Already In The Organization, a Majority Of UNDP UNCDF/UNV Vacancies Are Advertised Using a Tiered Application Process Whereby
   

  

* Tier 0: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed\-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026\.
* Tier 1: Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed\-term (FTA) appointments
* Tier 2: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
* Tier 3 or no tier indicated: All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates


 Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.
   

  

**Background**
 The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) Country Office in the Kingdom of Bahrain operates within the context of a high\-income, net\-contributing country, where UNDP engagement is fully funded through government cost\-sharing and aligned with national development priorities. Bahrain is implementing an ambitious national reform agenda under Bahrain Vision 2030 and the Government Programme (2023–2026\), with a strong focus on economic diversification, fiscal sustainability, effective governance, environmental resilience, digital transformation, and inclusive human development. As a net contributor country, UNDP Bahrain maintains a lean operational footprint while delivering high\-value technical assistance, policy advisory services, and innovation\-driven solutions in support of national priorities.
   

  

 UNDP Bahrain’s programme is guided by the Country Programme Document (CPD) 2025–2029, approved by the UNDP Executive Board in January 2025, and is fully aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNSDCF) 2025–2029\. The financial envelope for the 2025–2029 Country Programme Document (CPD) is structured around a total estimated cost of US 2\.5 million for Economic Prosperity (Outcome 1\) and US 5 million for Environmental Sustainability (Outcome 3\). As of late 2025, the Country Office manages seven ongoing projects with a total remaining budget of approximately US$ 1\.8 million. These initiatives are distributed across the three CPD outcomes: Outcome 1 (Economic Prosperity) and Outcome 3 (Environmental Sustainability) each account for about 37–38% of the project count, while Outcome 2 (Governance) makes up the remaining 25%. Notable projects Youth Leadership Program, King Hanad Ward for SDGs, National Human Development Report in partnership with DERASAT. A new generation of projects is expected to be developed under this Outcome.
   

  

 The CPD Positions UNDP As a Trusted Strategic Partner To The Government Of Bahrain, Contributing To UNSDCF Outcomes Through Integrated, Multi\-sectoral Interventions That Address Complex Development Challenges At The Intersection Of Economic Prosperity, Governance And Human Rights, And Environmental Sustainability. Under The Country Programme Document (CPD) 2025–2029, UNDP Bahrain’s Engagement Is Structured Around Three Interrelated CPD Pillars
   

  

 (i) Economic prosperity and sustainable livelihoods;
   

  

 (ii) Effective governance, human rights, and access to justice; and
   

  

 (iii) Environmental sustainability and climate resilience.
   

  

 These pillars reflect national priorities under Bahrain Vision 2030 and the Government Programme (2023–2026\), and constitute UNDP’s substantive contribution to the implementation of the United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNSDCF) 2025–2029\.
   

  

 To ensure coherence, integration, and efficient delivery within a lean Country Office structure, the Bahrain CO operationalizes the three CPD pillars through two integrated programme clusters. The first cluster brings together
 **economic transformation, sustainable livelihoods, and environmental sustainability** 
 , The second cluster focuses on
 **governance, human rights, access to justice, and social inclusion** 
 .
   

  

 This two\-cluster delivery model enables the Country Office to manage complexity, promote synergies across CPD pillars, and apply a portfolio approach to programme design, implementation, and partnerships. Staff are therefore expected to work across thematic boundaries, contribute to integrated solutions, and support joint programming within the UN system, while ensuring results\-based management, quality assurance, and alignment with national and UNSDCF priorities.
   

  

 Under the direct supervision of the Transition Manager (P4\) and overall guidance of the Resident Representative and in close collaboration with the rest of the Country Office programme team, the Programme Analyst \- Governance, Human Rights and Social Inclusion (GHRSI) will manage the oversight, accountability, and coordination of this programme area.
   

  

**The Programme Analyst Is Therefore Entrusted With**
* Contributing to setting the strategic direction of the area and the overarching UNDP Country Office programme as it related to this thematic area.
* Aiding in the management and coordination of the programme portfolio and team.
* Forging and growing broad\-based strategic partnerships, support to resource mobilization and strategic expansion.

 **resource mobilization** 
 to ensure the portfolio's long\-term sustainability.
   

  

 S/he endeavors to integrate the GHRSI cluster with the Economic Prosperity and Environment unit by fostering institutional innovation and evidence\-based public sector management to support a responsive digital economy. This cross\-cutting collaboration focuses on aligning digital transformation policies with international human rights standards and inclusive participation frameworks. Together, both clusters leverage data\-driven policy and statistical capacity building to ensure that innovation pipelines remain equitable and leave no one behind
   

  

 The incumbent also works in strong collaboration with the Regional Hub in Amman, as well as other regional and global UNDP Hubs, and professional and knowledge networks.
   

  

 UNDP personnel are expected to embrace innovative thinking and work across units, functions, teams, and projects in multidisciplinary teams that actively connect knowledge and skills around issues to ensure higher programmatic coherence and drive transformative changes.
   

  

 The incumbent is expected to display innovation, problem solving, trouble shooting, active initiative, and a strong client orientation that encourages and rewards excellence in programme delivery and implementation. S/he might be required to undertake emerging tasks and additional duties as requested by senior management.
   

  

 UNDP adopts a portfolio approach to accommodate changing business needs and leverage linkages across interventions to achieve its strategic goals. Therefore, UNDP personnel are expected to work across units, functions, teams, and projects in multidisciplinary teams in order to enhance and enable horizontal collaboration.

* Ensure implementation of relevant programme Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure the effectiveness of CO business processes.
* Analyze and synthesize proposals in assigned programme areas.
* Provides input into the integrated design of new development interventions (e.g., projects, etc.).
* Liaises with national and international partners, etc. in strategic programme areas of cooperation.
* Engages with colleagues in the Amman Regional Hub and Headquarters to apply in country programming new global and regional initiatives, polices and knowledge products that further the Governance, Human Rights and Social Inclusion programme.
* Ensure effective management of the CO programme within the assigned thematic/sector areas focusing on quality assurance and risk management from formulation to implementation of the country programme:
* Contribute to design and formulation of CO programme, translate UNDP priorities into local interventions, and oversee programme implementation with the implementing partners within the assigned programme areas. Ensure that design and formulation of programme considers societal digital technology risks and opportunities and other future signals.
* Oversee planning, budgeting, implementation and monitoring of the assigned programme areas; and track use of financial resources in accordance with UNDP rules and regulations. Ensure digital technology solutions in programme implementation are managed towards scalability and sustainability in line with UNDP’s digital standards.
* Ensure effective application of results\-based management tools and track achievement of strategic results.
* Ensure the effective use of data in programme implementation, across the data lifecycle; and ensure effective monitoring, evaluation and learning on programme impact.
* Support trends analysis for future informed and anticipatory programming.
* Follow up on audit recommendations and ensure the implementation of management responses.
* Prepare and aggregate reports on activities, outputs and outcomes, including donor and corporate reports.
* Support the rollout of new initiatives and programmes including through presentation of the project to PAC; finalize contribution agreements; and determine required revisions.
* Ensure creation of strategic partnerships and implementation of the resource mobilization strategy:
* Develop partnerships with the UN Agencies, international financial institutions (IFIs), government institutions, donors, private sector (if applicable to CO), and civil society in assigned programme/ thematic areas.
* Identify strategic programme areas of cooperation including joint programming.
* Analyze and research information on donors, prepare substantive briefs on possible areas of cooperation, identify opportunities for initiation of new projects, and substantively contribute to Country office resource mobilization efforts.
* Support development of portfolios and Country office pipeline including through the design of Programme/Project documents, concept notes, proposals, and cross\-sectoral coordination in assigned areas to bring resources for projects.
* Ensure provision of top\-quality advisory services and facilitation of knowledge building and management:

 The General Manager is responsible for overseeing the overall operations, profitability, and strategic growth of the company across all branches. The role includes driving sales performance, managing branch operations, maintaining strong client and supplier relationships, ensuring operational efficiency, and leading teams to achieve company objectives.

 Operations \& Branch Management
 


* Oversee the overall operations of the company and ensure smooth business activities across all branches.

 Sales \& Business Development
 


* Ensure achievement of overall company sales targets, branch targets, and individual sales targets.
* Monitor branch\-wise and overall profitability and implement strategies to improve financial performance.

 Financial \& Collection Oversight
 


* Ensure timely collection of payments and monitor outstanding receivables.

* Strong leadership, communication, and negotiation skills.

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.

 Skills

* Operational Management

data.jd_text:
**1\. Job Purpose** 




  





 To provide administrative support to the Board of Directors and associated committees. Execute streamlining of board communication and collaboration, overseeing logistics, documentation, feedback, planning, and compliance for enhanced governance and organizational success, providing comprehensive support to enhance board performance and uphold standards.
 



  





**2\. Position Accountability Description** 




**Board Operations Management** 




  




1. Formulate and maintain a comprehensive board operations manual to guide activities effectively, ensuring clarity and alignment with organizational objectives and regulatory standards. Incorporate regular staff input for continuous improvements and superior functionality, resulting in a more robust and user\-friendly manual.
2. Collaborate with executive leadership to meticulously draft, review, and finalize board meeting agendas and materials, incorporating feedback, fostering collaboration, and ensuring adherence to governance and compliance requirements.
3. Arrange logistical details for board meetings, meticulously overseeing scheduling, venue selection, catering arrangements, technology setup, and promptly resolving any unforeseen challenges.
4. Provide and distribute meeting materials to board members in advance, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, customization according to preferences, secure distribution channels, and thorough content coverage.
5. Support board affairs director to analyze board meetings to record precise minutes, capturing nuanced discussions, decisions, action items, key points, highlighting follow\-ups, and facilitating efficient dissemination and implementation of outcomes.
6. Distribute prepared action plans coming out of the board \& committees meetings to relevant parties and follow up on the implementation of action plans.



  





**Document and Information Management** 




  




1. Track an organized repository of board documents meticulously, ensuring systematic categorization, version control, security protocols, accessible data, confidentiality, and streamlined retrieval processes for enhanced operational efficiency.
2. Undertake board member onboarding processes strategically, offering tailored induction sessions, facilitating informed access to pertinent resources, enabling seamless integration, fostering relationships, aligning with strategic goals, and promoting engagement.
3. Contribute to and collect detailed feedback from directors to compile comprehensive reports, analyzing insights, trends, performance metrics, and areas for improvement, and presenting synthesized recommendations for concerned committee review and strategic decision\-making.
4. Analyze board member evaluations and self\-assessment processes, compiling results, identifying areas for improvement, and recommending development opportunities to enhance board performance, while tracking progress, providing personalized feedback, and ensuring alignment with the board's goals.



  





**Board Communication and Support** 




  




1. Serve as the primary point of contact for board \& committees inquiries, managing communications professionally, providing timely responses, clarifying information, addressing concerns skillfully, nurturing relationships, and upholding a positive board \& committees experience.
2. Support board affairs director to Aadvise Board and Committee members on tailored communications strategies, fostering effective interactions with internal and external stakeholders, enhancing transparency and alignment, fostering collaboration, and promoting a harmonious working environment for organizational success.
3. Establish and maintain effective communication channels between the board and senior management, ensuring key information flows smoothly and providing timely updates on organizational performance and strategic initiatives.



  





**Event Coordination** 




  




1. Coordinate board retreats and strategic planning sessions, including agenda development, facilitator selection, and the creation of supporting materials to drive productive discussions and outcomes.
2. Prepare a comprehensive annual calendar of board and committee activities, meetings, and events, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities and timely notification to all board members, incorporating feedback, key deadlines, and strategic milestones for optimal planning.
3. Help to create and execute special board events, such as recognition ceremonies, award presentations, and networking opportunities, to foster camaraderie and appreciation among board members, coordinating guest speakers, thematic elements, and leveraging social media to highlight achievements.



  





**Governance and Compliance** 




  




1. Oversee the development and maintenance of a comprehensive board and committees members skills matrix, identifying gaps and recommending targeted recruitment to ensure a diverse and effective board, incorporating emerging competencies, succession planning needs, and strategic alignment with organizational goals.
2. Support the Chairman in conducting board evaluations, compiling performance metrics, and providing actionable insights and recommendations for enhancing board effectiveness by facilitating post\-evaluation discussions, addressing identified issues, clarifying roles, and setting clear improvement goals.
3. Ensure compliance with all governance policies and procedures, conducting regular reviews, recommending updates, and ensuring adherence to ethical standards and legal requirements, while integrating best practices, stakeholder feedback, and proactive risk management strategies for continuous improvement. Ensure all rules and bylaws are adhered to by the board \& committees members during meetings and in the implementation of their decisions.



  





**Innovation and Continuous Improvement** 




  




1. Continuously benchmark Board operations practices against industry standards, adopting improvements to enhance efficiency and governance effectiveness.
2. Implement and monitor process improvements by analyzing current Board operations practices, identifying inefficiencies, and applying best practices to streamline workflows.
3. Explore and adopt new technologies and tools that can improve Board operations, keeping the team at the forefront of innovation and efficiency.
4. Foster a high\-performance culture by striving for excellence and encouraging peers, contributing to the overall success and continuous improvement of the Board operations team.



  





**Team Collaboration and Continuous Learning** 




  




1. Work collaboratively with team members and DACO management by sharing knowledge, providing support, and actively participating in team activities to foster a positive and productive work environment.
2. Engage in continuous learning by seeking feedback, attending training sessions, and staying updated on industry trends to enhance personal skills and professional growth.



  





  





 3\. Minimum Job Requirements
 


* 
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Public Administration, Management, or a related field.
* 2 to 4 years of progressive experience in board management, corporate governance, compliance, legal or a related field.

 **Rotoflow**

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 The Senior Mechanical Engineer (District Cooling) will oversee the engineering design, review, and coordination of district cooling systems for the airport project under the Project Management Consultant (PMC). The role ensures efficient, reliable, and sustainable cooling solutions aligned with project requirements, international standards, and operational performance.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the design review and validation of district cooling systems, including chilled water plants, distribution networks, and energy transfer stations (ETS).
* Ensure compliance with project specifications, international standards, and local authority regulations.
* Coordinate with MEP, structural, and architectural teams to integrate district cooling systems within the project.
* Review and approve technical submittals, shop drawings, method statements, and material specifications.
* Oversee hydraulic calculations, cooling load assessments, and system optimization for energy efficiency.
* Provide technical guidance on plant equipment such as chillers, pumps, cooling towers, and control systems.
* Identify design and operational risks and implement mitigation strategies.
* Support value engineering initiatives to optimize cost, efficiency, and sustainability.
* Participate in design coordination meetings and liaise with stakeholders, including utility providers and operators.
* Review testing and commissioning plans to ensure system performance meets design intent.
* Ensure adherence to Hill International’s Quality, Environmental, Safety, and Occupational Health policies and procedures.
* Perform other duties as assigned by the Project Director or line manager.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering (Master’s degree preferred).
* Minimum 15 years of experience in mechanical engineering, with strong expertise in district cooling systems.
* Proven experience in large\-scale infrastructure or airport projects.
* Strong knowledge of chilled water systems, HVAC design, and energy\-efficient cooling technologies.
* Familiarity with international standards (e.g., ASHRAE, CIBSE) and district cooling best practices.
* Experience in design review, system optimization, and multidisciplinary coordination.
* Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work well under pressure and tight deadlines.
* Excellent command of written and spoken English.
* Strong leadership and interpersonal skills.


**About Us**
 Hill International, with more than 4,300\+ professionals in over 100 offices worldwide, provides program management, project management, construction management, project management oversight, advisory, facilities management, and other consulting services to clients in a variety of market sectors. Engineering News\-Record magazine recently ranked Hill as one of the largest program management firms in the world. For more information on Hill, please visit our website at www.hillintl.com .
   

  

 Hill is exclusively a program, project, and construction management provider, meaning we have one focus as a company: protecting client interests. Free of any potential conflicts, our entire business is geared towards helping clients achieve their desired outcomes. We are dedicated to exceeding expectations throughout the entire construction project lifecycle and adapt to the needs of each assignment to develop tailored approaches and solutions to meet those needs.
   

  

 Hill is a GISI Consulting Group company, part of the Global Infrastructure Solutions, Inc. (GISI) family of companies. Learn more about GISI Consulting Group at www.gisiconsulting.com .
   

  

**Hill International is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Veteran/Disabled**

The Job Holder will also prepare and present sales presentations, sales forecasts and action plans in order to maximise the market potential and will develop goals accordingly to achieve the specified sales and business development targets.

When engaging with a new Local Agent / Distributor ensure the due diligence documents should be completed and submitted in a timely manner to the Legal Department for approval. Continue to manage and support the Local Agents / Distributors – provide technical and commercial support, provide training and guidance, make joint visits to key Customers as necessary, set KPI’s, monitor and evaluate performance, provide feedback / escalate as necessary through weekly meetings and quarterly reviews.
* Demonstrate strong expertise for assigned products and for the industry.
* Develop and expand relationships with existing and potential Customers and maintain close relationships with key Customers through driving spares price agreements with key accounts.
* Communicate regularly and consistently with existing and potential Customers to generate leads and opportunities and maximize aftermarket entitlement of the installed base.

* Support Field Service Engineers and conduct joint site visits to facilitate work and training activities.

Analyze the requirements in line with data sheets, specifications, P\&IDs, plans, and other project specific documents. Design, size and select suitable products as per the Customers requirements and support the Application Engineering Team to develop an appropriate proposal / quotation.
* For both the Company and the Customer coordinate the technical and commercial review of the quotation and assist with the negotiations for the same.
* Once quotation negotiations have concluded, prior to receiving the Customers PO, secure the necessary approval as per Company established approval matrix for all orders above Company defined threshold limit and for all orders that stipulate exceptional T\&C’s.
* Organise and drive the preparation of bids and contracts.
* Coordinate with the Finance / Accounts team and be aware of and problems with Supplier and Customer accounts.
* Coordinate and actively participate in the order hand over meeting with the Manufacturing Facility, Project Manager and Supply Chain Team. Provide clarification on any specific project requirements and on any technical or commercial queries.
* With your Line Manager / Regional Director, review the market potential for assigned products in the assigned territories and compile a strategy and action plan in order to maximize market potential and achieve targets. Continue to develop and recommend innovative ideas and tactics to increase market share and increase sales.
* With your Line Manager / Regional Director, evaluate and determine optimum route to market, including a pricing and marketing strategy and identify suitable partnership Companies to sell Celeros Flow Technology products and services.
* Execute agreed action plans to achieve targets for assigned products in the assigned territories.
* Monitor market trends and competitor activity in the assigned region on a regular basis. Report any concerns and suggested solutions and any opportunities and suggested action plans to the Line Manager / Regional Director.
* Prepare weekly and monthly sales reports (forecast, customer visit report, etc.) showing sales volume including potential sales, monitored against the budget, with action plans to address variations.
* Prepare and deliver sales presentations and technical presentations to internal and external stakeholders.
* Participate in trade shows, exhibitions and seminars either directly or in conjunction with Local Agents / Distributors.
* Represent the Company in a professional manner aligned to the Celeros Flow Technology Values and ensure all activities comply with both legal and ethical standards.


**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**
* Thinks both creatively and commercially; has in\-depth engineering knowledge to identify technical risks, solve problems and provide solutions but also has in\-depth commercial knowledge to identify risks within contracts.
* Analyses and interprets common scientific and technical journals, financial reports, and legal documents.
* Must be able to define the problem, assess the risks, and develop recommendations for action plans. Furthermore, must be able to execute the action plan, focus and guide others to accomplish the plan and drive change where necessary.
* Encourages others to seek opportunities for different and innovative approaches to addressing problems and opportunities; facilitates the implementation and acceptance of change within the workplace.
* Displays exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, even when handling multiple demands and has a proven track record of meeting high performance standards.
* Responds professionally to all inquiries and complaints and remains calm and composed when under pressure.
* Communicates effectively, effortlessly tailoring the approach to the audience and the level of technical competence.
* Possesses the ability to prepare and deliver both sales and technical presentations and to train and transfer technical knowledge to internal and external stakeholders.
* Clearly and succinctly conveying information and ideas to individuals and groups in a variety of situations; communicating in a focused and compelling way that drives others’ thoughts and actions. Engages the audience and helps them understand and retain the message.
* Uses appropriate interpersonal styles and techniques to gain acceptance of ideas and plans; modifying one’s own behaviour to accommodate tasks, situations, and individuals involved.

 Authorized to work in Bahrain and previous registration with CRPEP preferred.

data.jd_text:
Be Part of a Legacy Bigger Than the Game
 



  





 At Al\-Qadsiah Club we’re creating more than teams—we’re crafting a legacy that goes beyond the game, making an impact both on and off the field. Driven by ambition, synergy, and innovation, we aim to inspire generations while shaping the future of Saudi sports.
 



  





 This is more than just a job—it’s an opportunity to be part of something larger than yourself. At Al\-Qadsiah, you’ll play a key role in shaping our legacy, contributing to the nation’s sports vision, and making history every step of the way.
 



  





  





**Overview:** 




  





 As the Individual and Unit Coach at Al\-Qadsiah Club, you will specialise in developing the technical abilities and individual behaviours of Academy players across multiple age groups. You will play a key role in delivering individual development programmes aligned with the club’s game model, supporting both player progression and overall team performance.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Leadership and Management** 




  




* Collaborate with the Head of Individual Development to deliver the Academy’s Individual Development Model
* Support the planning and delivery of monthly training programmes across age groups with clear development objectives
* Contribute to the ongoing evolution of individual development practices within the Academy



  





**Individual Development and Coaching** 




  




* Deliver high\-quality individual and small group coaching sessions focused on technical development and behaviour
* Design and deliver position\-specific and unit\-based training aligned to the Qadsiah Game Model
* Support players across all Academy age groups (U13–U21\) in their individual development journeys
* Provide targeted feedback during team training sessions to support individual player progression



  





**Analysis and Performance Support** 




  




* Lead the design and delivery of video analysis sessions for individual and small group development
* Maintain and develop a library of training sessions and best practice content using club platforms (IterPro, Hudl, SportsCode)
* Collaborate with the Performance Analysis department to enhance player development resources



  





**Collaboration and Player Development** 




  




* Contribute to Individual Development Plans and player performance reviews
* Work closely with multidisciplinary staff across the Academy to support holistic player development
* Engage with coaching staff to ensure alignment between individual and team objectives



  





  





**Qualifications** 




  





**Desirable:** 




  




* AFC Pro License or UEFA equivalent
* FIFA Guardian safeguarding qualification
* Skills, Knowledge and Experience:



  





**Essential** 
 :
 



  




* AFC A License or UEFA equivalent
* Proven experience coaching elite academy players
* Strong understanding of individual player development across different age groups
* Ability to deliver structured and targeted individual coaching sessions
* Experience working collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams
* Strong communication skills and ability to engage players effectively
* Proactive and structured approach to problem\-solving
* Comfortable working within a new cultural and professional environment
* Fluency in English



  





**Desirable:** 




  




* Experience using performance and analysis platforms such as IterPro, Hudl, and SportsCode
* Multilingual capability, including Arabic or Spanish
* Previous experience as a professional footballer Experience working in the Middle East
* Strong leadership and teamwork experience



  





  





**Why Join Al\-Qadsiah?** 




  





 Be Part of the Legacy: Join a club that’s redefining the future of Saudi sports, striving to lead the competition and set new standards of excellence.
 



  





 Experience the Culture: Thrive in an environment that values quality, accountability, diversity, synergy, innovation, and ambition, while embracing harmony—this is the Qadsiah Way.
 



  





 The Executives in Sport Group are retained on behalf of Al Qadsiah SC to make this appointment. All direct applications and CVs will be forwarded to The Executives in Sport Group.
 



  





**If this role is of interest, then please press the apply button and include a copy of your CV.**
